title: Junior Embedded Software / Payload Engineer
description:
Want to work within sustainability and drones? Looking to be part of an innovative, fast-growing Danish greentech company with global reach? Then Explicit might be the place for you. 

Our tech team is looking for a new colleague to help build and improve the electronics that turn our drones into precision measuring instruments. If you enjoy hands-on hardware work in a greentech environment and want real ownership over what you build, we want to hear from you. 

About the job 

You will be part of a small, talented tech team, responsible for designing, building and maintaining our fleet of custom UAV deployed across the world to help map critical emissions. 

Responsibilities: 

  • Developing payload firmware that communicates with our drone systems (MAVLink / DJI) and onboard gas instrumentation and other sensors. 

  • Helping to bring new sensor instruments from datasheet to bench to flight. 

  • Improving and fixing existing payloads, diagnose issues on the bench and through in-flight data, harden the firmware, and ship the fix. 

  • Building small interface and breakout PCBs in KiCad, from assembly and bringing it up through to your own revisions. 

  • Potential for CAD and other mechanical work, depending on your qualifications. 

About you 

  • A bachelor's degree or similar/higher in electronics, robotics, computer engineering, mechatronics, physics or similar. 

  • 1+ years of hands-on experience, from your studies, a project, or a job. 

  • Tinker with Arduino/Raspberry Pi type projects. 

  • Wired up and used Serial/UART, I²C, SPI, etc., not just read about them. 

  • Basic C/C++ (or Arduino) and a bit of Python. 

  • English at a professional level. 

Nice to have 

  • Curiosity about drones, sensors and physical measurements. 

  • PCB design/KiCad experience, with signal/noise integrity knowledge. 

  • CAD and/or mechanical knowledge. 

  • Python for log analysis and quick tooling. 

  • Danish is an advantage, but not a requirement. 

What we offer 

  • A permanent, full-time position in a fast-growing greentech company with real-world impact. 

  • Competitive benefits including paid pension, health insurance, parental leave and 6 weeks' holiday allowance. 

  • Real hardware ownership early on, with a senior engineer to learn from. 

  • A flat hierarchy where ideas are heard, initiative is encouraged, and responsibility comes early. 

  • A close-knit, supportive team that values collaboration, trust and learning. 

  • Work that measurably cuts industrial emissions. 

About Explicit 

Explicit ApS is a pioneering Danish engineering company specialising in drone-based emissions monitoring across the energy, maritime, waste management, and other industry sectors. We deliver reliable, transparent and actionable emissions data to some of the largest energy companies all over the world using our patented drone-based methodology. Every measurement depends on the payload the drone carries: the boards, firmware, and sensors. 

We are headquartered in Virum, Denmark, with offices in Norway, Germany and Australia. Our international team of around 30 colleagues brings together engineering, data and environmental expertise, united by a shared mission to make a difference in emissions monitoring. 

Practical information 

  • Application deadline: 21 August 2026 

  • Expected start date: 1 October 2026 or 1 November 2026 

  • Location: Virum, Denmark 

How to apply 

Please send your application, including a few lines about what you’ve built and your CV, to jobs@explicit.dk. 

If you have any questions about the role, you are welcome to contact Rune Brogaard, Technical Manager, at ryb@explicit.dk

title: Har du erfaring med autisme, angst og PTSD – og motiveres du af at skabe udvikling gennem en stabil, tillidsfuld og fagligt funderet relation?
description:
Vi søger medarbejdere til en længerevarende § 85-indsats omkring en ung mand i Aarhus. 
Målet er at etablere et lille, fast team, som kan skabe kontinuitet, genkendelighed og tryghed omkring borgeren.

Om indsatsen

Borgeren har autisme, angst og svær PTSD og har behov for struktureret og forudsigelig støtte i hverdagen.

Han kan opleve svære angstanfald, som i perioder påvirker hans evne til at handle og gennemføre almindelige hverdagsaktiviteter. En central del af opgaven er derfor at kunne bevare roen, skabe tryghed og støtte ham i at udvikle og anvende mestringsstrategier, når angsten fylder.

Samtidig er han selv motiveret for udvikling og progression. Der er derfor gode muligheder for at arbejde målrettet med små, men betydningsfulde skridt mod større mestring og selvstændighed.

Hvad skal du arbejde med?

Den socialpædagogiske støtte har blandt andet fokus på:

  • mestringsstrategier i forbindelse med angst og angstanfald
  • støtte til at finde ro og genvinde handlekraft i belastende situationer
  • struktur og opretholdelse af en stabil døgnrytme
  • støtte til hensigtsmæssige rutiner omkring søvn
  • social færdighedstræning
  • gradvis træning i at færdes uden for hjemmet, eksempelvis gennem gåture
  • støtte til aktiviteter uden for hjemmet og øget selvstændighed i hverdagen.

Opgaven kræver, at du kan arbejde roligt, tålmodigt og relationsorienteret. Du skal kunne møde borgeren dér, hvor han er, uden at forcere processen – samtidig med at du har blik for hans ressourcer, motivation og muligheder for progression.

 

Du bliver en del af et fast team

Kontinuitet er en vigtig del af indsatsen. Derfor søger vi medarbejdere, som ønsker at blive en del af et lille og fast team omkring borgeren.

Teamet skal så vidt muligt være selvdækkende og sammen skabe den stabilitet og genkendelighed, som borgeren har behov for.

I teamet deler I faglige perspektiver, metoder, observationer og erfaringer, så der skabes en fælles og sammenhængende tilgang til indsatsen. Der afholdes desuden løbende teammøder med mulighed for faglig sparring og koordinering.

 

Arbejdstider

Indsatsen leveres på faste tidspunkter:

Mandag: kl. 8.00-11.00 og kl. 21.00-23.00

Tirsdag: kl. 8.00-12.00 og kl. 21.00-23.00

Onsdag: kl. 8.00-11.00 og kl. 21.00-23.00

Torsdag: kl. 8.00-12.00 og kl. 21.00-23.00

Fredag: kl. 8.00-11.00 og kl. 21.00-23.00

Søndag: kl. 21.00-23.00

 

Fra 1. september øges dagvagterne til fire timer og placeres kl. 8.00-12.00 eller kl. 9.00-13.00.

Vagttidspunkterne ligger fast og kan ikke flyttes.

Du behøver ikke kunne dække alle vagterne. Vi hører også gerne fra dig, hvis du kan varetage én eller flere faste vagter og dermed indgå stabilt i teamet.

 

Hvem søger vi?

Vi søger dig, som har de faglige og personlige kompetencer til at arbejde med en borger med autisme, angst og svær PTSD.

Det er en klar fordel, hvis du har erfaring med et eller flere af områderne og eksempelvis har en social-, pædagogisk- eller sundhedsfaglig baggrund.

Vi lægger særligt vægt på, at du:

  • kan skabe ro, tryghed og forudsigelighed
  • kan bevare ro og overblik, når angsten fylder
  • arbejder respektfuldt og relationsorienteret
  • forstår betydningen af struktur og kontinuitet
  • kan arbejde udviklingsorienteret med respekt for borgerens tempo
  • er stabil og kan forpligte dig på faste vagter
  • bidrager aktivt til faglig sparring og et tæt teamsamarbejde.

Af hensyn til borgerens konkrete behov kan indsatsen udelukkende varetages af kvindelige medarbejdere.

Der er aktuelt ingen fastsat slutdato på indsatsen, og vi søger derfor medarbejdere, som har mulighed for at skabe kontinuitet over tid.

 

Kan du se dig selv i opgaven?

Hvis du har erfaring med autisme, angst og/eller PTSD og trives i et tæt relationsarbejde, hvor udvikling sker gennem tryghed, struktur og vedholdenhed, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Ved interesse får du naturligvis yderligere information om borgeren, støttebehovet og de faglige rammer som en del af den videre rekrutteringsproces.

 

Vi tilbyder dig

  • Teammøder, supervision og konflikthåndteringskurser
  • Faglig udvikling og sparring med kolleger
  • Attraktiv løn iflg. overenskomst

 

Ansøgning

Send din ansøgning og dit CV samt dine uddannelsesbeviser ved at klikke "Søg Stillingen" længere nede på siden.

title: Senior Automation Manager, Nørresundby, Denmark
description:
Are you our new Automation Manager with a passion for technology, leadership, and scalable automation solutions?

At DESMI, you will play a key role in strengthening and scaling our automation capabilities across the organization. You will be part of product development & innovation leading a skilled engineering team in Denmark and China to develop reliable and future-proof automation solutions for both products and customized needs.
Working closely with Product Management, Projects, Production, and Service, you will ensure strong alignment between technical solutions and business requirements. You will be responsible for setting direction, creating structure across projects, and ensuring high quality delivery of automation solutions across DESMI's global operations.
DESMI is a dynamic and innovative company where collaboration, continuous learning, and professional development are at the core of our culture. In this role, you will have the opportunity to influence the direction of our automation landscape, develop your team, and contribute to building scalable and efficient solutions that support our continued growth.

Ideally, we are looking for someone who is:
Technically grounded
Possess strong leadership and people management skills
Structured and organized

A glimpse into the role
You will lead a team of automation engineers while ensuring that our solutions are robust and aligned with business needs. Your primary responsibilities will include:
-Team Leadership & Development: Lead, motivate, and develop a high-performing automation team, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
-Project Execution & Prioritization: Plan, structure, and drive execution across multiple automation projects, ensuring clear priorities, efficient resource allocation, and on-time delivery.
-Technical Direction & Quality Assurance: Set the technical direction for automation solutions across hardware and software, ensuring reliable, serviceable, and future-proof designs.
-Operational Ownership of Automation Solutions: Oversee the development and maintenance of automation systems, translating business and product requirements into standardized, scalable technical solutions.
-Stakeholder Management: Act as the key point of contact for stakeholders across Product Management, Projects, Production, and Service, ensuring alignment and clear communication on scope, expectations, and deliverables.
-Process & Solution Optimization: Drive structured and transparent workflows across projects, continuously improving processes and enabling efficient and consistent delivery of automation solutions.
-Innovation & Continuous Improvement: Support the ongoing development of DESMI's automation portfolio by promoting a solution-oriented mindset and identifying opportunities for innovation and standardization.

Your next opportunity starts here
We're looking for an experienced and driven leader with a strong technical foundation in automation and a passion for developing both people and solutions. You thrive in a dynamic, international environment and are motivated by creating structure, driving progress, and delivering high-quality results together with your team.

We also imagine that you:
Have minimum 5 years of leadership experience managing technical teams
Bring a strong technical background within automation, electrical engineering, or a similar field, combined with hands-on experience in both hardware and software design
Are structured and capable of creating clarity and overview in complex project environments with multiple ongoing activities
Have strong planning and resource management skills, enabling you to prioritize effectively and ensure successful project execution
Communicate clearly and proactively with stakeholders across functions and organizational levels
Take a solution-oriented approach and are comfortable setting direction while supporting your team in delivering robust and scalable solutions
Have experience working in a dynamic environment where priorities can shift, and where adaptability is key to success
Are fluent in English, as it is DESMI's corporate language

The perks of being at DESMI
Flexible working hours - including possibilities for remote work.
Global career prospects - work with colleagues across Europe, Asia, and the U.S.
Skills development and career growth - Training, job rotation, and internal mobility
Pension - attractive employer contributions
Private healthcare and life insurance
On-site canteen - light breakfast, lunch buffet, and snacks
Company sports & social activities - from badminton and bowling to art clubs and summer parties

What we're about
But we're more than just pumps. At DESMI, we believe teamwork and innovation drive success.
When you join DESMI, you can expect:
A collaborative and supportive team environment.
Opportunities for continuous learning and professional development.
A chance to contribute your ideas and make a real impact.
A company that values sustainability and innovation.

We are a flat organization with an open-door policy, where decisions are made together, and ideas are always welcome. Here, doers thrive - if you see an opportunity for improvement, you have the freedom to act on it.
As innovators in reliable and sustainable flow solutions, we serve a wide range of industries from Aquaculture and Defense to Green Technologies - the list goes on. Sustainability is highly appreciated while developing high-performance and long-lasting technologies that help industries adapt to evolving markets while reducing environmental impact.

Ready to apply?
If you're a dedicated and motivated individual seeking a challenging and rewarding career where you can contribute to a more sustainable future, we encourage you to apply!

To learn more about this please contact Søren Flummer (SORF@desmi.com). We are reviewing applications on a rolling basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Are you an Authorised Veterinary Nurse with strong anaesthesia and surgical nursing experience?

MyPeterinarian is looking for an experienced Veterinary Nurse to join our Copenhagen team in a part-time role with a strong focus on anaesthesia, surgical nursing and high-quality patient care.

Founded in 2017, MyPeterinarian is an established independent veterinary clinic, grooming salon and pet-sitting company. We are a close-knit team focused on excellent patient care, strong client relationships and creating a positive working environment.

About the Role

The core responsibility of this role is independently managing anaesthesia monitoring - from patient preparation and induction through to recovery. You will play an important role in ensuring safe, calm and well-managed surgical procedures while working closely with the veterinary team.

This role is ideal for a nurse who enjoys surgical nursing, values careful patient monitoring and is confident taking responsibility within their area of expertise.

Please note: MyPeterinarian is planning to relocate to a new Copenhagen location between now and the end of September 2026 -the exact address will be shared during the interview process 

Schedule

Approximately 21 hours per week

  • Tuesday and Wednesday: 09:00-15:00

  • Monday, Thursday and Friday: 10:00-13:00

  • Exact schedule to be agreed with the successful candidate

This is a weekday-only position, with no evenings, weekends or night shifts scheduled as standard, supporting a healthy work-life balance.

Expected start date: 15 September 2026

Key Responsibilities

  • Independently monitoring anaesthesia, including induction and recovery

  • Preparing patients for surgery and providing surgical assistance

  • Supporting blood sample collection and other clinical procedures

  • Providing routine patient care, including nail clipping

  • Handling and supporting patients throughout their visit

  • Maintaining clinical hygiene standards and sterilising equipment

  • Supporting reception and administrative tasks when required

  • Assisting with stock checks and inventory management

Qualifications

We are looking for someone who:

  • Is an Authorised Veterinary Nurse

  • Has proven experience of independently monitoring anaesthesia

  • Is comfortable working independently during surgical procedures

  • Has excellent patient handling skills and a calm, professional approach

  • Has a good standard of spoken and written English (Danish is an advantage but not essential)

  • Enjoys being part of a small, collaborative team

What We Offer

  • A friendly and professional team environment

  • A varied clinical role with genuine responsibility

  • No evenings, weekends or night shifts scheduled as standard 

  • Salary: 200dkk/hr

  • Regular team gatherings and a supportive workplace culture

  • Opportunity to increase working hours over time, by mutual agreement

  • Staff discounts on MyPeterinarian veterinary, grooming and pet-sitting services for your own pets

Application Process

Application deadline: 15 August 2026

Please note that applicants must already have the right to work in Denmark. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position.

title: Electrical Technician; Location: DK - Esbjerg
description:
Are you passionate about hands-on electrical work in the offshore and maritime industry? Do you thrive on a diverse range of tasks and enjoy travelling as part of your job? If so, this exciting opportunity could be perfect for you!

Your Position
In our Rig & Marine division, we are seeking an Electrical Technician who takes pride in quality craftsmanship and in getting the job done safely. This role offers numerous intriguing challenges, including yard stays and modification projects that contribute to the green transition within drilling rigs and special vessels. Depending on your experience, you may also act as Working Supervisor /
Foreman on selected projects, leading a small team of electricians and cable pullers.

At Semco Maritime safety is a core value, and in this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering innovative solutions. Above all, your work will make a real change for the global energy sector.

You will join a team of 5 colleagues working both locally and globally on projects within our division. The Rig & Marine division is comprised of 450 colleagues worldwide. This full-time position is based at our headquarters in Esbjerg, Denmark. You should expect between 100-150 travel days per year, with occasional work at our yard or locally in Esbjerg.

“I'm looking for an Electrical Technician who takes pride in the craft. This job is hands-on – pulling cables, terminating, testing and troubleshooting on rigs and special vessels around the world – always with safety first. If you enjoy varied work and being part of a tight-knit team – and perhaps have the ambition to step up as Working Supervisor on our projects – we'd love to hear from you.” - Manager, Electrical Engineering, Frederik Vester Pedersen

Your tasks and responsibilities
You will carry out electrical installation and maintenance work on our projects and report progress to your Supervisor or Project Manager. Quality, safety, and good order in tools and materials are essential in this role.
  • Perform electrical installation work such as cable pulling, glanding, termination, and mounting of equipment according to drawings and specifications.
  • Carry out testing, troubleshooting, and commissioning support on electrical systems on drilling rigs and special vessels.
  • Work in accordance with the permit-to-work system and all HSE rules and regulations, contributing to a strong safety culture on site.
  • Register your hours daily and help keep track of materials, tools, and equipment.
  • Cooperate with colleagues and other contractors on site and report progress and any deviations to your Supervisor.
  • When acting as Working Supervisor / Foreman: lead and coordinate the workforce on site, ensure quality and adherence to deadlines, and approve daily timesheets before handover to the Project Manager.

Your qualifications and Skills
We imagine that you are very independent and thrive when things change rapidly – sometimes by the hour. You are passionate about what you do, and you are eager to get things done in the right way while collaborating with various stakeholders.

To succeed in this position, we expect that you have:
  • A background as an electrician, with a minimum of 5 years of experience in the offshore or marine industry is preferred.
  • Experience reading and working from electrical drawings and technical documentation.
  • Proficiency in English, both oral and written, is essential.
  • Experience with fibre optic splicing is an additional advantage.
  • Experience as a Working Supervisor or Foreman – or the ambition to take on that responsibility – is a strong advantage.

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your application promptly via the link provided on the page.
For any inquiries, please feel free to contact Manager, Electrical Engineering, Frederik Vester Pedersen, +45 7916 6420 
We are excited to hear from you and potentially welcome you to our team!

Welcome to Semco Maritime 
At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. 

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. 

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. 

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   

Care to join the movement? 
Change. With us.

A role where you will have the trust as well as the responsibilities to play a key role in shaping the way we work? Within a team that is the pillar for all developmental work within our division, driving innovation and setting the standard for all upcoming projects? Then this is your chance to not just show what you’re made of, but also to join a world leader within renewables energy that have no intention to slow down the green energy transition.

Your position
We offer you an interesting and challenging job in an international organization, where we strive to provide innovative and creative solutions. You will get the unique opportunity to work in an environment characterized by dedication, passion, and ambition.

At Semco Maritime you will be joining our dedicated Product Line Team in our Renewables Division whose mission is to develop solutions for Offshore Substations engineered and constructed together with our close partners. Our goal is to standardize solutions while maintaining flexibility to align client needs with supplier capabilities. Offshore substation industrialisation is the key enabler for the green transition worldwide, and as such, your product solutions will need to reflect that. We have the largest project portfolio within offshore substations worldwide, so you will join a well-established company in growth and work with a team of changers.

“We are world-leading within offshore substations, and we have a strong focus on both AC and DC connections, as well as advanced floating technologies. Our Offshore Wind markets include Europe, Asia, and the USA, which means that you can expect to be involved in projects worldwide!” - Director, Product Line Management, Jannick Elmbæk Olsen.

Your tasks & responsibilities
As our new Electrical Engineer for High Voltage, you will be responsible for development, implementation, and maintenance of the products and solutions offerings for our offshore substation product line.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to:
  • HV/MV product and solutions development and maintenance in line with future market requirements
  • Proposal development based on the architecture framework and the client’s requirements
  • Working closely with our Tender team focusing on our customers Employer Requirements and Semco Maritimes own modular architecture
  • Maintain knowledge on market demand and implement product improvements and requirements for product line to fit future projects
  • Coordinate and secure strategic supply chain together with Procurement, including cost-out activities
  • Develop and maintain the product roadmap with input on new technologies from the supply chain, organization, and the market
  • Provide supervision and guidance to the development and execution teams

The successful candidate will be expected to form strong working relationships with the other existing teams e.g., in sales, tender, project management, construction, and most importantly, our in-house engineering organisation.

Your profile & qualifications
You are an experienced HV professional with a product development mindset, preferably coming from either an OEM or from an engineering organisation. Your collaborative spirit and commercial acumen will thrive in our international setting. In addition, you are a proactive team player with a continuous improvement mindset, analytical prowess, and a solution-oriented approach.

To succeed in this position, we expect that you:
  • Have experience with design, procurement and construction of the high voltage and medium voltage systems, such as electrical distribution, power transformers and GIS switchgear.
  • Are familiar with industrial layout design, routing, 3D modelling, structural and weight estimation of high voltage components, preferably on Offshore Substations
  • Have experience with interface management across systems
  • Possess excellent communication skills in English

As a person you are a natural team player and collaborator who enjoy working across many business areas. You have a strong drive and desire to continually develop high quality solutions in a dynamic environment. Furthermore, you have strong analytical and problem-solving skills to come up with efficient ways to solve obstacles.

You are born curious and have a positive mindset.

The position is full time and your work location can be either at our office in Copenhagen, Esbjerg or Gdynia. You should expect up to 10-30 travel days annually.

If you have any questions, you are welcome to contact Head of Solution Engineering, PLM – Jesper S. Rytke +45 2721 9705.
We conduct our interviews on an ongoing basis, so if you are interested, you must submit your application as soon as possible via the link on the page.

Welcome to Semco Maritime 
At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. 

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. 

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. 

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  
We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   

Care to join the movement? 
Change. With us. 
Apply
Share in your network

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

title: High Voltage Electrical Engineer for Renewables; Location: DK - Esbjerg, DK - Copenhagen
description:
Do you want to play a leading role in transforming the global energy sector from fossil fuels to renewable? Then this is your chance. Join us! 

Your position
In your new position as Electrical Engineer in the Renewables division, you will be a valuable member of the dedicated High Voltage Equipment team who is responsible for driving designs, installations, tests and commissioning of medium- and high voltage projects for large and specialized offshore substation projects. 

We are looking for an experienced specialist or an ambitious individual aiming to become an expert in High Voltage Equipment for offshore use. You will collaborate with highly skilled colleagues and can play a crucial role in designing offshore substations, from the tender phase through to commissioning.

Here, you will work with some of the brightest and most skilled engineers in developing technical solutions to our customers all over the world. You will have the exciting chance to bring your knowledge into work in the core area of high voltage systems. Above all, your work will make a real change for the global energy sector.

You may choose working from our head office in Esbjerg or our Nordhavn office close to the centre of Copenhagen. The position is full-time, and you can expect 10-30 travel days per year.

“As part of the high voltage team, we get to contribute to some of the largest offshore substations the world has ever seen. You will travel to different countries and will be working with team members from multiple cultures. Further you will have the opportunity to involve in both the theoretical and practical aspects of offshore wind farm projects. This is done in an informal atmosphere with high focus on knowledge sharing and development,” says Colleagues from the Electrical department. 

Your tasks & responsibilities
In the role you will be responsible for driving part of the high voltage scope of the projects. You will be the technical design responsible of own scope and in cooperation with the project team oversee compliance of the time schedule and budget, to ensure the project's successful completion.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to:
  • Responsible for design, calculations and engineering of HV/MV equipment in our EPC projects.
  • Handling suppliers, negotiations and contracts in cooperation with the project team and procurement department.
  • Planning and potentially attending FAT, HAT, SAT, commissioning and handover of projects to clients and their O&M organisation.
  • Developing, optimizing and standardizing technical solutions, as well as participating and supporting tenders.

Your profile & qualifications
As a person you are dedicated and proud of what you do, you are trustworthy, positive and a team player. Furthermore, you should be able to collaborate with both external and internal stakeholders and have a proactive, analytical and organized approach to your work.

To succeed in this position, we expect you to have:
  • A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, High Voltage Electrical Power Systems or Electrical Installation Engineer.
  • Experience in designing high voltage components such as High- and Medium Voltage GIS and oil-immersed equipment.
  • Practical experience in the installation, testing, and commissioning of high voltage equipment, as well as knowledge of offshore design requirements, is beneficial.
  • An understanding of project management and detailed engineering from offshore substations or other relevant electrical projects.
  • Can communicate in English, both verbal and written.
  • You should be the go-to person for technical clarifications and possess a good sense of humour, which is always appreciated at Semco Maritime.

Karstensens Skibsværft søger medarbejder til installation af mekaniske komponenter

Vil du være med til at bygge nogle af verdens mest avancerede fiskefartøjer? Hos Karstensens Skibsværft har vi en stor ordrebog, og vi søger derfor en dygtig mekanisk medarbejder, der har lyst til at blive en del af et stærkt team med høj faglighed og godt sammenhold.

Du bliver en del af et team på 4 erfarne mekaniske medarbejdere, som arbejder tæt sammen om installation og færdiggørelse af mekaniske løsninger ombord på vores nybygninger. Vores skibe er kendetegnet ved høj kvalitet og avancerede tekniske løsninger, og derfor er det afgørende, at de mekaniske installationer fungerer optimalt.

Hos os får du en hverdag med varierende opgaver, hvor du både arbejder selvstændigt og i tæt samarbejde med kollegaer på tværs af faggrupper.

 

Om opgaverne

Dine primære opgaver vil være installation og montage af mekaniske komponenter på vores nybygninger, herunder blandt andet:

  • Installation og opbygning af kraner, spil og øvrigt dæksudstyr.

  • Montage, tilpasning og justering af mekaniske komponenter.

  • Fejlfinding og kvalitetssikring af installationer.

  • Mindre opretnings-opgaver.

 

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har en god forståelse for mekanik og mekaniske komponenter.

  • Har en mekanisk baggrund, f.eks. som skibsmontør eller lignende.

  • Arbejder effektivt og har en fleksibel tilgang til opgaver.

  • Trives med både selvstændigt arbejde og teamwork.

  • Har øje for kvalitet og detaljer i dit arbejde.

Hos os får du:

  • En fast og varig stilling på fuldtid.

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer.

  • En attraktiv pensionsordning og sundhedssikring.

  • En anderledes og spændende arbejdsplads, hvor sikkerhed er en topprioritet.

  • Et stærkt socialt fællesskab og sjove sociale arrangementer.

 

Vil du med ombord?

Hvis du har lyst til at blive en del af et internationalt team på Skagens største arbejdsplads – så skal du sende din ansøgning afsted nu. Vi behandler ansøgningerne og indkalder til samtaler løbende.

title: Creative Concept & Content Developer
description:
At Les Deux, we believe great brands are built at the intersection of culture, community, and product. We’re looking for a Creative Concept & Content Developer who brings strong ideas to the table and helps turn them into inspiring executions.

This role is for someone with a sharp understanding of fashion, culture, and storytelling. You know how to turn a collection into a world people want to be part of — and you understand that the best results are created together. Travel will be part of the role, primarily in connection with our campaigns. However, travel is driven by business needs and is not required for every campaign. We typically run around four main campaigns per year, alongside smaller activations and collaborations.

What you Actually Will be Doing
  • Drive and develop creative concepts for campaigns, collaborations, social media, and brand activations
  • Turn ideas into output, from moodboards and concepts to final content across platforms
  • Art-direct photoshoots, content productions, and brand experiences, while briefing and collaborating with external creatives such as photographers, stylists, and videographers
  • Ensure a 360° rollout both online and offline across social media, campaign materials, POS and physical spaces (stores, pop-ups, activations)
  • Work closely with our Design, Brand Marketing, Social and eCommerce team
  • Help maintain and evolve the visual universe of Les Deux, always with an ambitious mindset where we dare to think the impossible = possible

What You Bring to the Table
  • 3–5 years of experience in a similar creative role within fashion or lifestyle
  • A strong portfolio showcasing campaign development, art direction, and concepts brought to life
  • A solid understanding of both the creative and practical side of content production
  • The ability to balance creative ambition with commercial goals
  • A collaborative mindset with ownership and a strong team spirit

What Success Looks Like
  • Campaigns that feel strong, distinctive, relevant and well executed, not just good on paper.
  • Clear and consistent brand expression across all touchpoints
  • Content and concepts that work across formats and platforms
  • Campaigns and activations that generate attention, engagement and cultural relevance

What We Bring to the Table
  • A workplace built on teamwork, good energy, and mutual support
  • A creative role with real responsibility and influence across campaigns, collaborations, and brand moments
  • A varied workday with close collaboration across Design, Brand, Social, and eCommerce
  • Daily work from our Copenhagen HQ, with flexibility in your workday and a culture built on mutual give-and-take

SC Logistik ApS is looking for an experienced and reliable CE driver for tipper and gravel transport on Zealand.

We are looking for a driver who already has experience with tipper/gravel trailers and is used to transporting materials such as soil, sand, gravel and other construction materials.

We offer

  • Stable and regular work

  • Start date by agreement

We place great importance on having the right experience with tipper transport. You do not necessarily need to know all the work locations in advance, but you must be comfortable working with a tipper trailer and be familiar with this type of transport.

title: Mekaniker - service, reparation og vedligeholdelse af lastbiler og opbygninger
description:
SAWO HERLEV

Mekaniker med blik for teknik, kvalitet og løsninger, der holder

Vil du arbejde med mere end standardreparationer – og blive specialist i hydraulik, el og avancerede opbygninger på lastbiler?

Hos SAWO får du faglige udfordringer, gode kolleger og mulighed for at udvikle dig i en branche, hvor dit håndværk gør en synlig forskel for kunden hver eneste dag.

Bliv en del af holdet i Herlev

Vi har travlt – og det er der en god grund til. SAWO er Danmarks førende specialist i opbygninger og udstyr til lastbiler og entreprenørkøretøjer. Siden 1962 har vi leveret driftssikre, skræddersyede løsninger, og i Herlev har vi brug for endnu en dygtig mekaniker, som vil være med til at holde både udstyr og kundernes hverdag kørende.

Du bliver en del af et erfarent og hjælpsomt værkstedsteam, hvor vi deler viden, hjælper hinanden og går op i at aflevere et stykke arbejde, vi kan være stolte af.

Din hverdag hos os

Du får en varieret arbejdsdag med både planlagte opgaver og faglige udfordringer, der kræver nysgerrighed og en god teknisk forståelse. Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

·     Service, reparation og vedligeholdelse af lastbiler og opbygninger

·     Fejlfinding på mekaniske, hydrauliske og elektriske systemer

·     Montering, tilpasning og klargøring af udstyr

·     Kvalitetssikring og dialog med kolleger om den bedste løsning

·     Bidrag til, at kunderne får driftssikkert udstyr og kortest mulig nedetid

Derfor skal du vælge SAWO

·     Et stærkt fagligt miljø – du arbejder sammen med erfarne specialister og får kolleger, der gerne deler deres viden.

·     Opgaver med variation – du møder forskellige køretøjer, opbygninger og tekniske problemstillinger.

·     Mulighed for at blive endnu dygtigere – vi tilbyder relevante kurser og efteruddannelse.

·     Ordentlige rammer – gode arbejdsforhold, hjælpsomme kolleger og en uformel omgangstone.

·     En arbejdsplads med retning – du bliver en del af en landsdækkende specialistvirksomhed med stolte håndværkstraditioner og stor efterspørgsel.


 

Er det dig, vi leder efter?

Du har en faglig baggrund som mekaniker eller reparatør – eller solid erfaring, der giver dig et stærkt teknisk fundament. Du arbejder selvstændigt, men trives også i et team, hvor man lykkes sammen.

Vi forestiller os desuden, at du:

·     har erfaring med mekanisk montage, fejlfinding og service

·     har flair for hydraulik og el – eller lyst til at lære mere

·     er kvalitetsbevidst og følger opgaven helt til dørs

·     er fleksibel, serviceminded og har forståelse for kundens behov

·     har kørekort til kategori B

Du behøver ikke kunne alt fra første dag. Det vigtigste er, at du har et godt mekanisk fundament, tager ansvar for kvaliteten og har lyst til at udvikle dig sammen med os.

Om SAWO

SAWO leverer, opbygger og servicerer kraner, hejs, ladopbygninger, lifte og specialudstyr til transport- og entreprenørbranchen. Med værksteder og servicepunkter over hele Danmark hjælper vi kunderne hurtigt og kompetent – fra rådgivning og specialopbygning til service, reparation og reservedele.

Bag hver løsning står mennesker med høj faglighed og respekt for godt håndværk. Det gælder også dig, hvis du bliver vores nye kollega.

Klar til næste skridt?0

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til Oliver Cox på oco@sawo.dk. Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat, så send gerne din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.

title: GenAI Specialist
description:
Paiblock, the world’s oldest blockchain company, building enterprise-grade digital currency infrastructure since 2011, is currently looking for a GenAI Specialist, that can help shape the next generation of digital customer experiences in crypto payment processing.

We currently repurposing our GenAI-powered assistant from a strong conversational experience into a more personalized, connected, and action-oriented AI product.

You will be central to that journey: designing, building, evaluating, and operating AI systems that can use internal knowledge and APIs responsibly to help customers get the right guidance at the right moment.

About the role

As our GenAI Specialist, you will be a hands-on engineer based at our Copenhagen office. You will support technical direction while building production systems alongside the team.

You will work across the full lifecycle of our AI capabilities, from agent design and retrieval to evaluation, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

Your work will include, among other things:

  • Designing and building production-grade agentic workflows, including tool and API use, orchestration, context management, grounding, guardrails, and safe fallback or handover paths.

  • Integrating AI systems with internal APIs, data sources, and customer journeys, and building reliable data-ingestion, retrieval, and grounding pipelines that enable relevant and personalized support.

  • Establishing the evaluation, testing, and observability practices needed to operate reliable AI systems, measuring quality, safety, task completion, latency, cost, and failure modes, and using those insights to support controlled self-improvement over time.

  • Setting technical direction and making sound architectural decisions across models, frameworks, data, security, reliability, and platform design.

  • Working closely with the Product Owner, engineers, and business stakeholders to turn customer problems into technically credible, high-value solutions, while raising the team’s technical bar through hands-on collaboration and knowledge sharing.

We offer

Here are some of the benefits of working at Paiblock:

  • An inclusive work environment where everyone is welcome

  • Career and development opportunities in a Danish blockchain scaleup

  • Possibility of a hybrid workplace

  • A health-promoting workplace with e.g., fitness programs and various sports activities

  • Attractive insurance benefits and pension

Who are you?

You are a junior engineer or graduate that is deeply curious about the fast-moving AI landscape but grounded in the discipline required to ship reliable products. You enjoy building, testing, measuring, and improving systems in production.

You are a true team player who enjoys lifting others and driving shared technical excellence. You are curious, pragmatic, and unafraid to challenge both technical and business assumptions. Switching between hands-on coding, architectural thinking, and stakeholder dialogue feels natural to you, and you thrive in an international cross-functional, and hybrid working environment.

You're likely bringing:

  • Experience building and deploying agentic systems in production, with hands-on Python engineering skills. This includes practical experience with patterns such as tool use, orchestration, routing, state management, guardrails, agent harness, and human-in-the-loop flows.

  • Experience integrating AI solutions with production APIs, internal data, and business-critical systems, together with strong knowledge of RAG, retrieval pipelines, embeddings, vector search, and grounding strategies.

  • Experience working with databases and data platforms such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Databricks, including deploying, managing, and integrating them in production environments.

  • Experience designing AI evaluations, test suites, quality metrics, feedback loops, and production monitoring, including tracing, prompt and version tracking, quality monitoring, latency, cost, and incident analysis.

  • Strong cloud and software-engineering practices, Git, security, and reliable API design.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical trade-offs clearly, challenge assumptions constructively, and turn technical complexity into clear guidance for developers and business stakeholders.

title: Skal du have en plads bag rattet i en af Aarhus’ ambulancer?
description:
Præhospitalet søger lige nu en ny kollega, der har lyst til at være en del den regionale ambulancetjeneste i Aarhusområdet. 

Du får hjemmebase på Præhospitalets største base på Bautavej i Aarhus V, hvor du bliver en del af et stærkt, kollegialt fællesskab.

Vi har en ledig stilling i DAN-vagtrul til besættelse 1. november 2026, eller efter aftale. Her får du 12-timers vagter i rækkefølgen 6-18, 11-23, 18-06 og 5 fridøgn

Hvem er du?
Du er uddannet paramediciner eller ambulancebehandler med autorisation. Du skal være fagligt velfunderet og opdateret inden for dit felt, og du skal have vist, at du tager ansvar for egen faglig udvikling og uddannelse.

Du kommer til at indgå i en organisation, der har fokus på både at løse de daglige opgaver, og hvor opgaverne er under fortsat udvikling. Vi håber, at du vil bidrage til en konstruktiv og løsningsorienteret samarbejdskultur – på tværs af faggrupper og organisatoriske tilhørsforhold. Der vil således blive lagt vægt på dine evner til at samarbejde og til at bidrage til et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab i ambulancerne og i Præhospitalet som helhed. 

Du skal have kørekort kategori B og C. 

Der indhentes straffeattest og børneattest.

Din nye arbejdsplads
Præhospitalet har ansvaret for det præhospitale område i Region Midtjylland, og vores hovedopgave og vision er ”at sikre rette hjælp i rette tid til alle patienter”. Præhospitalet har som de øvrige hospitaler i regionen både drifts-, behandlings-, uddannelses-, kvalitetssikrings- og forskningsmæssige opgaver. I Præhospitalet møder du kolleger med mange forskellige fagligheder, og fælles for alle er, at vi stræber efter at gøre det bedste for patienterne.

I Præhospitalet lægger vi vægt på høj faglighed, uddannelse og udvikling. Det håber vi også, at du gør, for kompetencevedligehold og efteruddannelse bliver en lige så fast del af dit arbejde som udrykning og behandling af patienter. Derfor skal du også selv have et ønske om at styrke din egen faglighed og udvikling. Det gør du selvfølgelig ikke alene – for vi hjælper og støtter hinanden, og der er kort vej fra medarbejdere til ledelsen. Vi vil gerne være en attraktiv og rummelig arbejdsplads, og du skal kunne se dig selv som en del af et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab og meget gerne bidrage til det fælles arbejdsmiljø. 

Du bliver ansat i Præhospitalets afdeling for ambulancer og akutlægebiler. Afdelingen ledes af en afdelingsledelse, som består af en ambulancechef og en cheflæge, samt en funktionsledelse bestående af 11 funktionsledere. Funktionslederne varetager personaleledelsen af ambulancepersonalet samt den daglige drift.

Du kommer til at referere til funktionsleder Morten Herlev.

Løn og ansættelsesforhold i henhold til overenskomst med FOA.


Yderligere information
Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at skrive eller ringe til:
Funktionsleder Morten Herlev
Mail: M.Herlev@rm.dk 
Tlf.: 51152151

Du kan finde flere oplysninger om Præhospitalet her Præhospitalet

Sådan søger du
Du søger nemt stillingen via linket "send ansøgning" nederst på siden. Her bliver du bedt om at udfylde nogle oplysninger om dig selv (navn, adresse mv.) samt vedhæfte en motiveret ansøgning og et opdateret CV.

Ansættelsesproces
Der er ansøgningsfrist d. 24. august 2026. Samtaler afholdes d. 26. august på Olof Palmes Allé i Aarhus N.

 

 


Stillingen er som udgangspunkt en fuldtidsstilling.

Da Region Midtjylland løbende gennemfører besparelser og omorganiseringer, vil medarbejdere i omplacering, der søger stillingen, have fortrinsret.

Region Midtjylland er jf. EU’s løngennemsigtighedsdirektiv, der trådte i kraft 7. juni 2026 forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startløn eller et interval for startløn for en stilling inden du tilbydes ansættelse.

Her finder du Region Midtjyllands lønkatalog for de fleste faggrupper og stillinger, som findes i Region Midtjylland: Gennemsigtighed forud for ansættelse - Medarbejder.rm.dk

title: Kan du synge “Hjulene på bussen” uden at miste pusten? Svanen søger vuggestue pædagog
description:
En attraktiv pædagogstilling i Svanens vuggestue er nu ledig – start 1. november 2026.

Har du en passion for de yngste børn og lyst til at indgå i et nærværende og engageret team? Så kan du være den pædagog, vi leder efter til vores vuggestue.

Hos os får du ikke bare et job – du bliver en del af et fællesskab.

Vi leder efter dig, der deler vores værdier, og som gerne vil være en aktiv del af det pædagogiske arbejde og fællesskabet omkring børnene. 

Hos os får du kollegial sparring, fælles ansvar og mulighed for at udvikle dig i samarbejde med resten af personalegruppen. Hver uge har vi tid sat af til både planlægning og samarbejde. Du får en times forberedelse og 45 minutters stuemøde med dine kollegaer på stuen. Det giver ro til at skabe veltilrettelagte pædagogiske forløb og et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab, som børnene mærker i hverdagen. Hos os i Svanen ønsker vi os en kultur, hvor man kommer med lige dele faglighed og vilje til samarbejde. I Brøndby Kommune har du ligeledes mulighed for at udvikle dig fagligt, da der løbende er tilbud om videreudvikling af pædagogisk personale i form af kurser, uddannelse og faglige oplæg. Vi passer på vores pædagoger og gør os umage med at skabe en rar og spænde arbejdsplads.


Om os
Børnehuset Svanen er et mindre børnehus normeret til 22 vuggestuebørn fordelt på to stuer og 40 børnehavebørn fordelt på to stuer. 

Vi ligger i et område, der byder på mange muligheder for aktiviteter – bl.a. volden, stranden, dyregården, middelalderlandsbyen og kulturhuset. VI har ladcykler som vi ofte bruger til at komme rundt omkring på tur.

Svanen ligger tæt på offentlig transport og har fantastiske fysiske rammer både ude og inde.


Vi søger en pædagog som:

  • Er anerkendende i din tilgang til både børn, forældre og kollegaer

  • Er ansvarlig, fleksibel og som er god til at strukturere en uge med aktiviteter for børnene

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt med en børnegruppe og tage ansvar for eget arbejde

  • Er smilende, energisk og klar på at sætte lege i gang sammen med børnene

  • Har overblik og et godt organiserings-gen så du kan bidrage til at skabe struktur i hverdagen

  • Hvis du er glad for sang, musik og bevægelse er det en fordel, men ikke et krav

  • Du kan være nyuddannet eller erfaren – det vigtigste er, at du bygger stærke relationer til børnene og ser dem som de små mennesker, de er

Har du læst med hele vejen og tænker: “Det lyder som mig”? Så håber vi, du har lyst til at tage næste skridt – og blive en del af fællesskabet i Børnehuset Svanen.

Du er velkommen til at give os et kald, hvis du har lyst til en rundvisning. Ring til dagtilbudsleder Katrine på 21 36 63 45.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Ansøgningsfrist:
Der er ansøgningsfrist d. 17. september 2026 og vi holder ansættelsessamtaler løbende og d. 21. september fra kl. 12.30 – 16.00.
Stillingen er som udgangspunkt en 37‑timers stilling – men vi ved, at livet kommer i mange former, så vi er åbne for en dialog om arbejdstiden.

 

Søg stillingen via 'ansøg'-knappen. Her kan du uploade din ansøgning og CV samt evt. relevant dokumentation. 

Alle interesserede ansøgere uanset alder, køn, handicap, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold opfordres til at søge stillingen.

I Brøndby Kommune er der en generel politik om, at nyansatte skal forevise straffeattest. Ved beskæftigelse og direkte kontakt med børn under 15 år, indhentes der også en børneattest.

Brøndby Kommune har røgfri arbejdstid. 

Brøndby er en centralt beliggende hovedstadskommune med cirka 40.000 indbyggere. Byens puls er præget af fællesskab, mangfoldighed og en stærk idrætskultur. Vi er en kommune med kant og spændende kontraster med bolig- og erhvervsområder, skove, grønne områder og Strandparken med havet og indsøerne.

title: Erfaren maler søges til renoverings- og vedligeholdelsesopgaver på Langeland
description:

title: Go-to-Market Responsible
description:
Do you enjoy turning product direction into commercially successful go-to-market plans? Are you motivated by bringing collections to life across retail, e-commerce and other consumer-facing channels? And do you thrive in the role that connects Product, Brand Identity and commercial execution?

Then you may be the Go-to-Market Responsible we are looking for.

YOUR TEAM
You'll join our E-Commerce & DTC Marketing team, where we bring our collections to market across retail, e-commerce and other consumer-facing channels. As our GTM Responsible, you'll work closely with specialists across CRM, Media, Retail & E-Commerce while partnering with Product, Brand Identity and B2B Communications to ensure every launch is successfully planned and delivered.

YOUR ROLE
As our Go-to-Market Responsible, you'll own the annual DTC go-to-market plan, translating product direction into commercially successful market launches. Working closely with Product, Brand Identity and key business stakeholders, you'll shape go-to-market plans that connect product direction with commercial execution across retail, e-commerce and other consumer-facing channels.
You'll ensure product direction is translated into clear plans, strong cross-functional collaboration and successful execution, bringing launches to market on time and supporting both revenue growth and brand awareness.

Your key responsibilities include:

  • Developing and driving the annual DTC go-to-market plan

  • Translating product direction into campaign and rollout plans

  • Planning and coordinating market launches across retail, e-commerce and other consumer-facing channels

  • Driving timelines and cross-functional execution from planning to launch

  • Coordinating stakeholders across Product, Brand Identity and B2B Communications

  • Using commercial performance and brand insights to optimize future go-to-market planning.

YOUR BENEFITS
This is a role for someone who enjoys making things happen. You'll work in a fast-moving environment where every collection presents new opportunities to improve, simplify and strengthen the way we go to market. If you're motivated by creating clarity, driving progress and seeing your work make a commercial difference, you'll find plenty of room to do so here.

YOUR PROFILE
You're at your best when bringing people, plans and commercial priorities together. You enjoy working across functions, balancing different perspectives and turning product direction into successful go-to-market activities.
Whether your background is in fashion or another consumer-focused industry, what matters to us is that you understand what it takes to create relevant consumer communication that resonates with end consumers.

In addition, we’re looking for someone who brings the following:

  • A relevant degree in Marketing, Communication or a related field

  • 4+ years of experience within DTC marketing, campaign planning or go-to-market planning

  • Experience planning and executing campaigns across multiple consumer-facing channels, including media planning and rollout.

  • Strong project management skills with experience coordinating cross-functional initiatives

  • A commercial, analytical and KPI-driven mindset, using data and insights to support decision-making.

WE LOOK FORWARD TO HEARING FROM YOU
If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Eileen Elbers at +45 52 15 40 73. Otherwise, please send us your application and CV as soon as possible and no later than 11 September 2026. We review candidates on an ongoing basis and reserve the right to take down the ad when we find the right candidate.

LOCATION: Brande, Denmark.

title: Kok til folkekære Kjærbøllingshus i Zoologisk have
description:
Bliv Kok hos Kjærbøllings Hus i Zoo – Her er Passion for Madlavning Nøglen til Succes!

Er du en passioneret kok, der elsker at arbejde med friske råvarer og skabe kulinariske oplevelser? Så er det måske dig, vi søger!

Kjærbøllings Hus, beliggende i hjertet af den zoologiske have i København, er ikke kun en restaurant, men et sted hvor kreativitet og kvalitet mødes. Vi er kendt for vores friske råvarer og vores evne til at eksperimentere i køkkenet. Vi laver mad, som vi selv elsker, og vi mener, at glæden ved madlavning smitter af på vores gæster.

Om dig:

- Du er en positiv og engageret person, der bidrager til den gode stemning i restauranten.
- Som en del af vores team, er du støttende og hjælpsom over for dine kollegaer.
- Du har erfaring som kok og en passion for at lære og vokse inden for faget.
- Du er dedikeret, nysgerrig og ansvarsbevidst – både i forhold til dine egne opgaver og hele restaurantens drift.
- Du er velorganiseret, pålidelig og altid klar til at give gæsterne en exceptionel oplevelse.

Vi tilbyder:

- En rolle, hvor du kan udfolde dine kulinariske talenter og sætte dit personlige præg på vores menu.

- Muligheder for både personlig og faglig udvikling.

- Et sjovt og dynamisk arbejdsmiljø, hvor godt samarbejde og positiv energi er i centrum.

- Konkurrencedygtig løn og fordelagtige vilkår, når du spiser på vores restauranter.

Hvorfor vælge Kjærbøllings hus?

Vi vægter et fantastisk arbejdsmiljø højt, hvor der er plads til alle, og hvor stærkt teamwork er nøglen til succes. Hos os skaber vi en atmosfære, hvor alle føler sig motiverede og inspirerede til at yde deres bedste.

Er du klar til at blive en del af vores team og være med til at skabe gastronomiske oplevelser for vores gæster? Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

title: Full-Time Caretaker / Property Maintenance Employee Wanted (vicevært)
description:
Full-Time Caretaker / Property Maintenance Employee Wanted (vicevært)

K.D.J. Byg ApS – Hanehovedvej 187, 3300 Frederiksværk

K.D.J. Byg ApS, part of the KDJ Group, is looking for an experienced and independent caretaker to handle the daily operation, upkeep and maintenance of the company’s properties.

You will play an important role in the day-to-day operation of our properties and enjoy a varied working day with both planned maintenance and practical tasks as they arise.

title: Cleaning Assistant for Industrial Kitchen – Approx. 5-8 Hours per Week
description:
Cleaning Assistant for Industrial Kitchen – Approx. 5-8 Hours per Week

Højbjerg, Aarhus | Start as soon as possible

We are looking for a thorough and reliable cleaning assistant for our professional production kitchen in Højbjerg.

We are a catering and food truck company, and our kitchen is used continuously for production and preparation for events. We are therefore looking for someone who can take care of the more thorough cleaning of the kitchen on a regular basis.

This is deep cleaning of an industrial kitchen, where hygiene, structure, and attention to detail are very important.

Main tasks

Your tasks will include:

  • Thorough cleaning of floors

  • Cleaning worktables and surfaces

  • Cleaning stainless-steel surfaces and kitchen equipment

  • Cleaning around and underneath equipment where possible

  • Cleaning shelves and storage areas

  • Cleaning refrigerators and other areas as needed

  • Cleaning sinks and dishwashing areas

  • Dishwashing when needed

  • Wiping and washing walls, tiles, and other surfaces when needed

  • Works thoroughly and pays attention to detail

  • Is reliable and punctual

  • Can work independently

  • Can notice when an area requires extra cleaning without always being instructed

  • Works systematically and efficiently

If you are interested, please send us a short message with some information about yourself, any relevant cleaning experience, your availability, and when you would be able to start. All applications need to be sent to hello@arcadiagastro.dk

title: Assistant Professors of Molecular Imaging
description:
We are looking for three highly motivated and dynamic assistant professors who can lead molecular imaging projects as part of a 3-year position to commence between November 2026 and February 2027.

Our research
Cluster for Molecular Imaging was established in 2004 by Professor Andreas Kjær to pursue translational molecular imaging research. The research is driven by unmet medical needs and includes all steps from molecule identification to evaluation in patients with a strong focus on the transfer of new methods into clinical practice. The research covers several disease areas including oncology, immune-oncology, cardiovascular diseases, and inflammatory diseases. The group has so far translated 5 PET tracers into the clinic.

Cluster for Molecular Imaging has access to all necessary facilities for molecular imaging, including preclinical and clinical imaging facilities, cyclotrons, and radiochemistry as well as laboratories for molecular biology, flow cytometry, immunohistochemistry, and a cell laboratory.

The group currently consists of 40 researchers covering a wide range of disciplines, including medicine, pharmacy, chemistry, engineering, biology, molecular biology, and physics.

Your job
You will join a multidisciplinary research team working on translational molecular imaging.

You are expected to design, execute and analyse high impact translational research related to molecular imaging. The exact project(s) to be conducted depends on the candidate’s background and experiences.

The assistant professor’s responsibilities will primarily consist of:

  • research, including publication/academic dissemination duties
  • research-based teaching
  • sharing knowledge with society
  • participation in formal pedagogical training programme for assistant professors
  • Supporting fundraising activities
Profile
Six overall criteria apply for assistant professor appointments at the University of Copenhagen. The six criteria (research, teaching, societal impact, organisational contribution, external funding, and leadership) are considered a framework for the overall assessment of candidates. Find information about each criterion here: https://employment.ku.dk/faculty/criteria-for-recognising-merit.

Furthermore, we are looking for a highly motivated and enthusiastic scientist with the following skills and experience:

Essential experience and skills:

  • You have a PhD in Molecular Imaging or an adjacent field
  • You have an active interest in translational medical research and innovation
  • You have documented pre- and postgraduate teaching experience
  • Proficient communication skills and ability to work in teams
  • Strong publication record corresponding to your career stage
  • Excellent English skills written and spoken
Desirable experience and skills:

  • Experience within areas such as oncology, immunology, infectious diseases or related biomedical fields
  • Experience working across academic, clinical, and/or industry settings
  • Interest in innovation, translational science, or implementation of research into practice
Place of employment
The place of employment is at the Department of Biomedical Sciences, Panum Institute, University of Copenhagen. We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in dynamic and international research environment.

Terms of employment
The average weekly working hours are 37 hours per week for 1 position, and 18,5 hours for 2 positions.

The position is a fixed-term position limited to a period of 3 years. The start date is in Ot

Salary, pension and other conditions of employment are set in accordance with the Agreement between the Ministry of Taxation and AC (Danish Confederation of Professional Associations) or other relevant organisation. Currently, the monthly salary starts at 40,000 DKK (November 2025 level). Depending on qualifications, a supplement may be negotiated. The employer will pay an additional 18.07 % to your pension fund.

Foreign and Danish applicants may be eligible for tax reductions if they have not lived in Denmark the last 10 years.

The position is covered by the Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities 2025.

Questions
For further information please contact Daniel Murray, daniel.murray@sund.ku.dk.

Foreign applicants may find this link useful: www.ism.ku.dk (International Staff Mobility).

Application procedure
Your application must be submitted in English by clicking ‘Apply now’ below. Furthermore, your application must include the following documents/attachments – all in PDF format:

  1. Motivated letter of application (Max. one page)
  2. CV incl. education, work/research experience, language skills and other skills relevant for the position
  3. A certified/signed copy of a) PhD certificate and b) Master of Science certificate. If the PhD is not completed, a written statement from the supervisor will do
  4. List of publications
  5. Teaching portfolio (If applicable)
Deadline for applications is 31 August 2026, 23.59 (CEST)

We reserve the right not to consider material received after the deadline, and not to consider applications that do not live up to the abovementioned requirements.

The further process
After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the hiring committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment by an unbiased assessor. Once the assessment work has been completed each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself.

You can read about the recruitment process here.

The applicant will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

Interviews are expected to be held in week 40-41.



The University of Copenhagen wish to reflect the diversity of society and encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of personal background.

title: Økonomimedarbejder / Bogholder søges til længerevarende vikariat
description:
På vegne af en af vores kunder i København søger FIRMAVIKAR en erfaren økonomimedarbejder/bogholder til et længerevarende fuldtidsvikariat med forventet opstart medio eller ultimo september 2026.

Vi søger en person, der har styr på bogholderiet, arbejder selvstændigt og er vant til at tage ansvar for den daglige økonomifunktion.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Du kommer til at arbejde bredt med virksomhedens daglige økonomi og administration. Opgaverne vil blandt andet være:

  • Løbende bogføring og kontering. Langt størstedelen af de månedlige transaktioner er faste og tilbagevendende

  • Debitor- og kreditorstyring

  • Bankafstemninger

  • Fakturering og opfølgning via Moment Flow. Project Leads opretter som udgangspunkt fakturaerne, mens du sikrer, at timer og priser er faktureret korrekt i henhold til de enkelte kontrakter

  • Håndtering og kontrol af bilag

  • Afstemning af konti

  • Moms og klargøring af materiale. Kvartalsmomsen gennemgås sammen med virksomhedens Director inden indberetning

  • Dagligt arbejde i e-conomic

  • 4-øjnes kontrol af løn via Dataløn. Administrationen indtaster som udgangspunkt lønoplysningerne, hvorefter du foretager kontrollen

  • Måneds- og kvartalsafslutning samt rapportering. Der arbejdes ud fra en fast Excel-skabelon, hvor periodiserede tal fra e-conomic overføres og efterfølgende sendes til Director

  • Klargøring af materiale til revisor i forbindelse med årsafslutning pr. 31/12. Da afstemninger foretages løbende, er denne del forholdsvis overskuelig

  • Registrering af betalinger i banken cirka én gang om ugen, typisk 10-15 betalinger. Betalingerne godkendes efterfølgende af Director

  • Back-up for virksomhedens Admin Lead samt løbende overblik over administrative opgaver

  • Øvrige administrative og økonomirelaterede opgaver efter behov

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du har erfaring fra en lignende stilling og er vant til at arbejde selvstændigt med bogholderi og økonomi.

Det er vigtigt, at du:

  • Har solid erfaring med bogholderi og økonomi

  • Har et godt og sikkert kendskab til e-conomic

  • Har erfaring med afstemninger, moms og månedsafslutning

  • Er fortrolig med Excel og kan arbejde med faste rapporteringsskabeloner

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine opgaver

  • Arbejder struktureret, grundigt og præcist

  • Er stabil og ansvarsbevidst

  • Trives med både økonomiopgaver og lettere administrative opgaver

Erfaring med Dataløn og Moment Flow er en fordel.

Praktiske oplysninger

Arbejdssted: København
Opstart: Medio eller ultimo september 2026
Periode: Frem til udgangen af juli 2027
Arbejdstid: Fuldtid

Vi tilbyder

Et længerevarende fuldtidsvikariat hos en virksomhed i København, hvor du får en selvstændig og alsidig rolle med ansvar for den daglige økonomifunktion.

Der er gode og faste arbejdsgange på plads, og du vil samtidig have løbende sparring med virksomhedens Director og øvrige administration.

Du bliver ansat gennem FIRMAVIKAR, og vi følger naturligvis op under hele vikariatet.

Interesseret?

Send dit CV og en kort ansøgning hurtigst muligt. Vi gennemgår ansøgningerne løbende og indkalder relevante kandidater til samtale.

title: Digital Content & Creative Lead
description:
Paiblock is a Fintech company that provides secure access to emerging asset classes to qualified investors, and global crypto payment processing solutions to e-commerce

We are looking for a Content & Creative Lead to join our Copenhagen team. In this role, you will take ownership of our visual content production and bring it to life across our site and channels. You will be responsible for our visual look and feel - setting direction for Paiblock and defining how content shows up everywhere our customers meet us.

This is a role for someone who combines a strong marketing understanding with hands-on content execution. You'll own visual content across our website and channels - the standard, the quality, and making sure we set and keep direction. Using the newest AI tools, you'll produce great content at scale while building automated creative workflows.

The position is full-time and based at Paiblock’s Copenhagen Office in Denmark, where you'll be part of a fast-paced, ambitious environment with a strong commercial focus. You'll also have people responsibility, managing subcontractors who support content production.

What You’ll Be Doing

As a Content & Creative Production Manager, you will own content production end-to-end - from setting creative direction to getting content live. You’ll take part in defining the visual bar for Paiblock and make sure everything we launch reflects it.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Taking ownership of overall content production and getting content live across our site and channels - email, socials, creative ads, etc.

  • Using the newest AI tools to execute and produce content at scale

  • Owning the delivery of content packages for new products

  • Setting visual and direction for Paiblock

  • Defining how we use our content on our site

  • Building and setting up automated creative workflows

  • Managing and coordinating subcontractors who support content production

  • Pushing our site and channels to the next level in look and feel

  • And so much more

The Ideal Profile

This role is ideal for someone who is tech-driven and knows all about the newest AI content production tools, with a background in content, creative, or marketing roles, preferably within blockchain or digital lifestyle company.

We imagine that you:

  • Have a strong sense of visual direction, and what good looks like

  • Have a marketing understanding

  • Have strongly adopted AI and use the newest tools to execute and produce content

  • Know how to set up automated creative workflows to scale content production

  • Have experience setting visual direction and look and feel across channels

  • Are fluent in English, written and spoken

You are someone who:

  • Is motivated by ownership and accountability

  • Is ambitious, takes initiative and turns opportunities into clear, structured actions. And executes them.

  • Is creative and obsessive about quality and detail

  • Thrives in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

  • Enjoys working cross-functionally and building strong internal relationships

What We Offer

Our people are at the core of our success, and we work in an environment that values ownership, development, and collaboration - where your contributions make a real impact.

  • A full-time, on-site position at our Copenhagen office in Denmark

  • A role with ownership of our content production and visual direction, with direct impact on how Paiblock shows up everywhere

  • Strong opportunities for professional and personal development

  • A social, dynamic, and ambitious workplace culture

  • Hands-on responsibility for setting the creative bar and producing content with the newest AI tools

  • Close collaboration with experienced colleagues

  • A modern, data- and tech-driven workplace where AI and new tools are actively applied

title: Business Intelligence Student Assistant

Build your future with us
