title: Senior Lead Project Manager for IT Technology project
description:
Are you a very experienced Project Manager with a passion for driving big and complex projects involving software development together with a big global vendor? Do you enjoy leading highly skilled teams in a dynamic and international environment? Then you may be our new Senior Lead Project Manager.

Nordic RCC – supporting security of supply and the green energy transition

Nordic Regional Coordination Centre (RCC) provides critical services and insights to support the national Transmission System Operators (TSOs) in Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark — to ensure the efficient operation and use of the Nordic power system and high security of power supply at any time. Join Nordic RCC and contribute to ensuring a secure and sustainable energy in the future.

Job description

Nordic RCC seeks a skilled and experienced Project Manager to drive an IT project with many internal and external stakeholders, several deliverables and milestones, delivered within agreed go-live dates.

You will be responsible for coordinating all aspects of the project as scoping, planning, execution and delivery. Working closely together with a big global vendor and senior stakeholders across Nordic RCC, you will ensure seamless collaboration and a transparent strong approach to project management.

You will guide the project team incl. project managers through strong project risk management and planning, dependencies to other projects, financial control, stakeholder alignment, and progress monitoring in close collaboration with the internal and external Steercos, ensuring alignment with Nordic RCC’s goals.

Your primary tasks and areas of responsibility:

  • Facilitate a strong collaboration and communication among program/project stakeholders from the different departments in the organization, the vendor's project organisation and the internal/external Steercos

  • In control of budget, forecast and monthly financial updates, incl. alignment with financial milestones from vendor

  • In control of project scope, resource needs according to project plan, manage project risks continuously through the project lifetime in close collaboration with vendor, internal project managers and the Steercos

  • In control of develop, coordinate, communicate and execute project plans with clear milestones and deadlines, ensuring to deliver all milestones on time in close collaboration with both vendor and Nordic RCC

  • Monitor program/project progress, assess performance, and report outcomes to key stakeholders/Steercos by monthly meetings and reporting to Leadership team in Nordic RCC

  • Lead a strong transition from each go-live to operational phase, ensuring an organized handover to line organization for the different deliverables

  • Use best practices and processes, e.g. Stage Gate Model, Governance model, Resource management, Project Risk Management etc. to provide the optimal guidance to cross-functional project teams throughout the project lifecycle with focus on balancing quality, efficiency, deliver on time and financials

Required skills and experience

The ideal candidate holds a BA or MA in IT with strong project or program management experience working with software development in an IT project in collaboration with a big global vendor.

Key skills include:

  • Strong drive and passion for project management, ensuring the project teams deliver on time in expected quality/scope and in control of finance

  • Strong organizational, planning and time management skills

  • Proven track record in managing senior stakeholder expectations and leading cross-functional teams in collaboration with an IT vendor

  • Experience in communicating both big-picture objectives and project details, ensuring all project managers/team members understand their roles and contributions

  • Demonstrated ability to identify challenges early and proactively drive deliverables in collaboration with vendor and project teams

  • At least 10 years of relevant experience in IT project management with a global vendor

  • Relevant project management certificates and e.g., relevant change management certificates

  • Full professional proficiency in English

Employment conditions

You will join a company of competent, diverse, and enthusiastic colleagues. We are currently more than 24 nationalities with more than 30% women (striving to improve this balance) and all ages.

 Your daily workplace will be in our newly furnished office premises in Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad. We are offering workplace flexibility to ensure a healthy work-life balance including the possibility for working from home some of your worktime. 

Our values of fellowship, curiosity, respect, and transparency have been defined by all employees. They identify how we behave and shape the way we work together, and we expect you to see yourself in them.

The position is conditioned upon a satisfactory background check as well as a national security clearance, both of which will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note, that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined. 

Application deadline and contact information

Please apply online as soon as possible (in English) on https://www.globesearch.dk/jobs/8221470 . We may conduct interviews on a continuous basis.

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system. 

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.

title: Salgschaffør
description:

Lørdag 08:00 til 15:00

- 2-3 vagter om ugen, hvor den ene vagt er hver anden lørdag.

Sjógæti Aps har været i Næstved i 2 år. Vi har vores eget røgeri, al vores fisk er frisk og leveres hver morgen. Kvalitet er nøgleordet for vores service og vores produkter.

Vi tilbyder et behageligt, uformelt og familiært arbejdsmiljø.

title: Meningsfyldt afløser job i hjemmeplejen.
description:
Vil du være med til at skabe nærvær og gøre en forskel for mennesker som omsorgsmedarbejder til hjemmeplejen i Aalborg?

Så har vi et spændende job til dig. Frit Valg Svane Pleje søger lige nu afløsere til at arbejde dag og aften – og weekender i vores afdeling i Nørresundby.

Vi søger afløsere, der gerne vil udvikle sig personligt og fagligt i relationen med mennesker og yde den bedste pleje til vores borgere. Vi tilbyder en timelønnet stilling med rig mulighed for indflydelse på egne arbejdstider og med mulighed for et længerevarende vikariat.

Arbejdet består primært af at hjælpe vores borgere i deres bolig med personlig pleje og bistand, samt praktisk hjælp.

Vil du med på holdet?

Vi søger dig, der er interesseret i at arbejde med pleje af borgere i eget hjem, og som gennem en helhjertet indsats vil gøre en stor forskel for borgernes hverdag og trivsel. Du skal minimum være 18 år og have kørekort B, da vores ruter primært er bil ruter. Derudover har vi også enkelte elcykelruter, som du også skal være villig til at køre på.

 

Vi forestiller os, at:

·        Du har erfaring med personlig pleje og praktisk hjælp eller er villig til at lære.

·        Du er fleksibel og mødestabil.

·        Du er et empatisk menneske, der kan skabe tryghed gennem nærvær og dialog.

·        Du er i stand til at arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig være en del af et team.

Vi kan tilbyde:

·        En stilling på mellem 8 til 32 timer, hvor der er mulighed for længerevarende vikariater.

·        Et grundigt introduktionsforløb, hvor du kører sammen med en kollega den første tid.

·        En arbejdsplads hvor der er stor frihed under ansvar.

·        Store muligheder for personlig og faglig udvikling.

Sammen skaber vi gode rammer for din ansættelse
Dit primære arbejdssted er i Nørresundby, hvor du møder ind og starter din rute. På adressen er der mulighed for at låne en af vores firmabiler, som står til rådighed.

Ansøgning og ansættelsesforhold
Vi ønsker stillingen besat hurtigst muligt, vi afholder samteler løbende.

Hvis du har spørgsmål eller ønsker stillingsopslaget uddybet, er du velkommen til at kontakte daglig leder Jannike Frølund på +45 41 40 20 10 eller på e-mailadressen aalborg@svanepleje.dk.

Lønnen starter på 161,72,- i timen og ansættelsesforhold er i henhol til vores overenskomst med dansk erhverv og FOA

title: JP Dynasty ApS søger en Group Kitchen Manager
description:
JP Dynasty ApS er en asiatisk restaurantgruppe med base i København og driver flere brands og restauranter.

I takt med at koncernen fortsætter med at vokse, søger vi en erfaren Group Kitchen Manager / køkkenchef med ansvar for flere restauranter, som kan sikre en ensartet og effektiv køkkendrift på tværs af vores lokationer.

Primære arbejdsopgaver

  • Overordnet ansvar for den daglige køkkendrift på tværs af flere restauranter

  • Regelmæssige besøg og kontrol af køkkenerne for at sikre ensartet kvalitet, hastighed, hygiejne og driftsstandard

  • Udarbejde, forbedre og implementere SOP'er og standardiserede arbejdsprocedurer

  • Lede, træne og støtte Kitchen Managers og køkkenteams

  • Sikre overholdelse af fødevaresikkerhed, hygiejne og HACCP

  • Kontrollere vareforbrug, lønomkostninger, madspild og køkkeneffektivitet

  • Overvåge lager, varebestilling, lageroptælling, FIFO og råvareforbrug

  • Anvende lager- og managementsystemer til at identificere driftsmæssige og økonomiske problemer

  • Koordinere tæt med centralkøkken, indkøb, restaurantchefer og administration

  • Ansvar for implementering af nye retter fra test og standardisering til lancering i restauranterne

  • Tilpasse produktion, forberedelse og bemanding efter omsætning og driftsbehov

  • Håndtere akutte driftsproblemer og udvikle langsigtede løsninger

  • Deltage i åbning af nye restauranter, herunder køkkenopsætning, arbejdsprocesser og medarbejdertræning

  • Rapportere regelmæssigt til ledelsen om køkkendrift, problemer og forbedringstiltag

Vi forventer, at du

  • Kan kinesisk og engelsk flydende, både mundtligt og skriftligt

  • Har erfaring med køkkenledelse fra en restaurantkæde, flere restauranter eller centralkøkken

  • Har erfaring med ledelse af Kitchen Managers, kokke og køkkenmedarbejdere

  • Kan tage selvstændigt ansvar for flere restauranter og ikke kun ét køkken

  • Har solidt kendskab til fødevaresikkerhed, køkkenhygiejne og HACCP

  • Har erfaring med kontrol af food cost, lager, madspild og løneffektivitet

  • Kan anvende Microsoft Office, Google Workspace eller tilsvarende kontorsoftware

  • Kan arbejde med lagerstyrings-, indkøbs- eller restaurantmanagementsystemer

  • Har god talforståelse og kan identificere problemer gennem rapporter og data

  • Har erfaring med at udarbejde og implementere SOP'er

  • Har stærke ledelses-, kommunikations- og træningsevner

  • Kan håndtere flere driftsmæssige udfordringer samtidigt i et travlt miljø

  • Er ansvarlig, proaktiv og løsningsorienteret

  • Kan arbejde i weekender og har fleksible arbejdstider efter restaurantdriftens behov

Det er en fordel, hvis du har

  • Erfaring fra asiatiske restauranter, japansk eller kinesisk køkken eller fast-casual-kæder

  • Erfaring fra centralkøkken eller fødevareproduktion

  • Erfaring med åbning af nye restauranter

  • Erfaring med menuudvikling og standardisering af produkter

  • Erfaring fra en restaurantgruppe med flere brands

  • Kendskab til danske regler om fødevaresikkerhed og restaurationsdrift

  • Tidligere erfaring fra restaurationsbranchen i Danmark

Vi tilbyder

  • En central lederstilling i en voksende asiatisk restaurantgruppe i København

  • Ansvar på tværs af flere brands og restauranter

  • Stor indflydelse på den daglige drift og gode udviklingsmuligheder

  • Mulighed for at deltage i nye restaurantåbninger, produktudvikling og udvikling af centralkøkken

  • Løn efter erfaring og kvalifikationer

Arbejdssted: København, med regelmæssigt arbejde på tværs af vores restauranter
Virksomhed: JP Dynasty ApS
Stilling: Group Kitchen Manager / Køkkenchef med ansvar for flere restauranter
Ansættelse: Fuldtid

JP Dynasty ApS is Hiring: Group Kitchen Manager

JP Dynasty ApS is a Copenhagen-based Asian restaurant group operating multiple brands and locations.

As our group continues to grow, we are looking for an experienced Group Kitchen Manager / Multi-Unit Kitchen Manager to oversee kitchen operations across several locations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee daily kitchen operations across multiple restaurant locations

  • Conduct regular kitchen inspections to ensure consistent food quality, speed, hygiene, and operational standards

  • Develop, improve, and implement kitchen SOPs

  • Manage, train, and support Kitchen Managers and kitchen teams

  • Ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, and HACCP requirements

  • Monitor and control food costs, labour costs, waste, and kitchen efficiency

  • Supervise inventory, ordering, stock counts, FIFO, and raw material usage

  • Use inventory and management systems to identify operational and cost issues

  • Coordinate closely with central kitchen, purchasing, restaurant managers, and the office team

  • Manage implementation of new dishes from testing and standardisation to launch across all locations

  • Adjust production levels, preparation, and staffing based on sales and operational needs

  • Handle urgent operational issues and develop long-term solutions

  • Support new restaurant openings, including kitchen setup, workflows, and staff training

  • Provide regular reports to management on kitchen performance, issues, and improvement plans

Requirements

  • Fluent Chinese and English, both spoken and written

  • Previous experience managing kitchens in a restaurant chain, multi-unit restaurant group, or central kitchen operation

  • Experience managing Kitchen Managers, chefs, and kitchen teams

  • Ability to manage several locations independently, rather than only one kitchen

  • Strong knowledge of food safety, kitchen hygiene, and HACCP

  • Experience with food cost control, inventory management, waste reduction, and labour efficiency

  • Comfortable using Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, or similar office software

  • Able to use inventory, purchasing, or restaurant management software

  • Strong analytical skills and ability to identify operational problems through reports and data

  • Experience creating and implementing SOPs

  • Strong leadership, communication, and staff-training skills

  • Able to handle multiple operational issues in a fast-paced environment

  • Responsible, proactive, and highly execution-focused

  • Able to work weekends and maintain a flexible schedule according to operational needs

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in Asian restaurants, Japanese cuisine, Chinese cuisine, or fast-casual restaurant chains

  • Central kitchen or food production experience

  • New restaurant opening experience

  • Menu development and product standardisation experience

  • Experience working in a multi-brand restaurant group

  • Knowledge of Danish food safety and restaurant regulations

  • Previous restaurant industry experience in Denmark

We Offer

  • A key management position in a growing Asian restaurant group in Copenhagen

  • Responsibility across multiple brands and restaurant locations

  • Significant operational responsibility and development opportunities

  • Opportunity to participate in new restaurant openings, product development, and central kitchen development

  • Salary based on experience and qualifications

Location: Copenhagen, with regular travel between our restaurant locations
Company: JP Dynasty ApS
Position: Group Kitchen Manager / Multi-Unit Kitchen Manager
Employment: Full-time

  • Klargøring og installering af arbejdsstationer og bærbare computere med Windows 11.

  • Printeropsætning og generel printerassistance.

  • Udarbejdelse af korte manualer samt opdatering af videndokumentation til vores online IT-hjørne.

  • Indrapportering og opfølgning på sager hos vores IT-driftspartner Supporters A/S.

  • Oprettelse og nedlæggelse af brugere i samarbejde med Supporters A/S.

  • Support i vores Microsoft-miljø med fokus på Outlook. Vi kører AVD - kendskab til Azure er et plus, men ikke et krav.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er i gang med en uddannelse.

  • Er udadvendt, flink og har et stærkt service- og support-gen.

  • Taler og skriver dansk. Engelsk er en fordel i vores internationale miljø.

  • Er positiv, løsningsorienteret og klar til at klare alle udfordringer.

  • Er en meget hjælpsom og kompetent kollega med godt humør.

  • Er selvkørende og tager eget initiativ.

Vi tilbyder:

  • Arbejdstid 6 timer om ugen (evt. lidt mere efter behov) og gerne fordelt på 2 formiddage eller eftermiddage.

  • Arbejdsdage kan justeres løbende så det passer ind i dit studie.

  • Kaffe/te og frugt.

  • Arbejdsplads centralt i Frichsparken.

title: Senior Lead Project Manager for IT Technology project
description:
Are you a very experienced Project Manager with a passion for driving big and complex projects involving software development together with a big global vendor? Do you enjoy leading highly skilled teams in a dynamic and international environment? Then you may be our new Senior Lead Project Manager.

Nordic RCC – supporting security of supply and the green energy transition

Nordic Regional Coordination Centre (RCC) provides critical services and insights to support the national Transmission System Operators (TSOs) in Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark — to ensure the efficient operation and use of the Nordic power system and high security of power supply at any time. Join Nordic RCC and contribute to ensuring a secure and sustainable energy in the future.

Job description

Nordic RCC seeks a skilled and experienced Project Manager to drive an IT project with many internal and external stakeholders, several deliverables and milestones, delivered within agreed go-live dates.

You will be responsible for coordinating all aspects of the project as scoping, planning, execution and delivery. Working closely together with a big global vendor and senior stakeholders across Nordic RCC, you will ensure seamless collaboration and a transparent strong approach to project management.

You will guide the project team incl. project managers through strong project risk management and planning, dependencies to other projects, financial control, stakeholder alignment, and progress monitoring in close collaboration with the internal and external Steercos, ensuring alignment with Nordic RCC’s goals.

Your primary tasks and areas of responsibility:

  • Facilitate a strong collaboration and communication among program/project stakeholders from the different departments in the organization, the vendor's project organisation and the internal/external Steercos

  • In control of budget, forecast and monthly financial updates, incl. alignment with financial milestones from vendor

  • In control of project scope, resource needs according to project plan, manage project risks continuously through the project lifetime in close collaboration with vendor, internal project managers and the Steercos

  • In control of develop, coordinate, communicate and execute project plans with clear milestones and deadlines, ensuring to deliver all milestones on time in close collaboration with both vendor and Nordic RCC

  • Monitor program/project progress, assess performance, and report outcomes to key stakeholders/Steercos by monthly meetings and reporting to Leadership team in Nordic RCC

  • Lead a strong transition from each go-live to operational phase, ensuring an organized handover to line organization for the different deliverables

  • Use best practices and processes, e.g. Stage Gate Model, Governance model, Resource management, Project Risk Management etc. to provide the optimal guidance to cross-functional project teams throughout the project lifecycle with focus on balancing quality, efficiency, deliver on time and financials

Required skills and experience

The ideal candidate holds a BA or MA in IT with strong project or program management experience working with software development in an IT project in collaboration with a big global vendor.

Key skills include:

  • Strong drive and passion for project management, ensuring the project teams deliver on time in expected quality/scope and in control of finance

  • Strong organizational, planning and time management skills

  • Proven track record in managing senior stakeholder expectations and leading cross-functional teams in collaboration with an IT vendor

  • Experience in communicating both big-picture objectives and project details, ensuring all project managers/team members understand their roles and contributions

  • Demonstrated ability to identify challenges early and proactively drive deliverables in collaboration with vendor and project teams

  • At least 10 years of relevant experience in IT project management with a global vendor

  • Relevant project management certificates and e.g., relevant change management certificates

  • Full professional proficiency in English

Employment conditions

You will join a company of competent, diverse, and enthusiastic colleagues. We are currently more than 24 nationalities with more than 30% women (striving to improve this balance) and all ages.

 Your daily workplace will be in our newly furnished office premises in Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad. We are offering workplace flexibility to ensure a healthy work-life balance including the possibility for working from home some of your worktime. 

Our values of fellowship, curiosity, respect, and transparency have been defined by all employees. They identify how we behave and shape the way we work together, and we expect you to see yourself in them.

The position is conditioned upon a satisfactory background check as well as a national security clearance, both of which will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note, that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined. 

Application deadline and contact information

Please apply online as soon as possible (in English) on https://www.globesearch.dk/jobs/8221470 . We may conduct interviews on a continuous basis.

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system. 

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.

title: Research Assistant in Regenerative Medicine
description:
A position as a full-time research assistant is vacant in the lab of Dr. Srustidhar Das, at the Department of Clinical Research and at the Research Unit of Inflammation Research, Department of Molecular Medicine, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. 

The position is limited to one year with the possibility of extension and/or continuing further as a PhD student, subject to funding and fulfilment of SDU's PhD admission requirements.

Job description

The position primarily consists of research within tissue regeneration, epithelial biology and inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), with limited research-based teaching or supervision activities where relevant. The research assistant will join a translational research programme that aims to understand how inflammation reshapes the intestinal epithelium and its surrounding tissue niche, and how these changes can be therapeutically targeted to restore safe and durable mucosal healing.

The position will suit a highly motivated candidate with a strong interest in mucosal biology, epithelial regeneration, organoid models, immune-stromal-epithelial interactions, single-cell and spatial technologies, and clinically oriented biomedical research. The successful candidate will work at the interface of experimental biology, translational medicine and omics-based research.

Research environment

The research assistant will be embedded in a dynamic and highly collaborative research environment spanning the Institute for Molecular Medicine and the Department of Clinical Research at SDU. The project benefits from close interactions among basic scientists, clinicians, bioinformaticians and translational researchers, with strong links to Odense University Hospital and access to patient-derived material, advanced disease models and state-of-the-art molecular technologies.

The environment provides excellent opportunities to develop practical and analytical skills in experimental and translational biomedicine, contribute to clinically relevant discoveries in IBD and tissue regeneration, and prepare for a potential subsequent PhD project.

Research project

The project investigates how prior inflammation leaves a lasting memory in the intestinal epithelium and its surrounding tissue niche, and how this memory affects mucosal healing in IBD. The research assistant will help establish and apply experimental models based on patient-derived intestinal biopsies, organoids, fibroblasts and immune-cell co-cultures to study epithelial regeneration in health and disease.

The work will also support the generation and functional validation of findings from single-cell and spatial approaches, including single-cell RNA sequencing, single-cell chromatin accessibility analysis, spatial transcriptomics and spatial epigenomics. Depending on experience and project needs, the research assistant may contribute to CRISPR-based genetic engineering of patient-derived organoids.

Key responsibilities

  • Establish, maintain and experimentally manipulate patient-derived intestinal organoids and relevant co-culture systems involving fibroblasts and immune cells.

  • Design and perform functional assays to assess epithelial regeneration, inflammatory responses, barrier function and cell-state plasticity.

  • Apply molecular and cellular methods such as qPCR, immunostaining, microscopy, flow cytometry, ELISA-based assays and related techniques.

  • Support sample preparation and experimental workflows for single-cell and spatial transcriptomic or epigenomic studies.

  • Contribute to CRISPR-based genetic engineering and functional validation of candidate pathways, depending on prior experience.

  • Work with patient-derived material in close collaboration with clinicians, bioinformaticians and translational researchers.

  • Maintain accurate experimental records, analyse and document results, and contribute to protocol development and optimisation.

  • Present results at group meetings and contribute to scientific reports, manuscripts, conferences, teaching and collaborative activities where relevant.

Expectations of qualifications 

The applicant is expected to hold a relevant master's degree or equivalent qualification in molecular biology, biomedicine, immunology, cell biology, biotechnology, medicine, bioinformatics or a closely related discipline.

Essential qualifications

  • A strong interest in mucosal biology, tissue regeneration, epithelial biology, inflammatory disease and translational biomedical research.

  • Hands-on experience with mammalian cell culture, molecular biology, primary cells, organoids, immunology, epithelial biology, inflammation research or related experimental systems.

  • Strong written and spoken English communication skills.

  • A structured, curious and technically careful working style, with the ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.

  • Good organisational skills and a commitment to reproducible research, careful documentation and responsible handling of research data and biological material.

Desirable qualifications

  • Experience with intestinal organoids, patient-derived material, immune-cell culture, fibroblast culture or epithelial-stromal-immune co-culture models.

  • Familiarity with qPCR, immunostaining, confocal or advanced microscopy, flow cytometry, ELISA or MSD assays, and CRISPR-based genetic engineering.

  • Experience with, or a strong interest in learning, single-cell RNA sequencing, ATAC-seq, spatial transcriptomics, spatial epigenomics or computational analysis of omics datasets.

  • Interest in developing and optimising experimental models that connect mechanistic biology with clinically relevant questions in IBD and mucosal healing.

  • Previous experience with bioinformatics, statistics or image analysis will be considered an advantage but is not essential.

Research strategy for OUH and the Department of Clinical Research

The joint research strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital sets the direction for our shared research efforts in the years ahead. Rooted in the vision –We conduct research together to shape the patient care of the future – it focuses in particular on: cross-disciplinary research – with people at the centre; strong research environments – as drivers of development; and the research journey – from idea to impact. Further information on the joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital is available here.

Srustidhar Das

University of Southern Denmark (SDU)

title: Mechanical Supervisor
description:
Join a project that’s not just exciting—it’s world-changing! We’re looking for talented individuals to be part of something truly remarkable. If you’re driven by challenge and the chance to make a lasting impact, this is the perfect place for you. Don’t just be a part of the future—help create it.

About FLC:

At Femern Link Contractors (FLC), we are responsible for designing and constructing the immersed tunnel, portals and ramps on both ends of the tunnel, in Rødbyhavn and Puttgarden.

We are also building the facilities for prefabricating tunnel elements as well as accommodation facilities, also known as the “Tunnel village” in Rødbyhavn, which provides housing for FLC workers.

About the department:

The TE systems are part of the scope of the Marine team as temporary measures to facilitate the immersion of the elements. In total, 79 standard (220m long, 9m high, 45m wide) and 10 special elements (38m long, 12,5m high, 50m wide) will connect the Femern Belt Tunnel to both Germany and Denmark.

To be able to float up, transport and immerse the Tunnel Elements, the elements require temporary installations. These installations ensure that the elements float, stay balanced, immerse and can connect to the preceding element. A team of mechanics and electricians will install and test these installations.

Main tasks and responsibilities:

Execute the TE systems works whilst coordinating closely and effectively with the involved (internal) stakeholders to optimize efficiency.

Plan, execute and register maintenance & repairs to the TE systems equipment:

o Pumps / Piping / Valves

o Electrical components

o Subsea sensors

o Hydraulic cylinders / Powerpacks / manifolds

o Umbilical winches / Sliprings

o Rolling equipment

Thereby ensuring operational equipment in compliance with legislative-, safety- and user requirements.

You will lead the team of technicians installing, maintaining and repairing the Tunnel Elements systems during the preparation, transport and installation phase of Tunnel Elements. Understand the functionality of the Tunnel Element systems. Troubleshoot system during installation and operation. Maintain and organize the work area (workshop and yard facilities) to ensure an orderly and safe workplace in compliance with Danish regulation, company procedures, and good work practice. Set up, select and support the TE systems team of technicians to ensure effective and reliable production cycle.

In the role of the Mechanical Supervisor, there will be interface with subcontractors, Operational departments of various disciplines and operations staff.

Qualifications:

The TE systems Mechanical Supervisor:

- Has the ability to read and understand technical drawings, working methods and working procedures.

- Plans the work ahead.

- Manages daily interface with other TE outfitting parties.

- Communicates in English (minimum B2 level) both written and spoken.

- Optimizes the usage of the TE systems team capabilities.

- Supports and coaches the TE systems technicians.

- Has excellent interpersonal skills

- Organizes daily toolbox / pre-start meetings.

- Connects the tasks to the bigger picture.

- Provides support and input on risk assessments for TE mobilization / demobilization, general tasks.

Conditions: 

FLC considers transparent management structures, short decision-making channels, and a team-oriented environment to be extremely important. The FLC staff is expected to set themselves targets, achieve them independently, and take responsibility for their actions – irrespective of their position in the company. 

FLC offers attractive employment conditions on a Danish contract according to The Danish Salaried Employees Act (Funktionærloven). Pension health insurance and lunch arrangement will be available.

Rødbyhavn Denmark

We look forward to receiving your application (in English) as soon as possible. Applications received will be processed on an ongoing basis, and we will complete the recruitment once we have found the right profile.

title: Positioning Specialist - Immersion Pontoon
description:
Join a project that’s not just exciting—it’s world-changing! We’re looking for talented individuals to be part of something truly remarkable. If you’re driven by challengeand the chance to make a lasting impact, this is the perfect place for you. Don’t just be a part of the future—help create it.

About FLC:

At Femern Link Contractors (FLC), we are responsible for designing and constructing the immersed tunnel, portals and ramps on both ends of the tunnel, in Rødbyhavn and Puttgarden.

We are also building the facilities for prefabricating tunnel elements as well as accommodation facilities, also known as the “Tunnel village” in Rødbyhavn, which provides housing for FLC workers.

About the department:

The FLC Survey Department plays a key role in supporting the construction of this immersed tunnel project. The marine survey team delivers positioning, navigation, monitoring, and hydrographic survey services for offshore construction activities using advanced technologies such as multibeam echo sounders, Inertial Navigation systems, LBL and USBL systems, Fibre Optic Gyroscopes and many more. Together with over 60 hydrographic and topographic survey professionals from more than 15 countries, the department ensures accurate survey data for all project phases. The topographic survey teams support construction through stake-out, control, and as-built surveys, utilizing state-of-the-art equipment including Total Stations, GNSS, drones, laser scanners, and specialist software for planning, execution, and data processing.

Within the marine survey team, the Positioning Specialists play a key role in the immersion of tunnel elements. They install, configure and operate advanced positioning systems, combining GNSS, INS, LBL, tautwire, and distance sensor technologies to ensure the precise placement of tunnel elements.

Main tasks and responsibilities:

Prepare positioning systems for (re-)installation operations by performing maintenance, calibration, and configuration of the hard- and software.

Configure positioning software in preparation for positioning operations, such as Qinsy, Delph SP and Delph INS and project specific software.

Operate and monitor the positioning systems during tunnel element installation operations, such as GNSS (Septentrio), INS (Exail), LBL (Exail), SVP (AML) and a project specific Light Tautwire and Distance Sensor system.

Remote or on-board troubleshooting of positioning system issues.

Analyse positioning data of tunnel installation process.

Write installation-, configuration- and commissioning reports for positioning systems.

Create reports for ‘as-installed’ and ‘as-configured’ survey set-ups.

Create ‘as-installed’ reports for installed tunnel elements

Cooperate with the operational team to schedule installation and removal of survey systems.

Cooperate with pontoon and vessel crews during remote- or on-board troubleshooting.

Concise communication with the immersion master during installation of the tunnel elements.

Qualifications:

Degree, diploma, or equivalent professional experience in Hydrographic Surveying, Geomatics or Geodesy, Survey Engineering, Offshore Engineering, Marine Technology, Navigation, Positioning, or a related technical discipline

Minimum 5 years of experience with surface and/or subsea positioning systems.

Proven experience configuring, maintaining, and operating marine positioning systems during offshore operations.

Experience with working with Qinsy survey software.

Experience with USBL and/or LBL positioning systems.

Ability to configure, calibrate, and troubleshoot complex positioning systems.

Strong capability in quality control, analysis, and interpretation of positioning data.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Able to remain calm and make sound decisions during critical offshore operations.

Strong verbal and written communication skills, particularly when coordinating with immersion masters, vessel crews, engineers, and survey teams.

You will become part of our kitchen team and work closely with the kitchen management and other employees to ensure efficient daily operations, consistent quality and a high standard of food preparation.

The position is full-time and includes both preparation and cooking duties. We are looking for a reliable and professional employee who can work independently, cooperate with colleagues and contribute positively to the development of our kitchen.

  • Preparing and cooking authentic Thai and Asian dishes according to the restaurant’s recipes and quality standards.

  • Ensuring consistent taste, quality, portion sizes and presentation.

  • Maintaining a clean, organised and efficient kitchen station.

  • Assisting with daily preparation and service in both smaller and larger kitchen operations.

  • Following instructions from kitchen management regarding production, preparation and daily priorities.

  • Monitoring stock levels and informing management when ingredients need to be ordered.

  • Receiving, checking and correctly storing food deliveries.

  • Ensuring proper labelling, date marking, storage and rotation of ingredients.

  • Following all hygiene, HACCP, food safety and workplace safety procedures.

  • Cleaning kitchen equipment, utensils and work areas.

title: Rengøringsleder til Renseri
description:
Vi søger en engageret og struktureret Rengøringsleder til vores renseri hos Renserierne.DK ApS, ,Vester Farimagsgade 3 , 1606 København V

Som Rengøringsleder får du en central rolle i den daglige drift, hvor du sikrer, at arbejdsopgaver planlægges, koordineres og udføres effektivt. Du bliver bindeled mellem virksomhedens ejer og medarbejderne og bidrager til en høj kvalitet i både driften og kundeservicen.

Stillingen er en driftskoordinerende funktion uden personale- eller HR-ansvar. Du har ikke ansvar for ansættelser eller afskedigelser, men du har ansvar for at sikre en effektiv daglig drift, høj service og et godt samarbejde mellem medarbejderne.

Ansættelsen forudsætter, at du til enhver tid har gyldig arbejdstilladelse, hvis dette kræves.

Arbejdsopgaver

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være at:

  • Overvåge og koordinere virksomhedens daglige driftsaktiviteter for at sikre en smidig og effektiv arbejdsgang.

  • Koordinere medarbejdernes arbejdsplaner og sikre tilstrækkelig bemanding i forhold til den daglige drift og kundernes behov.

  • Vejlede og støtte medarbejderne i det daglige arbejde for at sikre høj kvalitet og effektiv kundeservice.

  • Modtage og betjene kunder, besvare henvendelser samt modtage servicebestillinger.

  • Håndtere kundefeedback og klager professionelt og sikre hurtig opfølgning.

  • Sikre en effektiv kommunikation mellem medarbejderne og virksomhedens ejer om den daglige drift.

  • Overvåge virksomhedens kundeservice og den samlede driftseffektivitet.

  • Følge kundetilfredsheden og komme med forslag til forbedringer af kundeoplevelsen.

  • Identificere daglige driftsmæssige udfordringer og foreslå praktiske løsninger, der styrker den operationelle effektivitet.

  • Bidrage med idéer til salgsfremmende aktiviteter og forretningsudvikling med henblik på at tiltrække nye kunder og understøtte virksomhedens vækst.

  • Sikre, at de daglige arbejdsopgaver udføres rettidigt og bidrage til et organiseret, sikkert og effektivt arbejdsmiljø.

  • Repræsentere virksomheden professionelt i kontakten med kunder.

Vi forventer, at du

  • Har erfaring fra renseri, vaskeri, rengøringsbranchen eller en anden servicevirksomhed.

  • Er struktureret og god til at koordinere den daglige drift.

  • Har stærke samarbejds- og kommunikationsevner.

  • Er serviceminded og sætter en ære i at levere en høj kundeservice.

  • Er løsningsorienteret og arbejder selvstændigt.

  • Kan bevare overblikket i en travl hverdag og sikre, at opgaver bliver løst effektivt.

Vi tilbyder

  • En spændende og alsidig stilling med ansvar for den daglige drift.

  • Mulighed for at bidrage til udviklingen af virksomhedens arbejdsgange og kundeoplevelse.

  • Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med korte beslutningsveje.

  • Et tæt samarbejde med virksomhedens ejer.

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer.

Ansøgning

Send din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt til vores kontaktperson, da vi akut har brug for en medarbejder i teamet.

  • Identify operational challenges and recommend practical solutions to improve efficiency.

  • Ensure daily tasks are completed on time while maintaining a well-organised and efficient working environment.

  • Represent the company professionally in all customer interactions.

Qualifications

  • Has experience in a dry-cleaning, laundry, cleaning or similar service business.

  • Is organised and capable of coordinating daily operations.

  • Has strong communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Is customer-focused and committed to delivering excellent service.

  • Is proactive, reliable and solution-oriented.

  • Can work independently while maintaining an overview in a busy working environment.

We Offer

  • A varied and responsible position with a key role in daily operations.

  • The opportunity to contribute to improving operational processes and customer satisfaction.

  • A friendly working environment with short decision-making processes.

  • Close collaboration with the business owner.

title: Rzeźnik - Rozbiór Łopatki Wieprzowej / Experienced Butchers – Shoulder Deboning
description:
Pracuj w Danii jako rzeźnik – atrakcyjne wynagrodzenie, elastyczność i stabilne warunki pracy. Danish Crown to jedna z największych firm spożywczych w Europie. Oferujemy stabilne warunki zatrudnienia i pracę w międzynarodowym środowisku.

Opis stanowiska


  • Wykonywanie rozbioru łopatki wieprzowej zgodnie z obowiązującymi standardami jakości i wydajności.




  • Precyzyjna praca nożem na linii produkcyjnej, z dbałością o detale.




  • Monitorowanie i utrzymywanie wysokiej jakości cięcia oraz efektywności pracy.




  • Ścisłe przestrzeganie zasad higieny i bezpieczeństwa pracy na każdym etapie produkcji



Wymagania


  • Ugruntowane doświadczenie w rozbiorze mięsa, najlepiej w pracy z łopatką wieprzową lub przodami.




  • Doskonała umiejętność sprawnego i precyzyjnego posługiwania się nożem.




  • Udokumentowane doświadczenie w pracy na ubojni lub w zakładzie mięsnym.




  • Zdolność do efektywnej i samodzielnej pracy w tempie produkcyjnym od pierwszego dnia.




  • Sprawność fizyczna oraz odpowiedzialność w wykonywaniu powierzonych zadań.



Oferujemy


  • Atrakcyjne wynagrodzenie godzinowe z dodatkami, 176 dkk + 12,20% czyli 197,58 dkk z możliwością wzrostu po przejściu na system akordowy.




  • Stabilne zatrudnienie bezpośrednio u duńskiego pracodawcy Danish Crown, z pełnym pakietem socjalnym (urlop, emerytura).




  • Wsparcie w procesie relokacji i adaptacji w Danii (CPR, podatki, ubezpieczenie, zakwaterowanie).




  • Pomoc w języku polskim oraz innych językach, a także wprowadzenie w życie i pracę w Danii.



English version:

Experienced Butchers – Shoulder Deboning

Work in Denmark as a butcher– attractive salary, flexibility and stable working conditions

For our customer, Danish Crown - one of Europe’s largest food companies - we are looking for experienced pork butchers for shoulder deboning (pork front ends) at abattoirs in Blans, Denmark.

Working in Denmark means clear employment conditions under collective agreements, pension schemes, paid holidays and stable working conditions. At Danish Crown you will join an international workplace with colleagues from many different countries.

The work is guided by clear values. Safety first is the most important principle – employees must always be able to work safely and return home safely every day.

Danish Crown is also focusing strongly on employee well-being and development. Employees should feel comfortable in their work, understand their role in the production and see how their contribution creates value for the company.
The company culture is based on teamwork, responsibility and mutual respect, where colleagues support each other and everyone is treated fairly.

Please note: You will be employed directly by Danish Crown from your first day of work

Job tasks

• Deboning of pork shoulders (front ends)
• Knife work in high-volume pork production
• Ensuring correct cutting and optimal meat yield
• Following hygiene and safety procedures
• Supporting other tasks in the cutting room when required

Candidate requirements

• Experience with deboning
• Preferably experience with pork shoulders / front ends
• Good knife skills
• Experience from a abattoirs or meat processing plant
• Ability to work in a fast-paced production environment
• Physically fit and reliable

Candidates must be able to work independently with deboning from the first working days.

Salary and working conditions

• Hourly wage according to the collective agreement: DKK 176.10 plus a flexible benefits allowance of 12.20% = DKK 197.58 per hour.

• After a short accomodation period, the salary will switch to piecework (akkord), where the hourly rate will increase significantly.

• Possibility of higher earnings depending on function and performance

• Flexible benefit scheme (extra pay or extra time off)

• Canteen facilities

• Opportunities for training and development

We also offer:

• Admininstrative assistance with CPR number, tax card, healt insurance, and more.

• Help with accomodation near the working place.

• Support in multiple languages ( English, Danish, Romanian, Polish, more)

• Guidance regarding Danish work and living culture.

Working hours

Day shift
Monday – Friday

40 hours per week

Employees accumulate additional hours that can be used for time off.
If flexible benefits and accumulated hours are used for time off, employees can potentially have up to around 10 weeks of time off per year.

Evening shift
32-hour work week distributed across 4 working days.

Employees on the evening shift do not accumulate extra hours, but instead have a weekly rotating day off, which means that approximately every fifth weekend they can have both Friday and Monday off.

Evening shift employees also receive additional evening pay for many of their working hours.

Application
If you are interested in the job, please complete the application form and attach your CV as soon as possible.

If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Ewa Pedersen email ewape@jks.dk telefon: +45.61204070.

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Housekeeping Staff – 2 Positions Available | Full-Time | Accommodation Available
description:
*** Right to Work in Denmark Required ***

Please read before applying.

Applicants must already have the legal right to work in Denmark.

Unfortunately, we are unable to assist with work permits or visa applications, and applications from candidates who do not have the legal right to work in Denmark will not be considered.

Join the Team at Ærø Hotel

Are you reliable, hardworking and looking for an opportunity to live and work in Denmark?

Ærø Hotel is currently looking for 2 motivated employees to join our housekeeping team.

The positions primarily involve housekeeping, but the housekeeping team also assists with the hotel’s dishwashing department as part of the daily operation.

About Ærø Hotel

Ærø Hotel is a family-owned and family-operated hotel located in the maritime town of Marstal on the beautiful island of Ærø, Denmark.

The hotel has:

  • 100 hotel rooms

  • Around 35,000 overnight stays every year

  • Restaurant and Compass Bar

  • Conference and event facilities

  • Indoor swimming pool

  • Fitness room

  • An international team with employees from several European countries

Ærø Hotel is Denmark’s only adults-only hotel, welcoming guests aged 18 years and above.

English is the primary working language at the hotel, so it is not necessary to speak Danish.

Your Responsibilities

Your daily responsibilities will include:

  1. Cleaning and preparing guest rooms

  2. Cleaning bathrooms

  3. Changing bed linen and towels

  4. Making beds according to hotel standards

  5. Restocking guest amenities and supplies

  6. Cleaning corridors and other public areas

  7. Ensuring that all rooms are clean, tidy and ready for arriving guests

  8. Following the hotel’s cleaning procedures and quality standards

  9. Assisting in the hotel’s dishwashing department

  10. Washing dishes, glasses, cutlery and kitchen equipment

  11. Keeping the dishwashing area clean and organised

  12. Working closely with the rest of the housekeeping team to ensure an efficient daily operation

We Are Looking For People Who

  • Speak and understand English

  • Are reliable, responsible and hardworking

  • Have a positive attitude

  • Work well as part of a team

  • Are able to work independently

  • Are comfortable with physically demanding work

  • Can work efficiently while maintaining a high standard

  • Are flexible regarding working hours, including weekends

  • Preferably have previous experience from hotels, housekeeping or professional cleaning

Previous housekeeping experience is an advantage, but the right attitude, reliability and willingness to work are equally important.

What We Offer

  • Full-time employment

  • 2 available positions

  • Start as soon as possible

  • Hourly salary of DKK 130 before tax

  • 12.5% Danish holiday pay in addition to the hourly salary

  • Stable employment

  • Friendly and international colleagues

  • Thorough introduction and training

  • Staff accommodation available

  • The opportunity to live and work on the beautiful island of Ærø

Staff Accommodation

Staff accommodation is available approximately 10 minutes’ walk from the hotel.

At present, each employee has a private bedroom, while kitchen and bathroom facilities are shared with other employees.

Rent is DKK 750 per person per week, including:

  • Electricity

  • Water

  • Heating

  • Internet

During the coming winter, the staff accommodation will undergo a complete renovation. After the renovation, each room will have its own private bathroom and a small private kitchen, providing significantly improved and more independent living facilities for our employees.

Employment Details

Number of positions: 2

Position: Housekeeping / Dishwashing

Salary: DKK 130 per hour + 12.5% Danish holiday pay

Working hours: Full-time

Start date: As soon as possible

Workplace:

Ærø Hotel
Egehovedvej 4
5960 Marstal
Denmark

Please send your application by email to:

Nick Hulegaard
General Manager
Ærø Hotel
NB@aeroehotel.dk

We look forward to hearing from you and hopefully welcoming you to the team at Ærø Hotel.

title: We Are Hiring – Experienced Chef
description:
EU/EEA citizenship or valid right to work in Denmark required

Ærø Hotel is looking for an experienced, skilled and reliable Chef to join our international kitchen team.

We are located on the beautiful Danish island of Ærø, in the maritime town of Marstal. We are looking for an experienced chef who enjoys working in a structured professional kitchen, preparing good-quality food for a large number of hotel guests.

We have 1 position available.

About the position

You will become part of our evening kitchen team, which consists of five chefs working closely together.

Ærø Hotel does not operate an à la carte restaurant.

Our kitchen is based on planned production and pre-arranged menus for our hotel guests. We serve between approximately 100 and 200 guests every day.

During the day, we prepare and serve lunches, while dinner consists of pre-booked and predetermined two-course menus.

Our dinner concept follows a fixed rotation of four different two-course menus. After the fourth menu, the rotation starts again on day five.

This means that our kitchen operation is highly structured, allowing the team to focus on good preparation, consistency, quality and efficient service.

We are therefore looking for an experienced chef who is comfortable preparing food in larger quantities and who understands the importance of planning, organisation and consistency when serving many guests.

The primary working language in our kitchen is Spanish, while English is the common language throughout the rest of the hotel.

Your main responsibilities

  • Preparing lunches and evening meals for our hotel guests

  • Preparing and cooking food for approximately 100–200 guests per day

  • Working with our fixed rotation of pre-planned two-course dinner menus

  • Taking responsibility for your own tasks and preparation

  • Working closely with our team of five evening chefs

  • Ensuring consistent quality, taste and presentation

  • Planning and organising preparation efficiently

  • Contributing to a smooth and well-organised dinner service

  • Maintaining high standards of cleanliness and hygiene

  • Following Danish food safety and hygiene regulations

  • Supporting your colleagues and contributing to a professional and positive working environment

We are looking for someone who

  • Has solid professional experience working as a chef

  • Is experienced in preparing food for larger groups of guests

  • Is comfortable with high-volume food production

  • Is able to work independently and take responsibility

  • Understands the importance of planning, preparation and consistency

  • Works efficiently and remains organised during busy periods

  • Speaks Spanish and is able to communicate in English

  • Is reliable, responsible and flexible

  • Takes pride in food quality and presentation

  • Enjoys working as part of a professional kitchen team

  • Has EU/EEA citizenship or another valid right to work in Denmark

Previous professional experience as a chef is essential for this position.

Salary and employment conditions

Salary: DKK 180 per hour before tax.

Holiday allowance is paid in addition to the hourly salary in accordance with Danish regulations.

We offer attractive working hours and the opportunity to become part of an established and experienced kitchen team.

Start date: As soon as possible

Location: Ærø Hotel, Marstal, Denmark

Staff accommodation

If needed, we can offer staff accommodation close to the hotel.

The current accommodation consists of private bedrooms with shared kitchen and bathroom facilities.

Rent is DKK 750 per week and includes:

  • Electricity

  • Water

  • Heating

  • Internet

During the coming winter, the staff accommodation will undergo a complete renovation. After the renovation, each room will have its own private bathroom and small kitchen.

Accommodation is optional and paid by the employee.

About Ærø Hotel

Ærø Hotel is a well-established hotel located in Marstal on the island of Ærø in southern Denmark.

We welcome guests from Denmark and abroad and have an international team of employees from several different countries.

Our kitchen is an important part of the hotel experience. Because most of our guests stay with us as part of organised hotel packages, we know in advance how many guests we are cooking for and which menus will be served.

This gives us a structured way of working, where good preparation, teamwork and consistency are essential.

You will become part of an experienced kitchen team where everyone works together to ensure that between 100 and 200 guests receive a good dining experience every day.

Life on Ærø

Ærø is one of Denmark’s most beautiful and distinctive islands.

The island is known for its beautiful coastline, beaches, historic towns, colourful houses, maritime atmosphere and relaxed way of life.

Marstal has a strong maritime tradition and is a lively small town with shops, cafés and the everyday facilities needed when living on the island. At the same time, the sea and nature are always close by.

Working at Ærø Hotel gives you the opportunity to combine a professional job with life in a safe, peaceful and welcoming island community.

For the right person, Ærø offers much more than just a workplace. It is an opportunity to become part of an international team while experiencing a very special part of Denmark.

If you are an experienced chef and would like to become part of our team at Ærø Hotel, we would be very pleased to hear from you.

Please send us your CV together with a short introduction about yourself, your professional kitchen experience and when you would be available to start.

title: Postdoctoral Position in Multiphysics Modelling of Bubble Transport and Electrochemical Processes in Alkaline Electrolysers
description:
The Centre for Industrial Mechanics in Sønderborg, Denmark, part of the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for a 2-year postdoc position in Multiphysics Modelling of Bubble Transport and Electrochemical Processes in Alkaline Electrolysers. The position is open from October 1, 2026, or as soon as possible thereafter, and the specific start date will be agreed with the successful candidates.

 

About the Position

The position is funded through a collaborative research and innovation project involving SDU, DTU, and Stiesdal Hydrogen, and aims to reduce the CAPEX of green hydrogen production by developing a next-generation bipolar electrode cassette for alkaline electrolysers. One focus will be on geometry-driven bubble management.

As a postdoctoral researcher, you will join the SDU Energy Systems Group at the Centre for Industrial Mechanics (CIM) and play a key role in developing advanced simulation tools and validating simulations with experimental results. Your work will combine multiphase CFD modelling, current distribution modelling, and collaboration with experimentalists. The objective is to create predictive models that guide cassette design, identify optimal operating conditions, and reduce the need for extensive physical prototyping.

Working closely with researchers at SDU and DTU, as well as engineers at Stiesdal Hydrogen, you will contribute to the development of next-generation hydrogen production technology with clear industrial impact and support its path towards large-scale implementation.

 

Your Role

  • Develop and apply simulation methods for multiphase transport and current distribution 

    in electrolyzers

  • Investigate bubble-buoyancy-driven internal electrolyte circulation

  • Quantify transport processes affecting mass transfer and electrochemical performance

  • Integrate computational and experimental results to advance mechanistic understanding and predictive modelling

  • Collaborate with academic and industrial partners

  • Mentor and supervise students (PhD, MSc, BSc) on related research questions

  • Publish research results in peer-reviewed journals and present at international conferences

  • Contribute to research funding applications and assist with teaching activities as relevant

 

Your Profile

  • PhD in engineering, computational science, physics or related discipline

  • Background in computational fluid dynamics (CFD)

  • Experience in multiphase flow and/or electrochemical transport modelling

  • Experience with numerical simulation software such as ANSYS, COMSOL, or OpenFOAM 

  • Programming skills in Python, C++, or equivalent languages

  • Strong teamwork, communication, and independent research skills

  • Proficient in English (spoken and written)

 

Why Join SDU Sønderborg?

The SDU Energy Systems Group at CIM is a dynamic, recently established research group within the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IME). As part of a young and growing team and institute, you will help shaping research, education, and innovation in engineering science. 

You will have access to state-of-the-art computing and lab facilities, and benefit from strong academic and industrial networks across Denmark and Europe. CIM is based at SDU’s scenic Sønderborg campus in the Alsion building directly at the waterfront. All study programs are taught in English, and more than half of our students and staff are international, creating an inspiring environment.

SDU maintains close ties to industry in Sønderborg, Southern Denmark, and Northern Germany, offering direct exposure to real-world challenges and opportunities for cross-sectoral research collaborations. This position offers you the chance to develop your own research ideas, contribute to the growth of the group and institute, and advance your career in a supportive, international setting.

In short, you will benefit from:

  • Access to state-of-the-art computing and lab facilities

  • A dynamic, international research environment in a scenic campus setting

  • Close ties to industry and opportunities for cross-sectoral collaboration

  • Support for developing your own research ideas and career

 

Contact information

For further information, please contact Associate Professor Martin Lautenschläger 
(mlaut@sdu.dk; phone: + 45 65 50 79 86) or Associate Professor Lars Duggen (duggen@sdu.dk) and visit www.sdu.dk/en/ime.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application.

  • Curriculum Vitae. 

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).  

  • Complete list of publications.

  • Publications most relevant to the position.

  • Summary and documentation of experience in teaching, if relevant to the position. 

  • A research statement may be included.

  • References/reference letters may also be included.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected.

title: PhD Position in High Performance Organic Photovoltaics
description:
The Centre for Advanced Photovoltaics and Thin-Film Energy Devices (SDU CAPE), Mads Clausen Institute, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for a 3-year PhD position within the DFF funded project LuminOPV. The position is open from Dec. 1, 2026, and the specific start date will be agreed with the successful candidates. 

 

What we offer 

The PhD position is a part of the SDU CAPE research center at the Mads Clausen Institute, SDU, where we focus on designing, developing, and bringing forward new sustainable solar energy conversion and storage technologies, in particular new thin film solar cells and modules. The DFF LuminOPV project will explore aggregation-induced emission (AIE)-active molecular materials to control photophysical processes, molecular organization, and energy losses in organic photovoltaics. Complementary interface engineering and passivation strategies will be employed to optimize charge extraction, suppress interfacial defects, enhance operational stability, and facilitate scalable organic solar cells and modules. 

This PhD project focuses specifically on the design and development of AIE-active molecular materials for next-generation organic photovoltaics. The project will be part of the DFF1 project, and research stays abroad is part of the position. Most of your working time is devoted to your own research studies. As a PhD student you are expected to develop your own ideas and communicate scientific results in English. We offer a fully funded PhD position for the duration of three years. 

The successful applicant will be enrolled as a PhD student at the PhD School at the Faculty of Engineering.

 

What we expect 

Candidates who hold a master’s degree in a relevant field (chemistry, material science, physics, electrical engineering and similar). Preferred candidates have experience with some of the following: Organic synthesis, molecular photophysics, organic and/or hybrid semiconductors, thin films and interfaces, and organic photovoltaics. Due to the high cross-disciplinary nature of the work, the candidate is expected to have excellent collaboration skills. A very good capability of communicating scientific results in English, both orally and in writing is required.

 

Workplace description 

We are an international research center working in the field of green energy technologies (CAPE), and we are looking for a highly motivated PhD candidate to join our CAPE research center at University of Southern Denmark (SDU), campus Sønderborg, for developing next-generation sustainable and high-performance photovoltaics. We offer a modern, inclusive, international and interdisciplinary working environment with state-of-the-art facilities as well as a strong tradition of international collaboration. Our ambition is, to recruit, develop, and retain talented scholars committed to both academic excellence and departmental development.

Having a focus on green energy technologies - improving performance, device stability and up-scaling, the center has full access to an ISOS5 cleanroom and surface science laboratory facility for the preparation and characterization of thin films and photovoltaic devices, as well as a fully equipped Roll-to-Roll (R2R) facility for upscaling flexible devices. Our research center CAPE is a partner in various national and international research projects and networks that include collaboration partners from both academia and industry.

For information about the CAPE research center, please see https://www.sdu.dk/en/forskning/cape 

For information about the Mads Clausen Institute, please see www.sdu.dk/en/mci

Further information about this position is available from Associate Professor Vida Engmann, e-mail: engmann@mci.sdu.dk.

title: Postdoc in Microbiome Bioinformatics Workflows
description:
A position as a postdoc (100% time) is vacant at the the Arumugam Group, Research unit of Medical Gastroenterology, the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. 

The position is limited to 3 years with the possibility of extension. 

Research tasks 

The position as a postdoc consists of research, teaching, professional development, and guidance in Microbiome Bioinformatics Workflows

We seek a bioinformatician to develop computational workflows to analyze large-scale microbiome multi-omics data in multiple projects studying human and animal health, including the consortium project PIG-PARADIGM to combat antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in pig production (http://pig-paradigm.net) and EU Horizon 2020 project MICROB-PREDICT (https://microb-predict.eu/). We strive to implement efficient and scalable workflows to analyze and integrate these data derived from metagenomics, metatranscriptomics, viral metagenomics, metabolomics, and metaproteomics in collaboration with international data science partners (e.g., EMBL-Heidelberg; University of California, Davis) and other project partners. We have developed the MIntO package (https://github.com/arumugamlab/MIntO) that integrates microbiome metagenomic and metatranscriptomic data. Our ambition is to develop new workflows that expand MIntO’s features (e.g., novel analysis types) as well as datatypes (e.g., metabolomic data).

In this position, you will be:

  • Responsible for improving and expanding workflows in our current MIntO pipeline, while also having a chance to create your own novel workflows.

  • Expected to participate in and lead existing projects within these consortia and other projects in the Arumugam group; and are highly encouraged to initiate new cutting-edge research projects.

  • Expected to interact and collaborate with other clinical researchers, veterinarians, biologists, and bioinformaticians in these consortia, to enhance and ensure proper interpretation of experimental results.

Expectations of qualifications 

The applicant who is hired must have a Ph.D. degree and documented research experience in one or more of the areas/fields mentioned below:

  • Bioinformatics

  • Biology

The Postdoc fellowship is aimed at early-career researchers with a background in basic science. We are particularly interested in candidates with solid experience in analyzing large volumes of next-generation sequencing data, who are aware of challenges in scalability and efficiency

Required qualifications:

  • PhD in bioinformatics or biology with strong experience in software development.

  • Academic preparation as well as experience in biological statistics.

  • Strong programming skills in Python and/or R.

  • Experience with bioinformatics workflow environments such as snakemake, NextFlow or CWL.

  • Experience in analyzing next-generation sequencing datasets.

  • Experience in a high-performance computing environment using any flavor of UNIX.

  • Demonstrated capacity for effective teamwork.

  • Proven track record showing scientific productivity in peer-reviewed journals.

  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and oral.

The following qualifications are highly preferred, but not required. Candidates who possess any of these qualifications are encouraged to highlight them in the application:

  • Basic understanding of disease biology and/or microbiology.

  • Experience in analyzing metagenomic datasets from host-associated microbiota.

  • Experience in handling multi-omics data, including metabolomics and proteomics.

  • Experience in distributed and cloud computing technologies.

  • Experience in supervising other researchers at different levels.

  • International mobility

Research strategy for OUH and the Department of Clinical Research

The joint research strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital sets the direction for our shared research efforts in the years ahead. Rooted in the vision – We conduct research together to shape the patient care of the future – it focuses in particular on: cross-disciplinary research – with people at the centre; strong research environments – as drivers of development; and the research journey – from idea to impact. Further information on the joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital is available here.

For further information, please contact Group Leader Mani Arumugam, Department of Clinical Research, e-mail: arumugam@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 23649552 or Head of Department at the Department of Clinical Research Rikke Leth-Larsen, e-mail: rllarsen@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 65503477

The position is limited to 3 years with the possibility of extension. 

Research tasks 

The position as a postdoc consists of research, teaching, professional development, and guidance in Host-Microbiome Multi-omic Data Science.

We seek a data scientist to derive insights from host-microbiome multi-omics data in multiple consortium projects studying human and animal health, including GALAXY/MicrobLiver studying liver fibrosis (https://www.sdu.dk/en/forskning/galaxy), MICROB-PREDICT studying late-stage liver cirrhosis (https://microb-predict.eu/), and PIG-PARADIGM to combat antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in pig production (http://pig-paradigm.net). We strive to integrate and interpret these data derived from microbiome (e.g., metagenomics, metatranscriptomics, viral metagenomics, metabolomics, metaproteomics) and host (e.g., genetics, proteomics, circulating metabolomics) in collaboration with international data science partners (e.g., EMBL-Heidelberg; University of California, Davis) and other project partners. The current state-of-the-art for multi-omics integration and interpretation leaves much to be desired. Fortunately, our ongoing work leveraging a deep learning approach (autoencoders) integrates multi-omics data and generates biologically relevant insights using a biologically informed machine learning framework. Our ambition is to strengthen and expand this research direction into graph-based approaches such as graph neural networks.

In this position, you will be:

  • Responsible for improving and expanding our current deep learning approaches, while also having a chance to create your own novel approaches.

title: Critical Environment Technician
description:
Overview
Critical Environment Technician (CET) – Shift Role 
Location: 3 Sites Greater Copenhagen Area, Denmark  
Role Type: Shift-based, onsite technical operations role 

Role Summary Microsoft is seeking a Critical Environment Technician (CET) to support the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of Microsoft datacenter infrastructure in Denmark. 
This role is responsible for supporting the operation, monitoring, maintenance, and troubleshooting of electrical, mechanical, cooling, and control systems within a 24/7 mission-critical environment. 

We offer an excellent work-life balance 
•    Two-day shifts from 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM. •    Two-night shifts from 6:00 PM to 6:00 AM. 
•    Seven days off following each rotation, in accordance with the DI agreement. 
Microsoft Culture and Expectations 
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. Within CO+I, this mission is supported through a culture focused on safety, reliability, sustainability, inclusion, learning, and continuous improvement. 
Employees are expected to model Microsoft values, follow approved procedures, apply STOP WORK authority when needed, and contribute to an inclusive environment where all team members can perform, grow, and succeed. 


Responsibilities
Key Responsibilities 
•    Monitor, operate, and control critical infrastructure systems, including electrical, mechanical, cooling, and control systems. 
•    Perform preventive and corrective maintenance in accordance with approved EOPs, MOPs, and SOPs. 
•    Respond to incidents, support troubleshooting and recovery activities, and lead response efforts when appropriate. •    Identify and escalate safety, compliance, and operational risks in line with Microsoft standards. 
•    Collaborate with internal teams, vendors, and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure safe and high-quality execution. 
•    Contribute to continuous improvement by sharing knowledge, supporting peers, and developing technical capability over time. 


Qualifications
Required Qualifications 
 •    Upper secondary education (vocational or general upper secondary school) or equivalent practical work experience 
•    Some prior experience in technical work, such as: industrial maintenance, electrical or HVAC installations, energy, process or production facilities, datacentres, hospitals or other demanding technical environments 
•    You will be required to travel between sites as part of this role so a valid driver’s license will be required.
•    Ability to work rotating shift patterns in a 24/7 operational environment. 
•    Ability to communicate effectively in English. 
Preferred (but not essential) Qualifications 
•    Technical certification in electrical, mechanical, HVAC, or a related field, or equivalent training. 
•    Experience working with CMMS systems. •    Experience in high-availability, mission-critical, or safety-critical environments. 
•    Exposure to industrial, electrical, mechanical, cooling, or control systems.  

Direct datacenter experience is not required—we provide onboarding and support to build the necessary domain expertise. 
You do not need to meet every requirement to apply. 
If you have strong experience in similar technical environments, a passion for safety, and operations, we encourage you to apply. 

Candidate Profile 
•    The ideal candidate demonstrates a strong safety mindset, sound technical judgment, and the ability to operate effectively in a structured, procedure-driven environment. 
•    Microsoft encourages applications from candidates with diverse technical backgrounds who are motivated to learn and contribute to a high-performing datacenter operations team. 
Security Requirements 
Candidates must successfully complete the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire and maintain ongoing compliance throughout employment.
