title: Early morning deliverer, Turku region
description:
Keep your days free - become an early morning deliverer!

Are you looking for a job that leaves your days free for studies, hobbies, family life, or other commitments? Lounais-Suomen Tietojakelu regularly offers delivery work in Turku and the surrounding municipalities. The job is an excellent fit for students, early risers, and anyone looking for additional income.

Please note that we do not always have an open delivery route available immediately in every area. We continuously interview candidates and maintain a recruitment pool for different locations. This allows us to quickly contact suitable applicants when a route becomes available near their home.

We invite applicants to interviews based on their place of residence and anticipated recruitment needs in different areas. Bicycle delivery routes are typically offered within approximately 5 kilometres of the applicant's home address.

What is the job like?

As a deliverer, you will work approximately 3-5 hours per night, typically between 1:00 a.m. and 6:00 a.m.

The work consists of delivering newspapers, magazines, and addressed mail along a pre-defined route. The standard shift pattern is six consecutive working nights followed by two nights off, providing a predictable work rhythm and helping you plan your free time.

Delivery routes and equipment

- In Turku, deliveries are primarily carried out using a bicycle provided by the employer.
- Outside Turku, routes are completed using either your own car or a company vehicle.
- When a route requires the use of your own car, mileage compensation is paid according to the applicable rate.

Pay and training

- Pay is based on the collective agreement between the Finnish Media Federation and the Industrial Union.
- The average earnings for a new deliverer, including applicable supplements, are approximately €12-13 per hour.
- You will receive paid onboarding, including daytime training and practical guidance on your own route during night shifts.
- In addition, we pay a €900 orientation bonus during the first nine months of employment.

What we offer

- Permanent or fixed-term employment depending on your preferences and available routes
- Comprehensive training and support from the start
- A predictable and stable work schedule
- Independent work with a high degree of responsibility
- An active job that keeps you moving
- Occupational healthcare
- Five weeks of paid annual holiday
- TS Group employee benefits, including a Turun Sanomat subscription and wellbeing benefits
- The opportunity to start work quickly when a suitable route becomes available in your area

What we expect from you

- At least 18 years of age
- Good English or Finnish language skills
- Reasonable physical fitness
- A careful, responsible, and independent working attitude
- Ability and willingness to work at night
- A valid residence permit and the right to work in Finland

Interested?

Apply easily by clicking the "Apply" button below.

Please note that applications submitted by email cannot be processed.

This job posting is available in both English and Finnish. You only need to apply through one of them.

After reviewing applications, we invite selected candidates to interviews and maintain a recruitment pool for future delivery opportunities in different areas.

About Lounais-Suomen Tietojakelu

Lounais-Suomen Tietojakelu is responsible for the early morning delivery of newspapers, magazines, and addressed mail across 25 municipalities in Southwestern Finland. We employ approximately 500 deliverers and are part of the TS Group.

Our main delivery product is Turun Sanomat, the leading newspaper in the Turku region. As Finland's second-largest newspaper distribution company, we play an important role in ensuring reliable deliveries every day of the year.

Apply today and be ready to start when the right delivery route becomes available near you.

title: Bussikuski / Bus Driver
description:
BUSSIKUSKI HAUSSA NORTHERN LIGHTS VILLAGE SAARISELÄLLE!

Etsimme ammattitaitoista bussikuskia liittymään tiimiimme tulevalle talvikaudelle! Tässä tehtävässä ajat pääosin minibussilla säännöllisiä shuttle-kuljetuksia resortin ja asiakkaiden majoituksen välillä, osallistut revontuliretkille kuskina ja avustat oppaita ryhmäaktiviteeteissa.

Bussikuskina olet tärkeässä roolissa asiakkaidemme saapumisessa ja lähtemisessä sekä varmistamassa, että heidän matkansa sujuvat turvallisesti ja mukavasti.

MITÄ TYÖ PITÄÄ SISÄLLÄÄN?

* Yrityksen autojen ajaminen ja aikataulujen noudattaminen

* Asiakkaiden turvallisuudesta ja viihtyvyydestä huolehtiminen

* Ajoneuvon pitäminen siistinä ja hyvässä kunnossa

* Asiakkaille avun ja tiedon tarjoaminen tarvittaessa

* Oppaiden avustaminen revontuliretkillä

* Liikennesääntöjen ja turvallisuusohjeiden noudattaminen

* Ajoneuvon tarkistaminen ennen ajoa ja ajon jälkeen sekä mahdollisten vikojen raportointi huollolle

* Yrityksen sovellusten käyttäminen asiakastietojen tarkistamiseen

MITÄ ODOTAMME SINULTA?

* Voimassa oleva D-luokan ajokortti (linja-autokortti)

* Sujuva englannin kielen taito (suullinen ja kirjallinen)

* Hyvät ajotaidot ja paikkatuntemus

* Asiakaspalveluhenkisyys ja hyvät kommunikointitaidot

* Joustavuus työajoissa – työ sisältää vaihtelevia vuoroja aamu/ilta aina viikoloppuihin ja pyhäpäiviin

* Vähintään 2 vuoden ajokokemus

* Nuhteeton rikosrekisteri

EDUKSI KATSOMME:

* Kokemus asiakaspalvelutehtävistä

* Aikaisempi työkokemus eräoppaana

* Suomen kielen taito

* Valokuvaustaidot

MITÄ TARJOAMME?

* Mahdollisuus kehittyä ja saada koulutusta

* Mukava ja kannustava työympäristö

* Henkilökuntaedut yrityksen palveluissa, kattava yksityinen työterveys

TYÖN KESTO, PALKKA JA EDUT:

* Työ alkaa Loka-/marraskuussa Työ päättyy maalis-/huhtikuussa

* Työaika 120h/3vko

* Palkka sovitaan haastattelussa kokemuksen ja osaamisen perusteella (kk palkka 2800 - 3096e/kk)

* Muut edut ja lisät työehtosopimuksen mukaan

* Tarvittaessa tarjoamme majoituksen jaetussa huoneessa hintaan 300 €/kk



Mikäli kiinnostuit, laitathan hakemustasi tulemaan ja jutellaan pian lisää!



BUS DRIVER POSITION NOW OPEN AT NORTHERN LIGHTS VILLAGE SAARISELKÄ!


ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a qualified bus driver to join our team for the coming winter season. In this role you drive regular shuttle transfers between the resort and guests' accommodation, mostly on the minibus, take part in aurora hunting experiences as a driver, and support the guides during group activities.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

* Operating company cars on scheduled routes and maintaining timeliness

* Ensuring passenger safety and satisfaction

* Maintaining a clean and tidy vehicle at all times

* Providing information and assistance to passengers as required

* Supporting guides during aurora hunting excursions

* Adhering to traffic laws and regulations

* Conducting pre-trip and post-trip vehicle inspections, and reportingany bus malfunctions or needed repairs to maintenance.

* Using companys applications to check customer data

REQUIREMENTS

* Valid Finnish bus driver license (D-class)

* Fluent written and spoken English

* Excellent navigational and driving skills

* Good communication skills

* Ability to work flexible schedules, including weekends and holidays

* A minimum of 2 years driving experience is preferred

* Experience driving in winter conditions

* Clear criminal background report



DESIRABLE QUALIFICATIONS

* Experience with customer service

* Previous experience as a wilderness guide

* Finnish language knowledge

* Knowledge of the local area

* Photography skills

WHAT WE OFFER

* Opportunities for professional development and training

* A positive and supportive working environment

* Discounts across our properties and facilities, comprehensive private health care package

Pay, Duration, and Benefits

* Starts: October/November, Ends: March/April

* Working time 120h/3week

* Monthly pay negotiated in an interview, according to knowledge and experience (2800 - 3096e/month )

* Other benefits and supplements according to the collective labor agreement

* If necessary, the resort provides accommodation in a shared room for €300,00/month

HOW TO APPLY

Before applying, please ensure you have the right to work in Finland.

Please note that due to the high volume of applications, we may not reply to applications that do not fulfill the stated requirements. Should your application meet the initial selection criteria, you will receive a reply in early August at the latest.

If driving and customer service are your passions, we encourage you to apply. Please submit your CV and a cover letter highlighting your suitability for this role to our recruitment team.

Join our driving force at Northern Lights Village. Apply now!

title: Kotisiivooja Ouluun
description:
Etsimme Oulun kotisiivoustiimimme vahvistukseksi luotettavaa ja reipasta kotisiivoojaa!

Kotisiivoojan työ on monipuolista ja joustavaa päivätyötä, jota tehdään asiakkaidemme kodeissa heidän toiveidensa mukaisesti.Pidät asiakkaidemme kodit hohtavan puhtaina ja ikkunat kirkkaina, eli vastaat asiakkaiden kotien siivoamisesta, ikkunanpesuista ja muuttosiivouksista. Työhösi voi kuulua myös muita kodinhoidollisia tehtäviä, kuten pyykkihuoltoa ja lakanoiden vaihtoa. Meillä Sivinassa on käytössämme ammattimaiset siivousvälineet ja puhdistusaineet.

Meillä on Oulussa todella kiva tiimi ja saamme jatkuvasti kiitettävää palautetta asiakkailtamme. Työtä tehdään oman työparin kanssa ja päivän asiakaskohteet sijaitsevat lähellä toisiaan. Tämä työ sopii niin aloittavalle kotisiivoojalle kuin pidemmän uran tehneellekin ammattilaiselle! Työ on osa-aikainen ja sovimme kanssasi työtunneista joustavasti.

MEILTÄ SAAT:

\-Kilpailukykyisen palkan (kiinteistöpalvelualan TES)

\-Joustavan arkipäivätyön klo 8-16 välillä

\-Hyvät kouluttautumismahdollisuudet yhteistyökumppanimme Taitotalon kanssa (+huomioi mahdolliset koulutuslisät!)

\-Huolellisen perehdytyksen työhösi

\-Huippukivat työkaverit ja oman työparin

\-Lähiesihenkilösi Minnan tuen, milloin ikinä sitä tarvitsetkin

\-Vapaa-ajalle ulottuvan tapaturmavakuutuksen

\-Kattavan paketin jäsenetuja Fitness24Seven-kuntokeskuksissa!

\-Yli 20h/viikossa tekevälle tarjoamme yksityisen työterveyshuollon palvelut sekä liikunta- ja kulttuuriedun

SINULTA ODOTAMME:

\-Aitoa halua helpottaa asiakkaidemme arkea

\-Hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja ja reipasta asennetta työntekoa kohtaan

\-Täsmällisyyttä ja huolellisuutta

\-Suomen kielen taitoa

\-B-ajokorttia ja kykyä ajaa manuaalivaihteista autoa

\-Kokemus siivousalan töistä katsotaan eduksi

\-Oma auto on iso plussa!

title: Director, Projects, Marine
description:
Are you an experienced engineering professional with a passion for leading people and delivering high-quality project execution? Do you enjoy combining technical expertise with team leadership and close collaboration with sales and clients? Would you like to be part of a global engineering and consulting organization, working across international teams and projects to deliver solutions for the marine industry?

If so, this could be your next career step.

Your role and the team

Join us as we strengthen our Project Operations team of ten professionals! The team is part of our Marine business unit, ensuring our projects are executed successfully as well as providing high-end project execution services for our clients. The team also supports project sales and business development.

As a Director, you will play a key role in overseeing our project portfolio and working as a Marine Business Unit PMO, managing and developing our project operations, ensuring efficient, high-quality project execution aligned with our long-term business goals and processes. You shall be responsible for building our project management capability, leading and supporting the current team in a daily leadership role and contributing hands-on to projects when needed.

You will also drive business growth by identifying new opportunities, building customer relationships, and ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards. In addition, you will contribute to recruitment, subcontracting decisions, and the development of expertise within your team and discipline.

As the Marine PMO, you will be working closely with the Elomatic Group PMO to ensure our project management processes are aligned and further developed according to business needs. You'll also work closely with sales to provide engineering and technology support, contribute to proposals, and strengthen client relationships. Additionally, you play a key role in ensuring effective collaboration between internal and external stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle, from initial sales activities to successful project delivery.

The ideal candidate is an experienced project management professional with hands-on senior project management experience in the marine industry. You are motivated to drive successful projects by leading people and actively contributing to project delivery while working closely with customers. The role and job title can be tailored to reflect your expertise and career goals.

What helps you succeed in this role

- B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in a relevant field (preferably in engineering or technology)
- 10+ years experience, in project leadership roles in marine industry
- Ability to lead study and pre-engineering projects
- Strong project management skills, including resource management, problem-solving abilities, effective time and organizational skills, and the ability to perform well under pressure and changing priorities
- Project management certificate preferred
- Motivation to lead, coach, and develop people and guide your team towards shared goals
- Fluent communication skills in Finnish and in English
- Willingness to global travel occasionally
- Motivation to work in a global operating environment, taking different time zones into account

What we promise you

Interesting and challenging projects with a supportive team, modern tools and technologies, and a flexible hybrid work model that helps you balance work and free time. We offer training, mentoring, and comprehensive learning and development opportunities to support your growth and help you shape your career. All this is backed by our warm EloWe culture, built on respect, equality, kindness, and support.

Learn more about us: [Visions of Tomorrow, Engineered Today - Elomatic](https://www.elomatic.com/)
Get to know your future colleagues: [Meet Us! videos](https://www.youtube.com/@ElomaticOy/shorts)

Please share your thoughts regarding salary expectations in your application. Our compensation aligns with trade union recommendations and reflects your future role, capabilities and skills, working experience and specialization. Additionally, we offer versatile employee benefits, including comprehensive insurance and support for sports and cultural activities.

We succeed together, we have passion to improve, we are trustworthy

If you share our values and are ready for this exciting opportunity, apply with your CV and cover letter in English or Finnish by August 31st at the latest. We welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds and working styles, different perspectives make us stronger. We review applications continuously and are ready to start interviews during the application period.

For more information, feel free to contact us

SVP Marine: Teemu Tuomisto, +358 40 820 4808, teemu.tuomisto@elomatic.com

And remember to follow us on [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/elomaticoy/) and [LinkedIn!](https://www.linkedin.com/company/elomatic/)

___________________________________________________________________________

Building tomorrow. Elomatic is an international consulting and engineering company dedicated to creating solutions that improve the wellbeing of people and the environment. With over 50 years of experience, we are known as pioneers in the development of design methods. Our 1,300 professionals provide exceptional value across the entire life cycles of products, services, and digital solutions.

What we do

Elomatic specializes in

- Marine
- Pharma, and
- Industry, covering process and energy industries, machinery, and equipment manufacturing.

We offer a comprehensive range of services, including engineering and consulting, project management, technical analysis and visualization, as well as product and service development. Additionally, we deliver products and overall solutions that complement our core services.

title: Kotisiivooja Ruovesi
description:
Haluaisitko tehdä merkityksellistä ja joustavaa osa-aikatyötä apua tarvitsevien sympaattisten asiakkaiden, kuten ikäihmisten kanssa? Saatat olet tuleva helpperimme! Olit sitten opiskelija, eläkeläinen tai etsit muuten vain osa-aikatyötä, tässä roolissa ratkaisee innokkuus ja aito halu auttaa suurella sydämellä!

Me olemme Hemby, ikääntyneiden, lasten ja oikeastaan ihan kaiken ikäisten apua tarvitsevien kotipalveluita rohkeasti uudistava yritys. Tarjoamme iloa ja turvaa asiakkaidemme arkeen ja mottomme on: autamme kuin omaa äitiämme tai isäämme.

Mikä on helpperi? Helpperi on henkilö, joka tarjoaa arjen apua, seuraa ja/tai tukee kodin puhtaanapidossa omaa nimettyä avustettavaa henkilöä, kuten ikäihmistä. Helpperin työ voi sisältää avustajan tehtäviä, kuten asiakkaan tukemista kaikenlaisissa arjen askareissa, kuten ulkoilussa, kauppareissuilla, roskien viemisessä tai ihan vain kahvitellen yhdessäolon ja jutustelun merkeissä. Etsimme myös avustajien lisäksi siivooja-helppereitä, joiden työtehtäviin kuuluu ammatillinen kotisiivous ja ikkunanpesu. Ajan myötä helpperistä ja asiakkaasta tulee usein jopa ystäviä työskentelyn myötä.

Helpperin työtä voivat tehdä kaikki yli 18-vuotiaat opiskelijoista eläkeläisiin. Tärkeintä on reipas työote ja aito halu auttaa.

Mitä helpperin työ vaatii? Sitä, että palat halusta auttaa. Avustajan työ ei vaadi muita erityisiä taitoja. Riittää, että haluat viettää aikaa apua tarvitsevien kanssa ja tehdä omalla toiminnallasi heidän arjestaan parempaa ja helpompaa. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat myös hyvin joustavat. Siivooja-helppereiltä edellytämme kokemusta puhtaanapidon alalta.

Mikä on parasta helpperin työssä? Kysyimme tätä helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat:

- "Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen seniorin kanssa."

- "Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne."

- "Hembyn yhteisöön kuuluminen."


Helpperinä saat:

- Oman nimetyn asiakkaan, jota autat arjen askareissa ja olet hänelle seurana

- Joustavat työajat, jotka sopivat mainiosti esimerkiksi opiskelun tai osa-aikatyön ohelle. Tyypillinen työaika on 1-2 kertaa viikossa muutaman tunnin ajan.

- Kilpailukykyisen tuntipalkan: 13,20-15,98 €/h + työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät sekä lomakorvaukset.

- Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet: Voit edetä kokemuksen ja hyvän asiakaspalautteen ansiosta pro-helpperiksi tai guru-helpperiksi ja saada korotusta palkkaasi!


Hakemukset lähetetään sähköisen lomakkeen kautta. Olemme kaikkiin hakijoihin yhteydessä hakemuksen lähettämisen jälkeen.

title: Cleaner, Housekeeper
description:
Safartica Oy is a privately owned activity service company operating in Rovaniemi, Ylläs, Levi, and Saariselkä. In addition, we offer accommodation services in Rovaniemi and Ylläs. Our core principles are high-quality service, flexibility, and the ability to respond quickly to customer needs and changing conditions.

We are looking for cleaners and room attendants to join our growing team for the winter season 2026-2026 in Rovaniemi.

Our accommodation team is responsible for tasks such as cleaning our accommodation properties in Rovaniemi and providing on-site customer service. The properties are located near the city center, in the Ounasvaara area and at Vaattunki Wilderness Resort, which sits near the Arctic Circle hiking area. The concept and brand of Vaattunki was renewed in summer 2025. The updated resort opened its doors for the winter season 2025, offering an even more experiential and high-quality accommodation experience. Our resort combines premium lodging, an inspiring restaurant experience, and stunning natural surroundings in the heart of Lapland.

What we expect from you:

- Ability to work independently

- Organizational skills and efficiency

- Ability to work under pressure and adapt to the ever-changing nature of the tourism industry

- Flexibility

- A positive attitude toward work and colleagues

- Finnish and English language skills


Considered an advantage:

- Previous experience in cleaning or housekeeping

- Additional language skills

- Drivers license (B)


What we offer:

- A relaxed and cheerful working atmosphere

- Full training for your tasks

- A position in a growing company with opportunities to take on a variety of tasks

- Staff benefits (e.g., accommodation, activities, and discounts with local partners)


Work begins in September-October 2026.

title: Butcher / meat cutter
description:
Tenon Luonnontuote is looking for a skilled professional butcher for reindeer meat processing for autumn 2026.

The work starts at the beginning of October, when the reindeer season begins, and continues until the end of November.

Main duties: deboning and cutting reindeer meat, cutting and sawing meat, packing meat products, assisting in the production of meat products, other tasks related to meat processing.

We are looking for an experienced and reliable butcher with professional skills in meat cutting. Experience with reindeer meat is considered an advantage.

Language requirements: Finnish or English.

Free accommodation. We provide free accommodation next to the workplace for the entire duration of the employment.

Work in the beautiful Arctic North. Tenon Luonnontuote is located in Nuorgam, the northernmost village in Finland and the European Union, right next to the Norwegian border.

Working in Nuorgam offers a unique opportunity to experience the beautiful Arctic nature, spectacular landscapes, outdoor activities and, as autumn progresses, the possibility of seeing the Northern Lights.

title: Vapaaehtoistoiminnan verkoston koordinaattori (Päijät-Häme)
description:

description:

Lastenvastaavana työskentelet osana moniammatillista kurssitiimiä ja vastaat yhdessä lastenohjaajien kanssa lasten ryhmätoiminnan suunnittelusta, toteutuksesta ja sujuvuudesta kurssin aikana. Voit tutustua toimintaamme osoitteessa allergia.fi/kurssit.

- toimit yhteyshenkilönä vanhemmille lasten toimintaan liittyvissä asioissa

- joustavaa ja yhteistyökykyistä työotetta

- oma-aloitteisuutta ja ongelmanratkaisukykyä.


**Työsuhde**

Työ on määräaikaista ja kurssikohtaista. Työ sijoittuu pääasiassa viikonloppuihin, jolloin sinulle kustannetaan majoitus ja täysihoito. Viikonlopun kurssityö ajoittuu yleensä perjantaista klo 14.30 – sunnuntaihin klo 15.00. Kurssityötä voi tehdä mielenkiinnon mukaan keskimäärin 2–5 kurssia vuodessa. Työaika ja palkkio määräytyvät kurssin ohjelman mukaisesti.

Työt alkavat keväällä 2027 tai mahdollisuuksien mukaan jo 2026 aikana.

**_Vuoden 2027 kurssien toteutuspaikat määräytyvät julkisen kilpailutuksen perusteella. Vuoden 2027 kurssipaikat ovat tiedossa syksyn 2026 aikana._**

**Muuta huomioitavaa**

Tehtävässä työskennellään lasten kanssa, ja valitulta edellytetään rikosrekisteriotteen esittämistä ennen työsuhteen alkua ja EA1®-todistuksen voimassaoloa. Tarvittaessa kustannamme ensiapukoulutuksen.

title: Senior Research Fellow / Yliopistotutkija (Suffering and Meliorism in Literature and the Philosophy of Literature, within the Centre of Excellence in Meliorist Philosophy of Suffering)
description:
Tampere University and Tampere University of Applied Sciences create a unique environment for multidisciplinary, inspirational, and high-impact research and education. Our universities community has its competitive edges in technology, health, and society. www.tuni.fi/en

[The Faculty of Social Sciences](https://www.tuni.fi/en/about-us/faculty-social-sciences)at Tampere University invites applications for a fixed-term Senior Research Fellow position in literary studies and/or philosophy of literature for a two-year period starting in January 2027 (or as agreed).

The position is open within the Centre of Excellence in Meliorist Philosophy of Suffering (MePhiS), funded by the Research Council of Finland, and its research team Suffering and Meliorism in Literature and the Philosophy of Literature. Among the five research teams of MePhiS, four are hosted by the Faculty of Theology at the University of Helsinki, while the team Suffering and Meliorism in Literature and the Philosophy of Literature is hosted by the Faculty of Social Sciences at Tampere University. The Centre offers a supportive and inspiring research environment and excellent opportunities for researchers to develop their careers in an international and interdisciplinary setting. More information about MePhiS is available at: www.helsinki.fi/mephis .

MePhiS engages in philosophical and interdisciplinary scholarship that places the concept of suffering at the centre of philosophical reflection and offers conceptual and argumentative tools for a deeper understanding of human engagement with affliction, starting from the meliorist (Lat. melior, better) idea that the world can and should be made better through active human efforts. According to meliorism, a positive outcome is neither guaranteed (optimism) nor impossible (pessimism).

The research group on Suffering and Meliorism in Literature and the Philosophy of Literature within MePhiS focuses on literary studies and the philosophy of literature as pathways to a meliorist philosophy of suffering. We take seriously the idea that literature can articulate philosophical questions and shape peoples ways of experiencing, expressing, and coping with suffering. The group critically examines writers and literary traditions associated with optimism, pessimism, and/or meliorism, and analyses literary works that reflect societal anxieties as well as human or non-human suffering arising from war, violence, poverty, marginalisation, the climate crisis, and related challenges. We also investigate how philosophers draw on literature in developing ethical responses to suffering.

Position

Towards these ends, we invite applications for a Senior Research Fellow with a background in literary studies and/or philosophy of literature with demonstrated interest in advancing research in these fields.

The Senior Research Fellow will be responsible for

- investigating representations of suffering and meliorism in literary and philosophical contexts;
- developing literary and philosophical analyses of ethical responses to suffering;
- authoring scholarly publications on the research topic;
- collaborating with other members of the Centre of Excellence, including through joint publications and other research activities; and
- contributing to teaching and administrative duties, amounting to approximately 5-10% of the working time.

Qualifications

We seek candidates with expertise in literary studies and/or philosophy of literature who are interested in advancing the research aims described above. Applicants must hold a doctoral degree in a relevant field within the humanities or social sciences (e.g., literary studies, philosophy) and have a demonstrated track record of high-quality research and international publications. A Senior Research Fellow typically has at least ca. five years of postdoctoral experience. In addition, applicants should possess the ability to lead a research group, a track record of securing external research funding, and the teaching skills required to successfully perform the duties and responsibilities of the position.

Familiarity with the topics of suffering, optimism, pessimism, or meliorism in literature and philosophy, as well as experience in combining literary studies with philosophical inquiry, will be considered an advantage.

The selected candidate should be capable of conducting independent research at a high international level and able to work both independently and collaboratively as a member of the research team. The working language of MePhiS is English, and excellent written and oral communication skills in English are required.

Applicants should be prepared to provide proof of their qualifications upon request. Please do not submit AI-generated proposals.

The position is fixed-term for two years starting in January 2027 or as agreed. A six-month trial period applies to all new employees at Tampere University.

The salary will be based on [the University Salary System](https://www.sivista.fi/esittely/in-english/general-collective-agreement-for-universities/). The salary of a Senior Research Fellow is at levels 6-7. In addition to the basic salary, a performance-based salary component is paid according to the appointees qualifications and experience. The starting salary (level 6) is approximately EUR 4,700-4,900 per month.

The appointee is expected to reside in Finland while employed by Tampere University. Tampere University is an internationally renowned research university offering a wide range of staff benefits, including occupational health care, flexible working hours, and excellent campus sports facilities. Please read more about [working at Tampere University](https://www.tuni.fi/en/tau/work-with-us?navref=footer). International staff are supported in relocating to Finland.

title: 1-2 Doctoral Researchers in literary studies or history / 1-2 Väitöskirjatutkijaa kirjallisuustieteessä tai historiassa (The Verses of Learning: Epideixis and the Cultural Stories of Nature at Early Modern Universities, VERSITAS project)
description:
Tampere University and Tampere University of Applied Sciences create a unique environment for multidisciplinary, inspirational, and high-impact research and education. Our universities community has its competitive edges in technology, health, and society. www.tuni.fi/en

[The Faculty of Social Sciences](https://www.tuni.fi/en/about-us/faculty-social-sciences) at Tampere University invites applications for

1-2 Doctoral Researchers in literary studies or history. The duration of employment is determined by the progress of the doctoral studies and thesis work and is limited up to a maximum of four years, starting in January 2027 or as agreed.

The positions are open within Academy Professor Sari Kivistös project, [The Verses of Learning: Epideixis and the Cultural Stories of Nature at Early Modern Universities (VERSITAS)](https://projects.tuni.fi/versitas/in-english/), funded by the Research Council of Finland (2026-2031). The project examines the relationships between poetry, rhetoric, and nature in the early modern period, as well as their roots and continuities in earlier and later centuries. Myths and cultural narratives were an important part of early modern natural history and shaped experiences of nature. The project argues that understanding nature from a cultural perspective requires attention to the literary forms, genres, and rhetorical strategies through which it was represented. Through the study of scientific writing and occasional literature from the early modern period and adjacent centuries, we investigate how literary and stylistic devices shape relationships between humans and nature. Based in the Faculty of Social Sciences at Tampere University, the project offers a supportive and inspiring working environment, as well as excellent opportunities for researchers to advance their skills and careers.

Positions and Qualifications

We are seeking promising doctoral researchers with a masters degree in a relevant field within the humanities (e.g., literary studies, rhetoric and its history, book history, intellectual history, or classical studies). Applicants will be assessed primarily on the suitability of their proposed research topic to the projects aims and its potential to produce research of high international standard. Knowledge of early modern literature and/or history, as well as experience working with historical texts and archival materials, will be considered an asset. Possible dissertation topics include historical studies of nature, human-animal studies, and ecocritical approaches to pre-modern and early modern literature, with potential scope for transhistorical perspectives. Familiarity with the history of rhetoric or occasional poetry will also be considered an advantage.

The doctoral researchers will be responsible for writing a doctoral dissertation related to the projects research themes and completing the credits required for the doctoral degree. They will collaborate with the research team in organizing joint events and participating in other academic activities. The appointed researchers will contribute to teaching and administrative duties for up to 5% of their working time.

The selected candidates must apply for and be admitted to Tampere Universitys [Doctoral Programme in Literary Studies](https://www.tuni.fi/en/tau/doctoral-programmes/doctoral-programme-literary-studies) or [Doctoral Programme in History](https://www.tuni.fi/en/tau/doctoral-programmes/doctoral-programme-history) during the autumn semester of 2026. The application period for these programmes runs from 1 to 30 October 2026.

We offer

The positions are fixed term for four years (or a shorter period, depending on the stage of the dissertation) and will begin in January 2027 or as agreed. A six-month trial period applies to all new employees at Tampere University.

Salary is based on [the University Salary System](https://www.sivista.fi/esittely/in-english/general-collective-agreement-for-universities/). Doctoral Researchers are placed on levels 2-4 of the salary scale. In addition to the basic salary, a performance-based salary component is paid according to the appointees qualifications and experience. The starting salary is approximately €2,700 per month and will increase as the doctoral studies progress.

The appointees are expected to reside in Finland during their employment at Tampere University. Tampere University is an internationally renowned research university offering a wide range of staff benefits, including occupational health care, flexible working hours, and excellent campus sports facilities. Please read more about [working at Tampere University](https://www.tuni.fi/en/tau/work-with-us) and explore our [Career Stories.](https://www.tuni.fi/en/tau/work-with-us/career-stories)

For more information about Tampere, please see [VisitTampere](https://visittampere.fi/en/). For further information about Finland, please visit [InfoFinland](https://www.infofinland.fi/)and [This is Finland](https://finland.fi/).

How to apply

Applications must be submitted in English through Tampere Universitys electronic recruitment system (link below). The closing date for applications is 11 September 2026 (at 23:59/UTC+3). Online interviews with shortlisted candidates will be held on 22 and 23 September 2026.

Please attach the following documents to your application:

1) CV (max. 3 pages, including a list of publications, if applicable, and the contact details of the supervisor of your masters thesis)

2) Reference letter from the prospective supervisor of the doctoral dissertation (if external to the research team)

3) Preliminary research proposal (max. 3 pages), including

- a description of your previous research experience (e.g., your masters thesis);
- a research idea outlining why the projects themes or approach interest you and how you would position your doctoral research within this context;
- a timeline for your doctoral studies.

Please be prepared to provide proof of your qualifications upon request. Please do not submit AI-generated research proposals.

Enquiries

For further information about the position, please contact the project PI, Academy Professor Sari Kivistö, sari.kivisto(at)tuni.fi.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
**Help Engineers Solve Real-World Technical Problems Across Europe from Porvoo, Finland**

At Thermetrics Europe, we support engineers, researchers, manufacturers, and technical organizations with precision thermal and moisture measurement technology, application expertise, service, calibration, and technical support.

We may be a young European company, but we are not starting from scratch. We have more than 40 years of Thermetrics technology, engineering experience, and industry knowledge behind us.

We're now building the next stage of Thermetrics Europe, and we're looking for a **Technical Support Engineer – Service & Support** to join our growing team in Porvoo, Finland (you must be already located in Southern Finland).

**The Role**

This is a hands-on, varied engineering role. You'll provide technical support to customers, assemble and test our products in Porvoo, travel throughout Europe for installations and service, troubleshoot equipment, perform calibrations, train customers, and help them get the most from their Thermetrics systems.

You'll also work closely with our engineering team in the US, bringing customer and field experience back into product development and continuous improvement. No two days will look exactly the same. You might be troubleshooting a system remotely in the morning, preparing equipment for shipping items in the afternoon, and traveling to a customer site the following week.

Travel is approximately **25% or less**, throughout Europe, occasionally including trips to outside Europe as well.

**Help Build the Support Team**

We're building our European support organization as we grow, which means this isn't a role where every process is already written and every responsibility has been neatly assigned. There will be trial and error, problem solving, and plenty of wearing different hats.

You'll have opportunities to help develop service procedures, documentation, customer support processes, training materials, and new ways of working. Sometimes you'll be doing the technical work. Sometimes you'll be helping figure out how the technical work should be done.

We're looking for someone who enjoys that kind of environment.

You don't need to know everything on day one. You do need to be curious, willing to learn, comfortable asking questions, and able to look at a problem and say: "We haven't done this before. Let's figure it out."

**Team Player. Independent Problem Solver.**

You'll be part of a small, collaborative team, but field service also requires you to be comfortable working independently.

When you're at a customer site, you may be the technical person in the room. You'll need to assess the situation, troubleshoot on the go, make good decisions, communicate clearly, and keep working toward a solution even when conditions aren't perfect.

We're looking for someone who:

- Works well as part of a small team.

- Can work independently in the field.

- Enjoys hands-on troubleshooting and problem solving.

- Stays calm when things don't go according to plan.

- Takes ownership of problems and follows them through to resolution.

- Knows when to solve a problem independently and when to reach out for help.

- Is willing to pitch in wherever needed as the company grows.

- Communicates well with both technical and non-technical customers.


**What You'll Bring**

**Required:**

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Engineering Technology, Physics, or a related technical field.

- At least 2 years of experience with scientific instrumentation, laboratory equipment, automated equipment, engineered products, field service, commissioning, or technical support.

- Strong mechanical and electrical troubleshooting skills.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- A practical, hands-on approach to technical problem solving.

- Ability and willingness to travel up to 25% internationally, mostly alone

- Ability to work independently while contributing to a collaborative international team.

- Native or professional working proficiency in English.

- Valid Driver's License


**Nice to have:**

- Experience with scientific instrumentation or laboratory equipment.

- Experience with thermal, environmental, textile, or PPE testing.

- Experience with calibration, validation, commissioning, or field service.

- Familiarity with SolidWorks, Python, Excel, Power BI, or similar tools.

- Finnish or Swedish language skills.


**Why Thermetrics Europe?**

You'll be joining a company with the technology and experience of an established global organization, while having the opportunity to help shape a young and growing European operation.

You'll work with advanced thermal testing technology, support customers across Europe, collaborate with experienced engineers internationally, and have a direct influence on how our European service and support organization develops.

This is a role for someone who wants to build, not just maintain.

If you enjoy solving real-world engineering problems, working with customers, troubleshooting in the field, and helping build something that is still taking shape, we'd like to hear from you.

**Location:** Porvoo, Finland (Itä-Uusimaa)

**Employment:** Full-time, with trial period

**Travel:** Up to 25%, mostly Europe

**Education**: Bachelors (Required)

**Language**: English, Professional or Native (Required), and Finnish/Swedish, Working (Preferred)

title: Vastaanoton vuoropäällikkö / Sunday Morning Resort, Pyhätunturi, Lappi, Suomi
description:
Monipuolinen vastaanottotyö tarjolla boutique-hotellissa Pyhätunturilla upeassa Lapin ympäristössä! Oletko sinä tiimimme puuttuva palanen?

**Työn kuvaus**

Haemme nyt vastaanoton vuoropäällikköä vahvistamaan tiimiämme Pyhätunturille, Sunday Morning Resortiin. Meillä tunturien hiljaisuus kohtaa huippuluokan palvelun.

Vastaanottomme on kaiken toiminnan sydämessä, joten tässä roolissa pääset osallistumaan monipuolisesti resort-kohteen toimintaan. **Toivomme sinulta vähintään kahden vuoden/sesongin mittaista kokemusta vastaanottotyöskentelystä tai vastaavasta asemasta eri aloilta.** Meillä monipuolisuus on rikkaus ja arvostamme erilaisia taustoja.

Vastaanottovirkailijan työtehtäviin kuuluvat monipuoliset asiakaspalvelutehtävät. Huolehdimme asiakkaistamme lämpimästi niin vastaanottotiskillä, sähköpostitse, puhelimitse kuin eri varauskanavienkin kautta. Vastaanoton perustehtäviin kuuluvat mm.

- Sisään- ja uloskirjaukset (Sunday Morning Resort & Parkside Pyhä)

- Majoitus- ja ohjelmapalveluvarausten hallinta (järjestelmien tarkistus, että esim. ohjelmapalvelut ja pöytävaraukset ovat täsmällisesti merkattu, tervetulokirjeiden teko, paikallisten aktiviteettien suosittelua ja esittelyä)

- Majoitus- ja ohjelmapalveluvarausten maksuista huolehtiminen (ennakkomaksut ja paikan päällä rahastus)

- Lisäpalveluiden myynti ja varausten teko

- OTA-kanavien varaushallinta, asiakasviestintä & lisämyynti

- (meillä käytössä Booking.com & Expedia Group)

- Läheinen ja saumaton yhteistyö eri osastojen välillä

- Vastaanoton yhteydessä toimivan pienen matkamuistomyymälän tuotteiden esillepanosta ja myynnistä huolehtiminen + kahvipisteen siisteydestä huolehtiminen

- Concierge/guest relations -työntekijän tuuraus tarvittaessa (uusi toimenkuva tulevalle talvikaudelle, sis. mm. lobby-barista ja huonetoimituksista huolehtiminen)

- Lisäksi avustat tarvittaessa esim. kokouspalveluissa tai siivouksessa.


**Vastaanoton vuoropäällikön tehtäviin kuuluvat lisäksi:**

- Vastaanoton sujuvan arjen varmistaminen yhdessä esihenkilön kanssa

- Vastuu päivän tapahtumista ja korkeasta palvelusta

- Maksujen tarkistus & järjestelmien päivitys

- Viikkotilitysten tarkistus

- Ryhmävarausten valmistelut

- Vastaanoton esihenkilön avustaminen hallinnollisissa tehtävissä tarpeen ja osaamisesi mukaan


Tiimisi koostuu 2- 3 vastaanottovirkailijasta/-vuoropäälliköstä, concierge/guest relations -työntekijästä sekä vastaanoton esihenkilöstä. Resortimme koon ollessa kompakti, toimimme lähtökohtaisesti vuoroissa itsenäisesti sesonkiaikojen huiput poislukien. Toivomme siis vastuullista otetta työntekoon, jossa vuorossa eteentulevat asiat hoidetaan rauhallisesti ja huolellisesti. Apu on kuitenkin aina lähellä ja perehdyspäivien aikana käymme resortin ja vastaanoton toiminnot huolellisesti läpi.

Toimimme tiiviissä yhteistyössä muiden osastojen (resortin johto, myynti, keittiö & ravintola, siivous, ohjelmapalvelut, huolto) kanssa laadukkaan palvelun varmistamiseksi. Lisäksi meillä on vastaanotossa työparina tekoälypohjainen assistentti Butler AI, jonka kautta osa asiakasviestinnästämme hoituu. Työssäsi pääset myös kehittämään ja kouluttamaan Butleria aina vain paremmaksi asiakaspalvelijaksi.

**Toivomme sinulta:**

- Soveltuvaa koulutusta (esim. hotellivirkailija, restonomi tms.) ja / tai työkokemusta vastaavasta työstä

- Aiempi kokemus hotellivarausjärjestelmistä on eduksi, muttei pakollinen. Perehdytämme sinut mielellämme myös järjestelmiin. Meillä käytössä ovat:

- Mews (majoitusvaraukset),

- Fareharbour (aktiviteetti- ja kuljetusvaraukset),

- ResDiary (ravintolavaraukset) sekä

- Profitroom (verkkosivusto ja Booking Engine).

- Lämminhenkistä palveluasennetta

- Kykyä työskennellä vastuuntuntoisesti sekä tiimin jäsenenä että yksin työvuoroissa

- Kykyä työskennellä tapahtumien keskipisteessä tyylikkään asiakaspalvelun säilyttäen monien asioiden tapahtuessa usein samanaikaisesti —> priorisointitaidot plussaa!

- Joustavuutta ja hyviä ongelmanratkaisukykyjä

- Sujuvaa suomen- ja englanninkielen taitoa - asiakkaamme saapuvat meille eri puolilta maailmaa. Muut kielet ovat plussaa, muttei pakollisia.

- Hygieniapassi ja anniskelupassi katsotaan eduksi

- Tärkeimpänä pidämme kuitenkin ennakkoluulotonta ja rohkeaa asennetta, kaiken voi aina oppia ja tässä tiimissä opimmekin yhdessä toinen toisiltamme.


**Tarjoamme sinulle:**

- Vastuullisen ja monipuolisen työn, jossa saat yhdistää asiakaspalvelun, myynnin ja majoituspalveluiden tehtäviä

- Mukavan, ammattitaitoisen ja tiiviin tiimin tuen sekä ainutlaatuisen työympäristön Pyhän tunturimaisemissa

- Mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi matkailu- ja majoitusalalla

- Työpaikan erinomaisella sijainnilla lähellä Pyhätunturin palveluita ja laskettelukeskusta

- Mahdollisuuden työntekijämajoitukseen edullisella vuokralla.

- Kattavan työterveyshuollon

- Yrityksellä 2 kpl Pyhän yrityskausikortteja käytettävissä laskettelusta innostuneille

- Mahdollisuuden työskennellä kestävän matkailun yrityksessä, joka on sertifioitu Sustainable Travel Finland -merkillä

- Mahdollisuuden osallistua kasvavan yrityksen kehittämistyöhön. Parannamme jatkuvasti tekemistämme henkilöstöltä ja asiakkailta saadun palautteen mukaan.


**Työsuhde**

Paikkoja on tarjolla yksi, kokoaikainen 37,5/h/vk eli 112,5/3vk. Aloitus marraskuun puolivälissä. Työsuhteen kesto arviolta maaliskuun puoleenväliin.

**Meistä**

Sunday Morning Collection tarjoaa korkeatasoisia aktiviteetteja ja elämyksiä Pyhä-Luoston kansallispuistossa. Talvikaudella järjestämme muun muassa sähkömoottorikelkkaretkiä, revontulielämyksiä, lumikenkäretkiä, pilkkiretkiä, farmivierailuja sekä muita luontoaktiviteetteja.

Sunday Morning Collectioniin kuuluvat myös Sunday Morning Resort, Parkside Pyhä lomahuoneistot sekä Ravintola Aihki. Yhdessä luomme vieraillemme aitoja, vastuullisia ja korkeatasoisia Lapin elämyksiä.

title: CNC-koneistaja / CNC-machinist
description:
CNC-koneistaja – Pohjois-Savo / CNC-Machinist, North-Savo, Finland

Etsimme asiakkaallemme CNC-koneistajaa Pohjois-Savoon Kaaville vakituiseen työsuhteeseen.

Asiakkaamme valmistaa koneistettuja komponentteja mm metsä- ja kaivosteollisuuden koneisiin, kuten polttoaine- ja hydrauliikkasäiliöihin. Tuotanto on monipuolista ja valmistettavien kappaleiden koko vaihtelee – tuotannossa on sekä pieniä sarjoja että yksittäisiä kappaleita.


Työtehtävät

Työskentelet monipuolisesti CNC-koneistuksen parissa. Tehtäviisi kuuluvat muun muassa:

* CNC-koneiden käyttö ja asetukset
* kappaleiden koneistus teknisten piirustusten ja mitoitusvaatimusten mukaisesti
* työkalujen ja työstöarvojen määrittäminen
* kappaleiden mittaus ja laadun varmistaminen
* koneiden asetusten ja työkalujen vaihtaminen
* tarvittaessa useamman koneen samanaikainen käyttö

Kaikissa koneissa ohjelmointi ja koneistus perustuvat ISO-/G-koodiin.


Työstökoneet ovat vaaka- ja pystykaraisia. Ohjaimina Haas, Fanuc ja Mazatrol. Työstökoneiden lisäksi osaaminen sorvilla eduksi (Y-akselillisista CNC-sorveista, vastakarasta, tankolaitteista).


Odotamme sinulta

* vähintään 2 vuoden työkokemusta CNC-koneistuksesta
* kokemusta CNC-työstökeskuksista (osaaminen sorveista eduksi)
* ISO-/G-koodin hallintaa
* kykyä lukea teknisiä piirustuksia
* mittavälineiden sujuvaa käyttöä
* huolellista ja itsenäistä työskentelyotetta
* valmiutta työskennellä 2-vuorossa
* hyvää työmotivaatiota ja halua kehittyä koneistajana
* Fanuc-, Haas- ja/tai Mazatrol-ohjausten tuntemus


Tarjoamme

* vakituisen ja kokoaikaisen työsuhteen
* työajan 40 h/vko, 2-vuorotyössä
* palkkauksen teknologiateollisuuden työehtosopimuksen mukaan, alkaen 14,87 €/h brutto + vuorolisät
* mahdollisuuden työaikapankin hyödyntämiseen
* edullisen työasunnon mahdollisuuden
* monipuolisen ja nykyaikaisen konekannan
* mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa osaamista ja työskennellä erilaisten CNC-koneiden parissa

Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan mahdollisimman pian.

Jos olet kokenut CNC-koneistaja ja haluat työskennellä monipuolisessa tuotantoympäristössä, lähetä meille hakemuksesi!
**



CNC Machinist – North Savo

We are looking for an experienced CNC Machinist for our client in Kaavi,North Savo, Finland.

Our client manufactures machined components for the forestry and mining industries, including fuel and hydraulic tanks. Production is varied, with different component sizes and both small batches and individual pieces.

The workplace is located approximately 60 km from Kuopio.


Your responsibilities

Your work will include a wide range of CNC machining tasks, such as:

* operating and setting CNC machines
* machining components according to technical drawings and specified dimensions
* setting tools and machining parameters
* measuring components and ensuring quality
* changing tools and making machine adjustments
* operating several machines simultaneously when required

All machines are operated using ISO/G-code.


Horizontal and vertical Machining centres, with Haas, Fanuc- and Mazatrol controllers. Experience with CNC Lathes is advantage (Y-axis CNC lathes, sub-spindles, bar feeders)


What we expect from you

* at least 2 years of experience in CNC machining
* experience with machining centres (experience with CNC lathes is advantage)
* good knowledge of ISO/G-code
* ability to read and understand technical drawings
* ability to use measuring tools
* accurate and independent working style
* willingness to work in a 2-shift system
* good motivation and willingness to develop your machining skills
* Knowledge of Fanuc, Haas and/or Mazatrol controls


We offer

* a permanent, full-time employment contract
* working hours of 40 hours/week in a 2-shift system
* salary according to the Technology Industry Collective Agreement, starting from €14.87/hour gross + shift allowances
* possibility to use a working time bank
* affordable work-related accommodation
* a modern and versatile machine park
* an opportunity to develop your skills and work with a wide range of CNC machines

The work can start as soon as possible, according to agreement.

If you are an experienced CNC Machinist looking for a versatile position with modern CNC equipment, send us your application!

title: Night receptionist, Star Arctic Hotel, Saariselkä, Lapland
description:

Your diverse responsibilities include guest check-ins and check-outs for high-quality accommodation, processing reports, providing customer service, and preparing for the following day. During your shift, you will work independently and be responsible for ensuring the smooth operation of the hotel throughout the night. We are looking for candidates with previous front desk experience, an independent approach to work, and fluent English language skills. You will work as part of international team - Finnish language skills are not required.

Full-time employment, 90h/3 weeks, starts with orientation in Mid-November 2026 and lasts til March-April 2027. Terms of employment are following the Finnish Collective agreement for hotel- and restaurant industry. Salary according to the agreement. Employment contract will be between Bondata and employee. Shared accommodation in Saariselkä will be organized by the company for a reasonable rent.

What we offer:

- Unique work place on top of Kaunispää fell

- Good orientation for the work tasks and support from your team

- Possibility to develop your professional skills

- Bondata support during your employment

title: HSE Specialist
description:
At Grid & Power Quality Solutions and Service business at Hitachi Energy in Europe (HBUEU), Inclusion drives our culture of innovation and collaboration. Our leading technology and strong market position enable us to achieve growth targets in the energy transition across current and growing market segments such as data centers, hydrogen and e-mobility.

Join Our Team!

We are looking for a HSE Specialist to join our HSE Team in Vaasa, Finland. In this role, you will support our Finnish projects in the Nordic Operation Unit (OU) and focus on the HSE tasks in the HSE department and throughout the projects life cycle. You will be ensuring that the highest standards of health, safety and environmental performance are documented, monitored and maintained. You will also be driving continuous improvement in all areas of HSE.

The Nordic OU HSE Team is a network of experienced health, safety and environmental professionals supporting the delivery of complex construction, energy and industrial projects across Finland, Sweden and Denmark. We support highly skilled site teams in delivering world-class projects through professionalism, quality and operational excellence, creating environments where safety is the natural outcome of doing the job right. Working closely with project management, customers and contractors, we provide expertise and practical support throughout the project lifecycle. Our focus is on enabling disciplined planning, effective risk management and high-quality execution that protects people, enhances performance and strengthens project outcomes.

Our strength lies in our people. We bring together talented professionals with experience from the energy sector, industrial construction and major infrastructure projects. We value expertise, integrity and a willingness to take initiative. We are a team that shares knowledge openly, learns from each other and works together to solve challenges in demanding project environments. We welcome individuals from diverse professional backgrounds who are motivated by continuous development and a desire to make a meaningful impact.

We believe that excellence comes from combining technical competence with personal accountability. We encourage constructive challenge, transparent communication and the confidence to speak up when improvements can be made. By maintaining high professional standards and supporting one another, we help project teams achieve results while protecting people, the environment and the long-term success of our projects.

We challenge established practices and continuously look for better ways to manage risk, support project teams and improve performance. Through innovation, digitalization and intelligent use of technology, we advance how decisions are made and how projects are executed. We do not simply adapt to change; we actively shape the future of HSE by turning new ideas into practical solutions that enable safer, smarter and more efficient project delivery.

If you are motivated by complex projects, enjoy working with skilled professionals and want to help shape the future of HSE in the energy and construction industries, you will fit right in with our team.

**How you'll make an impact**

- Implement and work with continuous improvement of Hitachi Energy operating unit management system and local requirements in Finland for the operating unit of the Nordic OU.

- Prepare and update HSE documentation in accordance with the internal process. Submit all preliminary HSE plans to the customer in accordance with the tender submission dates.

- Attend clarification meetings and workshops with the customer (both in person and remotely).

- Prepare the Project HSE Plan as well as other HSE-related documentation such as the Emergency Preparedness and Response Plan.

- Ensure activities under the scope of Hitachi Energy are in compliance with legal and contractual HSE requirements as well as internal HSE requirements.

- Produce reports for Project Reviews, both internal and customer, and attend the Project Review meetings to ensure the Hitachi Energy HSE Operating System remains suitable, adequate, and effective.

- Review HSE documentation from all Hitachi Energy subcontractors and support subcontractors to meet internal and Project HSE requirements.


**Your background**

- Previous experience of HSE tasks in projects

- Professional HSE certification is seen as a plus

- Knowledge of ISO 45001 and ISO 14001 certifications

- Strong organizational and communication skills with the ability to operate within global teams

- Self-driven and persistent attitude towards challenges. You work actively and professionally both independently and as a part of a team.

- Excellent written and spoken communication skills in English and Finnish. Swedish is seen as a plus.

In this role, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining robust, dynamic project schedules that align with contractual commitments and provide a clear framework for successful project execution.

You will work closely with various stakeholders making sure the project schedules are used for work coordination, predictable forecasting, proactive schedule risk management, cost management, resource management, and of course, team alignment. At Hitachi Energy, we know that great results are achieved together. · Support and prepare What-if schedule scenarios, delay mitigation plans and Extension of Time (EoT) claims together with the project team

· Drive the use and continuous improvement of planning and scheduling methodologies and tools

· M.Sc. or B.Sc. in Electrical engineering or another relevant field

· Proven experience in planning and scheduling complex projects

· Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to engage, motivate, and inspire stakeholders across the project organization

· Advanced proficiency in Primavera P6 and good knowledge of schedule management theory

· The ability to prepare and maintain high quality, dynamic project schedules together with the project team

· A proactive and self-driven mindset, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability

· A structured and goal-oriented approach to your work, with a focus on delivering results

· Project Management Certificate (PMP® and/or PMI-SP®) is considered an advantage

· Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; knowledge of Finnish and/or Swedish is considered a plus

title: Christmas Operations Coordinator, Lapland Safaris Saariselkä
description:
**Lapland Staff is looking for Christmas Operations Coordinators for the Christmas season 2026 in Saariselkä and Rovaniemi.**

The duties focus on handling and organizing the safari programs for charter flight travelers. The coordinators form a team who manage the Christmas Operations as a whole, with the operators daily schedule being its core. This includes, for example, transportation scheduling, cooperation with tour operators, and management of bookings for various safaris with our suppliers. The Christmas Operations Coordinator mainly works as part of a team, but must also be capable of independent work, and if necessary, also acts as a guide.

We expect you to have an active and energetic attitude, a suitable education, and previous work experience within the tourism field in Lapland, as well as a flexible and firm approach to handling tasks. Excellent interpersonal skills are required as you will be guiding other team members in their work. December is a very busy travel month, so we also hope for problem-solving ability and the ability to work under pressure. The work environment is international, so you must have fluent verbal and written English skills. Knowledge of Finnish language is a big advantage in this position. Other language skills and previous experience in guiding work and providing tourism services are considered an advantage.

You will be working with international groups of guests, consisting of families with children. Your job is to make sure that all guests, children, and grown-ups are having a day full of joy and fun. The work is mostly independent, but at the same time you are a part of a big team which works in the same area.

Outdoor Activity Workers work during the busiest Christmas season, which means that working days are hectic and sometimes can be long. The length of the days varies according to the group and the program. The work includes preparation of the activity area and different kinds of maintenance work, as well as cleaning the area after the end of the day. The important task of providing clothing for our guests can also be your responsibility, as well as clothing maintenance.

Your English language skills do not have to be excellent, but you need to be able to give instructions to our guests in English and at least briefly answer their questions or direct the questions to another colleague. In Hetta, providing clothing to the guests and clothing maintenance plays a big role in the Outdoor Activity workers daily routines and work tasks.

title: Early Childhood Education Teacher, Daycare Aurinkokello, North Sámi-speaking group, Keski-Pasila
description:
We are looking for an Early Childhood Education Teacher for Aurinkokellos North Sámi-speaking group!

A wonderful new daycare centre, Aurinkokello, has been completed in Keski-Pasila, and operations began in August 2025. Early childhood education and pre-primary education services are being introduced gradually in the new unit. The position can also be performed on a part-time basis.

Suotnjarat is a sibling group for children aged 2-6 with a teacher and a carer working as a team. The group follows both the Helsinki Early Childhood Education Plan and the Sámi Early Childhood Education Plan. The goal of Sámi-language early childhood education is to support the childs growth into an independent, responsible, and social individual, as well as to foster the development of their language skills.

A childs proficiency in both languages becomes strong when they follow the immersion path throughout their entire educational journey up to the end of basic education. The group collaborates regularly with both a Finnish-language pre-primary education group and the Sámi class at Pasila Comprehensive School, providing pre-primary-aged children with opportunities to meet and engage in shared activities with children from other pre-primary groups.

Aurinkokello operates in the same building as Pasila Comprehensive School, enabling excellent cooperation along the childs educational path and the natural shared use of facilities. The daycare centre is very easy to reach, with excellent tram, bus, train and cycling connections.


What do we expect from you?

We hope that your work demonstrates strong basic pedagogical skills in everyday practice and a sensitive approach to meeting children. We expect you to understand the importance of play in a childs development and learning. You recognize that play is part of the adults responsibilities, you are a playful adult, and you make use of playfulness in various everyday situations. The facilities and learning materials at Aurinkokello are designed to invite play, so we expect you, as an adult, to take responsibility for continuously shaping and developing the play environment.

At Aurinkokello, you will work as part of a multidisciplinary team. We hope you have the motivation and attitude to develop practices in a new environment and within an evolving operational culture. You are open to experimenting with your team and suggesting changes that support a smooth and positive everyday experience for both children and adults. The daycare centre director and assistant director provide strong pedagogical support to the staff and are committed to creating the conditions that enable employees to succeed in their work.

Interested? If Aurinkokello sounds like your next workplace, don't wait - send us your application today. We will personally contact all candidates selected for an interview.

You will also support each childs individual learning in accordance with the Helsinki Early Childhood Education and Pre-primary Education Curriculum, the units operational plan, and the childs individual early childhood education plan.

Why Join Us?

It is important to us that you are able to do meaningful work that contributes to a good life for everyone in Helsinki. We want you to succeed and feel inspired in your work. We offer a wide range of opportunities for professional growth and development. According to our latest staff survey, our employees enjoy working here and find their work meaningful.

Eligibility may also be demonstrated through a recognition decision issued by the Finnish National Agency for Education, confirming that your foreign qualification provides eligibility for the position.

The main working language of the position is North Sámi. Good spoken proficiency in North Sámi is required. title: Outdoor Activity Worker, Lapland Safaris Saariselkä
description:
**Lapland Staff is looking for Outdoor Activity Workers for Lapland Safaris Saariselkä and Hetta for the Christmas season 2026.**

A workday of an Outdoor Activity Worker consists of various tasks including overseeing outdoor activities in a Christmas themed activity area surrounded by Lapland's beautiful nature. You will be working with international groups of guests, consisting of families with children. Your job is to make sure that all guests, children, and grown-ups are having a day full of joy and fun. The work is mostly independent, but at the same time you are a part of a big team which works in the same area.

Outdoor Activity Workers work during the busiest Christmas season, which means that working days are hectic and sometimes can be long. The length of the days varies according to the group and the program. The work includes preparation of the activity area and different kinds of maintenance work, as well as cleaning the area after the end of the day. The important task of providing clothing for our guests can also be your responsibility, as well as clothing maintenance.

Communication with guests is conducted mainly in English. Your English language skills do not have to be excellent, but you need to be able to give instructions to our guests in English and at least briefly answer their questions or direct the questions to another colleague. Other language skills, especially Spanish is very useful in Saariselkä. **In addition, please note that in order to work in Finland, EU-citizenship/passport or valid working permit to Finland is required. Please read more under the job advertisement**

**In Saariselkä** you will introduce tobogganing, mini-skidoo, kick-sledding or tandem skiing to our guests. You can also be working at the reindeer info, pancake-hut or at the warmup cabin. You might also work as a road crosser, when you make sure that the guests are crossing the road safely, either by snowmobile or by walking. In addition, your work tasks may include clothing and equipment maintenance.

**In Hetta** your workplace can be the toboggan slide or bobsleigh hill, you might be teaching the guests to drive the snowmobile, or you might be serving ginger breads in the snow castle and telling stories about the castle itself. You might also be part of the very important team that organizes the visits to Santa Claus himself. In Hetta, providing clothing to the guests and clothing maintenance plays a big role in the Outdoor Activity workers daily routines and work tasks.

**What we expect from you:**

- Energetic and outgoing character

- Flexibility and ability to handle pressure

- Good group management skills

- Christmas spirit and willingness to work with families, especially children


**What we offer you:**

- Great team and beautiful working surroundings

- Versatile and variable working days

- Easy way to experience arctic nature

- Comprehensive staff benefits of Lapland Hotels & Lapland Safaris. You will receive benefits for example from equipment rental, restaurants and Lapland Ski Resorts lift tickets.


Lapland Safaris provides new employees with paid, role-specific training at the beginning of their employment.

The employment relationship is a fixed term seasonal contract by the Collective Agreement in the Adventure Services sector. Work will begin in mid-November or at the end of November and will last approximately until the Christmas holidays in Hetta, and until the end of December 2026 in Saariselkä. Salary according to the Collective Agreement of Adventure Services grade A, hourly wage starting from 10,10 € (gross). Work will be done also during weekends and public holidays. Sundays and Finnish bank holidays are paid double. Accommodation is organized in shared rooms, with reasonable rent in comparison to the local price level.

Please note that Lapland Safaris is a non-smoking working place.

Interviews are conducted and hiring decisions are made already during the application period so apply soon!

For further information, please contact info@laplandstaff.fi

**In addition, please note that in order to work in Finland, EU-citizenship/passport or valid working permit to Finland is required.**

If you need a work permit or visa for Finland, **we must be able to process your application in time** due to the length of the permit process. You can check your work permit requirements here: https://migri.fi/en/home

The employee pays and applies for the work permit themselves, with the assistance of Lapland Staff. Please submit your job application to us before the following dates:

Work permit for seasonal work (whole winter season, over 3 months in Finland): **10.8.**

Visa: **10.8.**

Certificate for seasonal work (Christmas season, less than 3 months in Finland): **10.9.**

title: Travel Agency Clerk
description:
We are looking for a Travel Agency Clerk to join our team.

Your main responsibilities will include handling incoming travel requests and bookings from our international partner agencies, primarily from the USA, Europe, GCC and CIS countries. The role also includes communication with customers and partners, coordinating transfers and other travel arrangements, managing bookings and customer information in CRM systems, and offering suitable travel and holiday products to existing partner agencies.

**Main responsibilities:**

- handling reservations and travel arrangements

- customer service and responding to customer enquiries

- communication with hotels, transport providers and other partners

- preparing and processing travel-related documents

- coordinating travel services and bookings

- assisting with other daily travel agency operations


**Requirements**

- Relevant education or ongoing studies in tourism, travel or hospitality

- Previous work experience in the tourism industry, including experience with a travel agency or tour operator

- Experience in using CRM systems

- Fluent English language skills, as the position involves regular communication with international partner agencies and customers. Knowledge of other European languages is considered an advantage

- Good Russian language skills, as the position involves regular communication with Russian-speaking customers, including the coordination of transfers and other travel arrangements

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to communicate professionally with customers, partners and colleagues

- Good computer skills, including Microsoft Word and Excel

- Strong sales and customer service skills, including the ability to handle challenging customer and sales situations

- A results-oriented approach and the ability to work in a target-driven environment

- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage several tasks simultaneously

- Ability to work independently and take responsibility for assigned tasks

- Willingness and ability to travel for business when required


Please send your CV in English to elena@easytravel.eu

We offer a permanent part-time employment contract with a guaranteed working time of 99 hours per three-week period. Working hours are primarily scheduled on weekday mornings, Monday to Friday. The work is performed on-site at the office and is not a remote position. The hourly wage is €12.65.

The application period is 14–27 August 2026. Applications will be reviewed and interviews will begin already during the application period.

For further information: elena@easytravel.eu

title: Responsable de projet "Filières de réemploi solidaire" - LaCollecte.tech (H/F)
description:
Ces dernières années, la lutte contre l'illectronisme est devenue une cause nationale comparable à la lutte contre l'illettrisme, car la dématérialisation s'accélère et impacte tous les aspects du quotidien : renouveler ses papiers d'identité, chercher un logement, accéder à ses droits. bien souvent, tout cela n'est plus possible sans internet.
Pour les personnes en précarité sociale qui ne sont pas équipées ou n'ont pas les compétences nécessaires, c'est une double peine : déjà marginalisées, elles sont coupées de la plupart des services essentiels. Leur accompagnement vers plus d'autonomie numérique est notre combat quotidien.
Créée en 2013 et membre du mouvement Emmaüs, l'association Emmaüs Connect a redonné le pouvoir d'agir à plus de 135 000 personnes en difficulté sociale et numérique grâce à une équipe d'une centaine de salariés épaulée par plus de 1500 bénévoles sur 19 territoires d'action.
Nous agissons de 3 manières : en fournissant des moyens de connexion et équipements à tarifs solidaires, en accompagnant les personnes en difficulté sur les usages de base, et en formant des professionnels de l'action sociale aux pratiques de l'inclusion numérique
LaCollecte.tech en 2025, c'est 52 000 équipements collectés et 42 000 distribués, grâce à un travail de partenariats et à des acteurs solidaires engagés unis autour d'une vision partagée.
Après 6 années de développement intensif, d'ancrage territorial et de structuration sous l'impulsion de sa responsable historique, le projet LaCollecte.tech franchit une nouvelle étape. Pour prendre la suite, nous recherchons notre Responsable du pôle "Filières de réemploi solidaire".

Vos missions :
1. Vision stratégique, cadre national et pilotage par l'impact (30%)
- Définir la trajectoire de croissance : Traduire les orientations stratégiques d'Emmaüs Connect en une feuille de route opérationnelle exigeante et mesurable pour LaCollecte.tech.

- Pilotage : Suivre et faire parler les indicateurs clés de performance (KPIs d'activité, de flux et d'impact social/économique et environnemental) pour guider les arbitrages stratégiques.

- Remontée d'alertes et alignement : Anticiper les points de blocage, les risques ou dérives, et formuler des propositions d'arbitrage et des plans d'action correctifs.

- Instance de décision et co-construction : Animer et impulser des temps de co-construction avec le CODIR et les responsables régionaux

- Consolidation et développement des alliances : Nouer des partenariats stratégiques d'envergure nationale permettant de promouvoir, soutenir et de défendre le modèle du réemploi numérique solidaire.

2. Consolidation opérationnelle et performance financière (30%)
- Industrialisation du modèle : Poursuivre l'optimisation des processus du projet et sécuriser le changement d'échelle en vous appuyant sur votre équipe.

- Pilotage budgétaire et ressources : Garantir la rigueur budgétaire et optimiser l'allocation des ressources.

- Recherche de fonds : Appuyer la recherche de financements en valorisant les chiffres d'impact du pôle. Participer au développement et à la négociation des conventions grands comptes

- Pilotage des projets stratégiques: Valider les budgets, plans d'action et équipes projets. En fin de projet, valider la qualité des livrables, les reporting financier et narratif.

3. Management, leadership et cadre d'équipe (20%)
- Management direct de l'équipe siège: Encadrer, responsabiliser et faire monter en compétences  4 chefs de projet (équipes produit, communs et coopération, formation et coordination des filières)

- Animation élargie LaCollecte.tech : Fédérer le réseau des responsables régionaux autour d'une vision d'ensemble, en maintenant un haut niveau d'exigence et une dynamique collective porteuse de sens.

- Management inspirant: Incarner un leadership décisionnel, rassurant et structurant.

4. Alliances nationales stratégiques, plaidoyer et incarnation (20%)
- Incarnation: représenter le projet LaCollecte.tech lors d'instances stratégiques externes, de représentations publiques, de tables rondes ou d'interviews.

- Plaidoyer: Porter la vision du réemploi numérique solidaire et les enjeux de plaidoyer en vous appuyant sur des données probantes et incontestables, ainsi que sur la force des all
