title: Concepteur(rice) de formations e-learning & Administrateur(rice) LMS (m/f)
description:
1. Présentation d'Easy Learning

Easy Learning est un organisme de formation professionnelle continue agréé au Luxembourg. La société conçoit et propose des formations réglementaires, des parcours e-learning et des micro-learnings destinés aux entreprises et à leurs collaborateurs.

Les formations associent contenus théoriques, cas pratiques, quiz, animations et évaluations afin d'offrir
une expérience pédagogique concrète, dynamique et adaptée aux besoins des apprenants.

2. Finalité du poste

Le ou la titulaire du poste conçoit, produit, intègre et actualise les formations e-learning d'Easy Learning. La fonction comprend également l'administration quotidienne des apprenants sur la plateforme, le suivi de leur progression, l'assistance aux utilisateurs et la préparation des rapports destinés aux entreprises clientes.

3. Responsabilités principales

3.1 Analyse des besoins de formation

• Recueillir et analyser les besoins des clients et des experts métiers ;
• Identifier les publics cibles, les compétences attendues et les objectifs d'apprentissage ;
• Proposer une structure pédagogique adaptée au sujet et au profil des apprenants ;
• Participer à la planification des projets de formation ;
• Déterminer les méthodes d'apprentissage et d'évaluation appropriées.

3.2 Conception pédagogique

• Transformer les contenus techniques, réglementaires ou professionnels en parcours pédagogiques clairs et structurés ;
• Rédiger les scénarios pédagogiques, storyboards et scripts des formations ;
• Concevoir des modules, chapitres, micro-learnings, cas pratiques, quiz et évaluations ;
• Simplifier les contenus complexes tout en préservant leur exactitude ;
• Veiller à la cohérence entre les objectifs, les contenus et les évaluations.

3.3 Production des formations e-learning

• Produire les contenus à l'aide des outils auteurs e-learning ;
• Créer ou intégrer des textes, illustrations, schémas, animations, vidéos et supports
téléchargeables ;
• Paramétrer les activités interactives, les quiz et les conditions de réussite ;
• Intégrer les modules sur la plateforme LMS d'Easy Learning ;
• Réaliser les tests fonctionnels et pédagogiques avant la mise en ligne, puis corriger les
anomalies.

3.4 Mise à jour et contrôle qualité

• Actualiser les formations selon les évolutions réglementaires, techniques ou pédagogiques ;
• Assurer la cohérence graphique et éditoriale des contenus ;
• Vérifier l'orthographe, la lisibilité et la qualité des supports ;
• Recueillir les commentaires des clients et des apprenants ;
• Proposer des améliorations destinées à renforcer l'engagement et la réussite des apprenants.

3.5 Administration des apprenants

• Créer, modifier, suspendre ou désactiver les comptes utilisateurs ;
• Importer et contrôler les listes d'apprenants transmises par les clients ;
• Organiser les utilisateurs par entreprise, groupe, département ou parcours ;
• Inscrire les apprenants aux formations et leur attribuer les droits d'accès appropriés ;
• Paramétrer les périodes de disponibilité et les échéances ;
• Envoyer les invitations, identifiants, consignes de connexion et rappels ;
• Traiter les demandes de prolongation, de réinitialisation ou de modification des accès ;
• Veiller à l'exactitude, à la confidentialité et à la protection des données enregistrées.

3.6 Suivi des parcours de formation

• Contrôler l'état d'avancement, les résultats et le taux de complétion des apprenants ;
• Identifier les parcours non commencés, interrompus ou arrivant à échéance ;
• Envoyer les rappels nécessaires aux apprenants ou aux responsables de formation ;
• Vérifier les résultats obtenus aux quiz et aux évaluations ;
• Générer les certificats et attestations de formation ;
• Préparer les rapports et tableaux de bord destinés aux entreprises clientes.

3.7 Assistance aux utilisateurs

• Répondre aux questions des apprenants concernant l'utilisation de la plateforme ;
• Résoudre les difficultés courantes de connexion, d'accès ou de navigation ;
• Accompagner les clients dans la prise en main de la plateforme ;
• Identifier, documenter et transmettre les incidents techniques ;
• Assurer le suivi des incidents jusqu'à leur résolution ;
• Rédiger ou mettre à jour les guides d'utilisation et les réponses aux questions fréquentes.

3.8 Coordination interne et relation client

• Collaborer avec la direction, les experts métiers, les formateurs et les prestataires ;
• Participer aux réunions de lancement et de suivi des projets ;
• Communiquer régulièrement sur l'avancement des formations ;
• Recueillir les validations nécessaires avant la publication des contenus ;
• Veiller au respect des délais et des engagements pris envers les clients ;
• Contribuer à l'amélioration continue des services proposés par Easy Learning.

4. Compétences recherchées

4.1 Compétences techniques

• Maîtrise des principes de conception pédagogique et de formation pour adultes ;
• Capacité à structurer, vulgariser et scénariser des contenus complexes ;
• Bonne connaissance des plateformes LMS et de l'administration des apprenants ;
• Maîtrise d'un outil auteur tel qu'Articulate Rise, Storyline, Adobe Captivate, H5P ou équivalent ;
• Bonne maîtrise des outils bureautiques, notamment Word, PowerPoint et Excel ;
• Connaissance des formats et standards e-learning, notamment SCORM ou xAPI ;
• Capacité à produire des rapports et à contrôler la qualité des données ;

title: Senior R&D Engineer (m/f)
description:
Senior R&D Engineer

About Rotarex Firetec

Rotarex Firetec is a world leader in fire suppression solutions, with proven performance in several million installations worldwide.
A business unit of Rotarex SA, Rotarex Firetec operates globally through service centers and distributors in more than 65 countries. For over 100 years, we have developed breakthrough technologies that have become industry standards, driven by innovation, engineering excellence, and uncompromising quality.

Position based in Luxembourg

Our teams are currently relocating to our brand new Industry 4.0 manufacturing site in Bissen, designed to provide a state of the art working environment focused on innovation, employee well being, collaboration, and operational excellence.

Your mission

As a Senior R&D Engineer, you will lead R&D activities for fire suppression systems, products and components from concept through industrialization, serial production and end-of-life.
You will manage and develop the R&D team, while managing the R&D project portfolio and product-development activities, ensuring effective coordination and decision-making.

Your main responsibilities

R&D Leadership & Team Management

• Lead R&D activities for fire suppression systems, products and components from concept through industrialization, serial production and end-of-life.
• Manage and develop the R&D team by setting objectives, priorities, workload and resources; ensure delegation, performance follow-up and competency development.
• Work autonomously and remain accountable for the assigned scope; supervise R&D Engineers and Technical Designers when required.
R&D Project & Product Management
• Manage the R&D project portfolio and product-development activities, including 2D/3D definitions, technical specifications, validation and industrial performance, in line with quality, cost, timing, compliance and customer milestones.
• Lead preventive and corrective actions and manage the assigned product portfolio throughout serial life, including engineering changes, obsolescence, cost reduction, supplier changes, production deviations, quality issues and field feedback.
• Support product risk analyses, knowledge transfer and technical training in cooperation with Production, Quality and other internal partners.

Technical & Product Engineering

• Manage technical customer and supplier relationships, requirements, reviews, risks, problem solving, homologation and certification support.
• Ensure accurate and traceable product data across CAD, PDM and ERP systems, including drawings, specifications, material masters, bills of materials, routings, revisions, statuses and engineering changes.
R&D Strategy, Compliance & Digital Transformation
• Define and maintain the R&D roadmap for fire suppression systFems, including valves, actuators, pressure regulation, detection and control components.
• Ensure compliance with applicable product, pressure-equipment, transportable-pressure-equipment, fire-protection and customer-approval requirements.
• Support homologation and certification with laboratories, notified bodies and approval organizations, ensuring complete and timely technical files.
• Drive product-family standardization, modularity and reuse to improve quality, reduce complexity and accelerate development.
• Lead the migration from CATIA to Siemens NX and Teamcenter X, including data cleansing, conversion, validation, configuration rules, KPIs, training, user support and phased deployment in coordination with other R&D departments.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
• Ensure effective coordination and decision-making between R&D, Management, Laboratory, Purchasing, Production, Sales, Quality, Project
Management, suppliers and customers.

• Support product risk analyses, knowledge transfer and technical training in cooperation with Production, Quality and other internal partners.
• Provide technical support to Purchasing, Production and Sales for sourcing, manufacturability, quotations, claims and product applications.

Your profile

Technical skills

• Engineering or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electromechanical Engineering, Mechatronics or a comparable technical field
• Proven experience in R&D team management, technical leadership and multidisciplinary industrial project management
• Strong knowledge of mechanical or mechatronic product development, pressure equipment, system integration, validation, risk analysis, industrialization and lifecycle management
• Simulation skills (Mechanical and flow)
• Good understanding of fire suppression systems, product technologies, customer applications and certification constraints
• Knowledge of relevant standards, directives and regulations for pressure equipment and transportable pressure equipment, from medical to fire applications
• Strong knowledge of ERP master data, engineering change management and CAD/PDM/PLM environments ; CATIA, Siemens NX and Teamcenter experience is highly desirable
• Engineering-data migration, configuration management, data quality, user adoption and digital-transformation experience is an asset
• Ability to manage priorities, resources, budgets and conflicts, and to align cross-functional teams around common objectives

Languages

• Fluent in English
• Comfortable working in French or German
• Additional languages are an asset

Personal skills

• Strong R&D team management, technical leadership and multidisciplinary industrial project management skills
• Ability to manage priorities, resources, budgets and conflicts
• Structured, pragmatic and results-oriented
• Strong focus on safety, compliance, quality, cost, quantity and deadlines
• Autonomous and accountable for the assigned scope
• Able to align cross-functional teams around common objectives

What makes this position unique

• A role combining R&D team management, technical leadership, product development, project management, and industrialization
• The opportunity to lead R&D activities for fire suppression systems, products and components from concept through industrialization, serial production and end-of-life
• Ownership of the R&D roadmap for fire suppression systems, including valves, actuators, pressure regulation, detection and control components
• The opportunity to drive product-family standardization, modularity and reuse to improve quality, reduce complexity and accelerate development
• A highly collaborative environment bringing together R&D, Management, Laboratory, Purchasing, Production, Sales, Quality, Project Management, suppliers and customers
• The opportunity to lead the migration from CATIA to Siemens NX and Teamcenter X
• A technically challenging position combining product development, validation, certification, industrialization and lifecycle management

What you'll find at Rotarex Firetec

• The strength of a global industrial group combined with a family-oriented culture
• Real opportunities for training, professional development, and career growth
• Flexible working arrangements (depending on the position) promoting a healthy work-life balance
• An attractive package including numerous social benefits
• A brand new Industry 4.0 manufacturing site in Bissen, offering an ultramodern working environment (canteens, fitness center, free parking, electric vehicle charging stations, air conditioning...)
• Easy access to the site
• Additional benefits including Sympass card, preferential partnerships (banking, health insurance, mobile plans...)
• Regular company events that foster collaboration and team spirit

title: Chauffeur de Bus (m/f) - Statut du salarié
description:
Chauffeur d'autobus,

sous le statut du salarié - contrat à durée déterminée à temps plein

Enjeux du poste

Garantir un service de transport digne des attentes des usagers du service public en concordance avec les standards de qualité, de confort et de sécurité définies par le MMTP et le TICE.

Missions

Assurer le transport des usagers du service public au sens large.
Assurer au maximum la sécurité des usagers lors du transport.
Garantir pour les usagers, un confort de transport adapté aux conditions de la route.
Assister les usagers du transport public en cas de besoin.

Activités et tâches

Accueillir les clients de manière conviviale.
Respecter les horaires dans la mesure du possible.
Respecter les itinéraires réguliers des courses et en cas de déviations se les approprier pour pouvoir les suivre.
Respecter le code de la route.
Respecter le règlement d'ordre intérieur du syndicat TICE.
Signaler les anomalies matériel, arrêts, réseau, propreté et autres au poste commande.
Prendre en charge les objets trouvés et les déposer au poste commande.
Réaliser toute autre activité définie en relation avec sa responsabilité. La liste des missions, activités et tâches est sujette à modification suivant les besoins du syndicat TICE.

Compétences

Techniques

Disposer d'un permis de conduire de la catégorie « D » valable.
Disposer d'une carte conducteur tachygraphe valable.
Disposer de la formation initiale du conducteur professionnel (code 95) et/ou le cas échéant d'une formation continue valable.
Maîtriser les langues administratives courantes du pays (L, F, D).
Connaissance de la règlementation EU 561/2006 relative au transport routier.
Posséder une conduite prévoyante, rationnelle, convenable, confortable et sécurisée.

Personnelles

Avoir le sens de la responsabilité, faire preuve de rigueur et d'autonomie au quotidien.
Faire preuve de respect envers les usagers du service public et de ses supérieurs hiérarchiques.
Faire preuve de maîtrise de soi et de discernement en toutes circonstances
Faire preuve d'une ponctualité et d'une assiduité exemplaire.
Être disponible à suivre toute formation relative au poste et aux nouvelles exigences du métier.
Être capable d'accepter et de se conformer à un code vestimentaire identique pour tous les agents de transport.

Spécificités du poste

Horaire : Horaires décalés, irréguliers et nocturnes

Profil recherché

Nationalité : Ressortissant d'un État membre de l'Union Européenne ou de nationalité luxembourgeoise.
Formation : Avoir réussi au moins les 3 premières années de l'enseignement secondaire/secondaire technique ou posséder un diplôme équivalent reconnu.
Permis & Qualifications : Permis de conduire autobus valide et Code 95 à jour.
Langues : Maîtrise des trois langues administratives du Luxembourg (français, allemand, luxembourgeois).
Note : Aucun examen administratif ou d'admissibilité n'est requis.

À propos du TICE

Acteur majeur de la mobilité durable dans le Sud du Luxembourg, le Syndicat pour le Transport Intercommunal de personnes dans le Canton d'Esch-sur-Alzette (TICE) assure quotidiennement le déplacement de milliers d'usagers à travers ses 9 communes membres. Résolument tourné vers la qualité de service, la sécurité et la transition écologique, le TICE s'appuie sur l'engagement de ses équipes pour offrir un réseau de transport public performant, moderne et accessible à tous.

§ Capacité d'initiative
§ Aisance au niveau des relations interpersonnelles
§ Sens des responsabilités
§ Esprit d'équipe

Expérience professionnelle:

Une expérience professionnelle dans une fonction similaire sera considérée comme un avantage.

Pièces à joindre à la candidature :

1. Lettre de motivation
2. Curriculum vitae détaillé (périodes exactes des occupations professionnelles antérieures)
3. Copies des certificats et diplômes d'études
4. Copie de l'inscription du grade ou diplôme au registre des diplômes, prévu par la loi du 28 octobre 2016 relative à la reconnaissance des qualifications professionnelles (en cas de diplôme étranger)
5. Copie de la carte d'identité ou du passeport
6. Extrait récent du casier judiciaire (bulletin No 3)

Modalités d'embauche :

Le recrutement se fera sur base des dossiers de candidatures, d'entretien, et le cas échéant suivant d'autres démarches éventuellement à définir.

Le.la nouveau.elle titulaire sera engagé.e sous le régime de l'employé.e communal.e moyennant un contrat de travail à durée indéterminée prévoyant une période d'essai fixée selon les dispositions légales régissant la matière. Le degré d'occupation est fixé à 40/40ièmes.

Examen médical d'embauche :

Le.la nouveau.elle titulaire devra se soumettre, avant d'entrer en fonction, à un examen médical d'embauche auprès du médecin du travail compétent pour les fonctionnaires communaux. (Application des dispositions de la loi du 24 décembre 1985 fixant le statut général des fonctionnaires communaux, tel que ce texte a été modifié par la suite et notamment par la loi du 5 août 2006). Les modalités pratiques de l'examen médical seront communiquées au.à la nouveau.elle titulaire en temps utile.

Conditions d'emploi et de rémunération :

Le.a nouveau.elle titulaire bénéficiera d'un engagement dans le groupe d'indemnité C1 à conférer par le conseil communal.
Les employé.es communaux.ales sont considérés comme étant en période d'initiation pendant les deux premières années de service.
Dès la fin de la période d'initiation, l'employé.e communal.e bénéficie d'office d'une bonification d'ancienneté de service conformément aux dispositions prévues par l'article 5 du règlement grand-ducal fixant le régime des traitements et les conditions et modalités d'avancement des fonctionnaires communaux.
L'indemnité de l'employé.e au moment du début de carrière (donc après les deux années de service provisoire) est calculée à partir du 3ième échelon du grade de début de carrière.

En dehors de son traitement, le.la fonctionnaire pourra bénéficier d'une allocation de famille (29 points indiciaires) en application du chapitre 10a) - article 16 du règlement grand-ducal du 28 juillet 2017.
Tout.e fonctionnaire en activité de service bénéficie d'une allocation de repas et d'une allocation de fin d'année lesquelles sont fixées par le chapitre 10 b et c) - articles 17 et 18 du règlement grand-ducal précité du 28 juillet 2017.
Le traitement est adapté aux variations du nombre indice du coût de la vie suivant les dispositions légales afférentes.
Les titulaires seront affiliés à la Caisse de prévoyance des fonctionnaires et employé.es communaux.ales ainsi qu'à la Caisse de maladie y rattachée.
L'administration communale soutient l'égalité professionnelle entre les genres et les sexes. Lors de la désignation du.de la nouveau.elle titulaire il est tenu compte du plan à l'égalité des chances.

title: CONDUCTEUR DE TRAVAUX PRINCIPAL BÂTIMENT (m/f)
description:
CONDUCTEUR DE TRAVAUX PRINCIPAL BÂTIMENT F/H

Si le Groupe COSTANTINI s'est d'abord fait un nom dans le domaine du Génie Civil au Grand-Duché de Luxembourg, il couvre aujourd'hui l'ensemble des métiers de la construction.


La Construction, l'Entreprise Générale, la Promotion Immobilière, le Montage Immobilier, l'Electricité Générale, la Démolition, le Désamiantage, les Travaux Industriels et aux Particuliers constituent la large palette des activités proposées au Luxembourg, en France et en Belgique.


Animé par la passion du travail bien fait, le Groupe COSTANTINI se positionne aux côtés de ses clients, sur le chemin de la réussite.

La recherche constante de qualité, l'amélioration continue, la maîtrise des impacts environnementaux et des risques en termes de santé et de sécurité au travail sont au cœur de notre métier. Nos certifications ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001 sont là pour le démontrer.


Afin de nous accompagner dans notre développement, nous recherchons un·e Conducteur de Travaux Principal F/H.



Responsabilités :

Rattaché·e au Chef de Projet, vous avez en charge de :

    Coordonner et piloter les opérations de construction, depuis la préparation jusqu'à la réception, afin d'assurer un résultat optimal en termes de délais, qualité et coûts.

    Suivre les opérations TCE en prenant les décisions organisationnelles, techniques et financières nécessaires au bon avancement des travaux.

    Analyser et résoudre les problématiques chantier (humaines, techniques, sécurité).

    Assurer le suivi technique et financier des sous-traitants, du lancement au décompte final.

    Entretenir une relation opérationnelle de proximité avec les clients et les différents partenaires du projet.

    Maîtriser et vérifier les documents contractuels et administratifs relatifs aux chantiers.

    Encadrer et animer une équipe composée de conducteurs de travaux, chefs de chantier et équipes d'exécution.

    Élaborer le planning, les modes opératoires et les consultations sous-traitance.

    Organiser et animer les équipes d'intervenants, dans un souci permanent de sécurité et de performance.

    Gérer le transfert en phase SAV et assurer la satisfaction client.

    Organiser et répartir la charge de travail de vos collaborateurs (N-1) et assurer un reporting régulier à la direction.

description:
Research Scientist in Public Law

(Valid from 10/08/2026 to 25/01/2027)

Language: English (UK)
Location Luxembourg
Country: Luxembourg

Organisation data: Department of Law
Job Number: UOL08401
Contract Type: Permanent
Schedule Type: Full Time
Work Hours: 40.0 Hours per Week
Expected Start Date: 01/10/2026

Role Type: Open Position
Expertise: Researcher / Postdoctorant
Job (internal): Research scientist
Functions: Researcher

About us

The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Faculty of Law, Economics and Finance (FDEF) at the University of Luxembourg offers a unique academic and research environment.
Rooted in Luxembourg but with a European and international outlook, teaching and research benefit from the proximity of the European institutions, Luxembourg's leading international financial centre and its vibrant business community. Institutional and private sector partnerships, sponsored Chairs and a growing network of international partner universities make the FDEF a dynamic academic hub at the heart of Europe.

Your role

You will:

• Conduct independent research in the above-mentioned fields and contribute to the Department's and Faculty's research strategy, in particular on sustainability: environmental, social and institutional
• Publish high-quality scientific work in internationally recognised outlets and participate in editorial or scientific committees where appropriate
• Identify and secure external research funding, prepare competitive funding applications and manage research projects
• Organise and contribute to scientific events, e.g., conferences, workshops, seminars, at national and international level
• Teach public law at Bachelor and Master levels, in particular public economic and financial law, parliamentary law and legal methodology
• Supervise Master's theses and, subject to obtaining the ADR, supervise doctoral candidates and contribute to doctoral training
• Engage in knowledge transfer and outreach activities and develop professional networks with public institutions and other stakeholders in Luxembourg and abroad
The Research Scientist will join the Department of Law (FDEF) and the research area Public and Tax Law. The position focuses on research and teaching in European and Luxembourg public economic and financial law, monetary law, economic regulation, parliamentary law and legal philosophy.
For more information about this role, please contact: Prof. Luc Heuschling, luc.heuschling@uni.lu

Your profile:

• PhD in Public Law obtained at least 5 years ago, with a strong academic record and proven capacity for independent research
• Solid expertise in European and Luxembourg public economic and financial law, in particular public finance, monetary law and economic regulation; additional expertise in parliamentary law and/or legal philosophy is a strong asset
• Strong track record of publications in recognised peer reviewed journals and collective volumes
• Demonstrated experience in designing, leading and managing research projects, including successful applications for external funding
• Teaching experience in public economic law at Bachelor and/or Master level in higher education; ability to teach several areas of public law, e.g. public economic and financial law, parliamentary law, methodology, and to supervise Master's theses and participate in examination boards
• Marked interest in interdisciplinarity and in collaboration with other disciplines and non academic partners; commitment to knowledge transfer and public outreach
• Good IT skills, in particular for the conception and management of open access or open edition publication platforms; strong organisational skills and ability to work both independently and in a team
• Excellent communication and writing skills, and motivation to contribute to the strategic development of the Department of Law and the Faculty
• Experience with research assessment exercises and research evaluation schemes

Language requirements:

The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. The person hired for this position must have an excellent command of English and either French or German (C1). The University encourages its staff to learn additional languages and provides access to language courses to this end.

We offer

• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs
• Attractive salary and benefits packages with excellent opportunities for external funding. Support for career development and mentoring. Services to promote staff well-being and a healthy work-life balance

How to apply

Applications should contain:

• CV; you may include any periods of absence from work, such as family-related leave or career breaks, if you consider them relevant for the fair assessment of your experience
• Cover letter detailing your motivation for applying to the advertised research topic and/or project, including how your background, interests, and career goals align with its objective
• Short description of profile, key achievements and impact, summarizing main publications and projects
• Lists of publications, research projects, PhD theses supervised and subjects taught if applicable

All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence. Applications by post or e-mail cannot be considered. Early application is highly encouraged, as the applications will be processed upon reception.

title: Directeur/ Directrice des Systèmes d'Information (SI) (m/f)
description:
Description de tâches:


Vos missions :

- Définir et piloter la feuille de route SI des activités fret, en lien avec la Direction Générale, les Directions métiers et les Direction informatique Groupe afin d'aligner les solutions IT sur les priorités opérationnelles et stratégiques.
- Recueillir, challenger et prioriser les besoins métiers, puis recommander les projets, évolutions applicatives et investissements SI les plus pertinents au regard de la valeur business, des contraintes budgétaires et des enjeux de transformation.
- Assurer une veille technologique et réglementaire, identifier les innovations utiles aux métiers du transport, de la logistique et du fret ferroviaire, et proposer des évolutions pragmatiques du SI.
- Organiser, superviser et animer l'équipe IT dédiée, en structurant les processus SI, en pilotant les ressources internes et en coordonnant fonctionnellement les sujets relevant de la Division Informatique CFL, notamment les infrastructures, la cybersécurité, l'architecture et les standards groupe.
- Élaborer, suivre et maîtriser les budgets SI du périmètre fret, assurer un reporting régulier et veiller à la bonne allocation des ressources financières, humaines et externes.
- Contribuer à la gestion des risques SI et à la sécurité de l'information, en lien avec les politiques et expertises de la maison mère, et garantir la mise en œuvre des contrôles, standards qualité et mesures de continuité nécessaires.
- Définir les activités à internaliser ou externaliser et piloter les relations avec les prestataires IT, depuis la sélection jusqu'au suivi contractuel, afin de garantir la qualité, la maîtrise des coûts et la continuité des services.
- Piloter le portefeuille de projets SI, coordonner les parties prenantes métiers, IT groupe et prestataires, et garantir la livraison des projets dans les délais, le budget et le niveau de qualité attendus.
- Agir comme IT Business Partner des activités fret : comprendre les enjeux opérationnels, traduire les besoins métiers en solutions SI concrètes, accompagner le changement et favoriser l'adoption des outils par les utilisateurs.
- Assurer la conformité aux référentiels nationaux ou internationaux applicables.
- Respecter et appliquer les exigences du système de management intégré (QSE - énergie - sécurité ferroviaire – RSMS). Veiller à la mise en œuvre des mesures nécessaires pour garantir la sécurité et la santé des collègues/collaborateurs.


Votre profil :

- Formation supérieure en informatique, systèmes d'information, ingénierie ou domaine équivalent.
- Expérience confirmée, idéalement d'au moins 10 ans, dans une fonction de direction ou de pilotage SI, avec une forte exposition aux métiers et à la gestion de projets complexes.
- Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais ; la connaissance de l'allemand constitue un atout important dans un environnement groupe et transfrontalier.
- Capacité à dialoguer avec des interlocuteurs métiers et IT, à vulgariser des sujets techniques, à fédérer les équipes et à accompagner le changement.
- Leadership, sens du service, capacité d'arbitrage, rigueur de pilotage et aptitude à construire une vision SI au service de la performance opérationnelle.
- Pilotage de portefeuille projets, gouvernance SI, gestion budgétaire, gestion des prestataires, expression de besoins, conduite du changement et amélioration continue.
- Bonne compréhension des environnements applicatifs métiers, des ERP, des outils collaboratifs, de la gestion de la donnée, des processus opérationnels et des enjeux de cybersécurité.
- Une connaissance du transport, de la logistique, du fret ferroviaire ou d'environnements industriels multi-sites est appréciée.


Nous vous proposons :

- Un environnement de travail international, stimulant et dynamique.
- Un groupe engagé en faveur de la santé et sécurité au travail, de la qualité de service et de la responsabilité sociale et environnementale.
- Une prime annuelle basée sur la performance.

- Des tickets restaurant.

- Des parkings gratuits sur nos sites, un restaurant d'entreprise et une salle de sport.

Un second entretien métier/RH pour en apprendre davantage sur les détails du poste avec votre futur responsable

title: Paralegal (m/f)
description:
Description de tâches:
Arendt & Medernach is the leading independent business law firm in Luxembourg with over 800 professionals. The firm's international team of more than 450 legal experts represents Luxembourg and foreign clients in all areas of Luxembourg business law from its main office in Luxembourg and representative offices in Frankfurt, Hong Kong, London, New York, and Paris.

Our service to clients is differentiated by the end-to-end specialist advice we offer, covering all legal, regulatory, taxation, and advisory aspects of doing business in Luxembourg.

Our firm advises international and domestic clients in all areas of business law relevant to their business activities, ranging from fund formation, banking, insurance, private equity, and real estate to corporate and tax matters.

Given the ongoing development of our firm, we are currently recruiting:

Paralegal



In the paralegal department at Arendt & Mederenach you will have the opportunity to work in a legal environment marked by excellence. You will work on diverse and interesting files alongside lawyers and benefit from the same training center offered to them. Additionally, our specialized software helps to automize the more tedious work to allow our team to focus other matters.





Your role:



* Handle the day-to-day requests of Arendt's clients on the preparation and submission of legal documentation in relation to regulated and unregulated investment funds (such as the fund formation, the change of managers/directors, amendments to prospectus and/or articles of association, liquidation/dissolution, etc.) or domestic and multinational companies under the supervision of a Senior Paralegal

* Work on a variety of interesting cases without focusing on transactional work;

* Work closely with lawyers to support them on the management of their open files with a variety of prestigious clients;

* Liaise daily with clients, notaries, lawyers (both internally and externally) and authorities (the CSSF particularly);

* Draft standard legal documents (board minutes, incorporation deeds, resolutions, agreements, CSSF letters) and keep logs of all of them;

* Track and check documents (signature, legalization, apostille …);

* Prepare and attend board and general meetings and take minutes;

* Maintain statutory registers;

* Have the opportunity to work in a secondment at one of our clients.





Your profile:



* You have a bachelor's degree in law or an equivalent university degree;

* You ideally have at least two years experience in a similar position in a law firm, investment firm, a corporate service provider, or an interest in the corporate or funds sector;

* You have a perfect command of French and English; German being considered as an asset;

* You are highly organized, rigorous, and understand the importance of deadlines;

* You are proactive, eager to learn, with excellent interpersonal and communication skills;

* You have a perfect command of MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook);

* You may or may not be admitted to the bar, working here allows you to maintain your bar registration.

Within Arendt, we uphold high standards. Our professionals work with clients on engaging projects, empowered from the start. With a strong local presence in Luxembourg and international reach, we support and train our team members to thrive in a culture of excellence. Specialised teams ensure the right skills are available, allowing for a focus on added value. Our leaders are approachable, providing support and mentoring.

We offer a vibrant social life with numerous events, embracing sports and art, our culture encourages openness and discovery beyond the professional realm. With over 50 nationalities represented, Arendt is committed to the well-being of its staff, serving the best interests of its clients, protecting the environment, and supporting education.

Arendt promotes equal opportunities and value each employee for what they bring to the community. For more information, please refer to our diversity and inclusion policy on our website.

Interested?

If you are interested in this job opportunity, we are looking forward to receiving your application.
All applications will be treated confidentially.

Please be aware that the selected candidate will be required to provide a criminal record (or certificate of good conduct).

title: AIFM Risk Management, Manager (m/f)
description:
AIFM Risk Management, Manager

Department: Funds

Company Description

ABOUT IQ-EQ

We're a leading Investor Services group offering end-to-end services in administration, accounting, reporting, regulatory and compliance needs of the investment sector worldwide.  We employ a global workforce of 5,800+ people across 25 jurisdictions and have assets under administration (AUA) exceeding US$750 billion. We work with 13 of the world's top-15 private equity firms.

Our services are underpinned by a Group-wide commitment to ESG and best-in-class technology including a global data platform and innovative proprietary tools supported by in-house experts.      
                                                                              
Above all, what makes us different is our people. Operating as trusted partners to our clients, we deliver intelligent solutions through a combination of technical expertise and strong relationships based on deep client understanding. 

We're driven by our Group purpose, to power people and possibilities.

Job Description

As a Risk Manager, you will play a pivotal role in overseeing and enhancing the risk management framework for alternative investment funds managed by the AIFM. You will support the Head of Risk Management in leading the risk management team, ensuring robust risk governance, and acting as a key point of contact for senior management, clients, and governing bodies on risk management matters. You will be responsible for the effective identification, assessment, monitoring, and reporting of all material risks, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and alignment with the firm's risk appetite.

You will:

• Serve as the back-up for the Head of Risk Management, taking over key responsibilities when needed and ensuring continuity of leadership.
• Support the Head of Risk Management in daily team management, including coordination, task allocation, and staff development.
• Support the implementation, maintenance, and regular update of the Risk Management Procedure (RMP), policies, procedures, registers, and framework.
• Assist in identifying applicable risk types, proposing measurement methodologies and limits.
• Support the development, monitoring, and updating of risk profiles for all AIFs under management, ensuring alignment with investment strategies and regulatory standards.

About the SnT
The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Interdisciplinary Centre for Security, Reliability and Trust (SnT) at the University of Luxembourg is a leading international research and innovation centre in secure, reliable and trustworthy ICT systems and services.
We play an instrumental role in Europe by fueling innovation through research partnerships with industry, boosting R&D investments leading to economic growth, and attracting highly qualified talent. We look for researchers from diverse academic backgrounds to contribute to our projects in areas such as: Network Security, Information Assurance, Model-driven Security, Cloud Computing, Cryptography, Satellite Systems, Vehicular Networks, and ICT Services & Applications.
The successful candidate will become a member of the Interdisciplinary Centre for Security, Reliability and Trust within the Signal Processing and Communications Research Group (SIGCOM) under the supervision of Prof. Symeon Chatzinotas at the University of Luxembourg.
Ever-evolving intelligent connectivity systems require increasingly efficient systems to transmit, analyze, and reconstruct high-quality data. The SIGCOM group at SnT conducts research aimed at designing, emulating, and testing new high-performance systems for the future of mobile and satellite communications. Fields of applications range from 6G telecommunications to satellite-based internet connectivity and quantum internet. The SIGCOM group works across the entire spectrum of blue-sky research and applied research to conceive future communication networks. Prospective researchers will find a large and vibrant team of over 100 members fostering a collaborative atmosphere. title: Corporate Advisor - Banque des Grandes Entreprises (M/F)
description:
Description de tâches:


Fondée en 1856, la Banque Internationale à Luxembourg (BIL) est la plus ancienne banque universelle du Grand-Duché. Depuis sa création, elle joue un rôle actif dans les principales phases du développement de l'économie luxembourgeoise. Elle exerce aujourd'hui les métiers de banque de détail, banque privée et banque des entreprises et participe aux marchés de capitaux. Avec plus de 2.000 collaborateurs, la Banque est présente au Luxembourg, en Suisse et en Chine.
Acteur majeur de la place financière luxembourgeoise et signataire des « Principles for Responsible Banking » de l'UNEP FI (United Nations Environment Programme Finance Initiative), la BIL s'engage pour la construction d'une économie durable.


Vos responsabilités :  

Gérer et surtout développer activement un portefeuille clients dédié aux « International Companies ».
Fournir une analyse complète et détaillée des entreprises, à la fois sur les plans quantitatif et qualitatif.
Servir de point de contact principal pour les clients au sein de la BIL, assurant une communication fluide avec d'autres parties prenantes de la banque.
Atteindre les objectifs fixés en matière de revenus, coûts, collecte de dépôts et crédits.
Veiller au suivi opérationnel des demandes des clients et des dossiers de crédit.
Évaluer la structure financière des entreprises, suggérer des options d'optimisation et conseiller sur les financements appropriés.
Structurer, négocier et clôturer des opérations de financement complexes, notamment des financements syndiqués et structurés, des financements de type LBO, etc.
Être apte à réaliser des analyses financières complexes et à approfondir l'évaluation des risques de crédit.
Disposer d'une connaissance approfondie des modèles stratégiques majeurs, intégrer les implications macroéconomiques, et avoir une maîtrise de la réglementation bancaire pour prendre des décisions éclairées dans le cadre des opérations de financement.
Collaborer avec les équipes internes, notamment la gestion des risques, la salle des marché, les affaires juridiques et Compliance pour assurer la diligence requise et la structuration appropriée des transactions.
Identifier et évaluer les opportunités de cross-selling, en proposant aux clients des produits tels que des dérivés, des services de trésorerie et des solutions de gestion de fonds.
Intégrer les critères ESG dans les analyses financières et les recommandations, tout en conseillant les clients sur les opportunités et risques liés à l'ESG.
Jouer un rôle proactif dans la collaboration et la formation au sein du département, en partageant des connaissances et en se formant sur des domaines spécialisés.


Vos compétences :

Min. 5 à 10 ans d'expérience dans une fonction similaire.
Formation supérieure (Bac+5 accomplie) en Finance, Gestion d'Entreprises ou Ingénieur de Gestion.
Fort atout : Le candidat dispose déjà d'un réseau européen existant respectivement d'une expérience dans le marché du Corporate Banking à l'échelle européenne.
Expertise avancée en finance d'entreprises : compétence en comptabilité générale et analytique (IFRS / local Gaap), analyse financière, structuration financière, modélisation et évaluation d'entreprise.
Bonnes connaissances en économie et du monde d'affaires bancaire.
Connaissance de la finance de marché. Notions fondamentales en risk management.
Connaissance détaillée de l'environnement économique d'au moins un des pays concernés.
Des notions en sciences, technologies, ingénierie et mathématiques (STEM) et une sensibilisation au développement durable (ESG) sont des atouts.
Maîtrise totale des outils informatiques courants (PowerPoint, Excel, Word).
Orienté client, avec une présentation impeccable, une aisance relationnelle et un bon sens de l'écoute.
Solide compétence en analyse.
Intégrité, éthique professionnelle et discrétion.
Forte inclinaison pour le travail en équipe et la collaboration, ainsi qu'une capacité à partager des connaissances techniques et à former les autres membres de l'équipe.
Ouverture d'esprit et un vif intérêt pour l'innovation.
Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais. La connaissance de l'allemand et du luxembourgeois est un atout majeur.


La BIL offre une large gamme de projets stimulants et un important choix de carrières. Nous vous aiderons à trouver la voie qui répond le plus à vos compétences et à vos attentes. Votre développement personnel est notre priorité et nous vous encourageons à vous impliquer le plus possible pour que votre expérience soit la meilleure.
La BIL est convaincue que la diversité et l'inclusion contribuent à accroître la performance collective de la Banque. Nous nous engageons à créer une culture inclusive qui encourage le développement individuel de nos employés.

NB : le candidat retenu devra délivrer un extrait de casier judiciaire (bulletin n°3); datant de moins de 3 mois, afin de garantir son honorabilité au poste visé compte tenu de la confidentialité des informations à observer dans l'exercice de sa fonction. D'autres documents seront demandés dans le cadre d'un background check.

title: Business Manager - Finance (M/F)
description:
Description de tâches:


BIL is a leading player in Luxembourg's financial market. Founded in 1856 as the country's first bank, BIL has contributed significantly to the development of Luxembourg's social and economic landscape. Today, BIL operates across digital banking, wealth management and corporate finance, supporting individuals, entrepreneurs, businesses, and both private and institutional investors. Headquartered in Luxembourg, BIL employs more than 1,800 people and maintains a presence in key financial centers including Luxembourg, Switzerland, France and China. As a major player in Luxembourg's finance industry and as a signatory of the UN Principles of Responsible Banking, BIL is committed to handing over a responsible and sustainable bank to future generations.


We are hiring a Business Manager to work directly with the Chief Finance Officer, a member of the Executive Committee.

More than a traditional business support role, this position acts as a strategic advisor and internal consultant to the CFO. You will tackle complex business challenges, drive transformation initiatives, support executive decision-making, and work across the organization to deliver strategic outcomes.

This is a unique opportunity for a former consultant or strategy professional seeking direct exposure to executive leadership and the ability to influence the direction of a leading financial institution.


Your next challenge:


1. Strategy Advisory & Information Management

Act as a trusted sparring partner to the CFO on strategic, organizational and business topics.
Structure complex topics, challenge assumptions, and prepare forward-looking positions.
Monitor internal and external developments (e.g. market trends, industry shifts, regulatory changes, finance trends) and flag relevant risks or opportunities.
Research and prepare materials, briefings, and presentations on diverse topics - either proactively or at the Executive's request.


2. Operational Support & Execution

Prepare high-quality content (slides, briefings, memos) and coordinate inputs from across the business line.
Ensure the Executive is fully briefed for meetings and urgent topics.
Coordinate and participate in meetings, taskforces, and workgroups - internally and externally - ensuring follow-up on action items.
Synthesize workshop documentation and ensure the Executive is always well-prepared.


3. Stakeholder Management & Communication

Act as a trusted liaison between the Executive and internal/external stakeholders.
Build a strong network within the Executive's departments and across the bank.
Facilitate alignment, cascade key messages, and ensure two-way communication across N-1/N-2 levels.
Identify conflicts, flag issues for intervention, and engage in brainstorming sessions with the Executive.


4. Project Leadership

Independently lead and drive complex, high-stakes projects aligned with the Executive's strategic priorities.
Take ownership of key issues before escalation and proactively propose solutions.
Demonstrate initiative, problem-solving, and leadership readiness.
Deepen your business acumen and gain a comprehensive understanding of the business line's functioning.
Act as an internal consultant on key business priorities, including organisational transformation, operating model improvements and strategic initiatives.


Your skills:

Master's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Engineering - or equivalent.
Minimum 6 years of experience in strategy consulting, banking, finance or a relevant strategic role, with a strong preference for candidates having gained experience in a top-tier consulting firm or a comparable strategic advisory, transformation or Chief of Staff environment.
Strong analytical skills and advanced Excel proficiency.
Solid understanding of finance.
Fluent in French and English; additional languages are a plus.
Strong knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, reporting, and project management.
Excellent communication and presentation skills: Ability to convey complex information clearly and persuasively in both written and verbal formats. This includes preparing and delivering impactful presentations to diverse audiences, ensuring clarity and strategic alignment.
Politically astute, discreet, and capable of navigating complex stakeholder environments.
Dynamic, proactive, and willing to go the extra mile.
Solution-oriented with complex problem-solving and critical thinking skills.

BIL offers a broad range of challenging projects and a huge choice of career paths .We will assist you in finding the one that best meets your skills and expectations. Your personal development is our priority and we greatly encourage you to dive into different business areas for the broadest possible experience.
BIL is firmly of the opinion that diversity & inclusion contribute towards increasing the collective performance of the Bank. We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion that encourages individual development with equal opportunities for all.

NB: The selected candidate will be asked to provide an extract from the criminal record (no.3) as evidence of integrity and justified with regard to the specific needs of the position to be filled. Other documents will be collected, to the extent legally permitted, to perform background checks.

Through its dual mission of teaching and research, the FSTM seeks to generate and disseminate knowledge and train new generations of responsible citizens in order to better understand, explain and advance society and the environment we live in.
Within the FSTM, the Department of Health, Medicine and Life Sciences (DHML) coordinates all teaching programmes in life in sciences, medicine, nursing, radiology and midwifery. The department's research combines basic and translational, molecular and computational approaches, with a particular focus on cancer biology, while also encompassing clinical research in human health and disease.
The DHML cooperates with the national health care centers and leading international biomedical research institutions. As medicine and health are strategic priorities for the University of Luxembourg, the department is actively expanding its education and research activities in these fields, providing exceptional opportunities for medical and biomedical initiatives.

Your role
The position focuses on innovative, interdisciplinary teaching in public health at the bachelor's level and within health-related specialization programmes. The recruited professor will establish teaching and expertise in areas such as epidemiology, health systems, disease prevention, and health policy.
The successful candidate will lead the development and coordination of public health teaching activities across the University's programmes in medicine, nursing sciences, and midwifery. The role includes the implementation of a state-of-the-art public health curriculum, incorporating advanced educational tools such as digital learning platforms, data-driven health simulations, case-based learning, and interactive policy analysis. Working closely with faculty members and clinical partners, the successful candidate will ensure an integrated and cohesive learning experience for students.

Research Portfolio
The candidate is expected to have an internationally recognised research profile and to bring a coherent research programme in public health. The candidate will develop and lead an ambitious research agenda in areas such as population health, primary care, prevention, health systems, epidemiology, health inequalities, data driven health sciences, and digital health.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in public health research and/or practice, with a commitment to integrating real-world perspectives into education. The possibility of maintaining collaborative activities with national health authorities or international organizations may be considered, depending on the candidate's profile and institutional partnerships.

The University | About us...
The University of Luxembourg aspires to be a world-class research university. It strives for excellence in both fundamental and applied research, and in education. It drives innovation for society, has a high proportion of graduate students, and intertwines research, teaching and societal impact.
The University of Luxembourg has the profile of a research university with a strong activity in research, a high proportion of doctoral candidates and success in internationally competitive third-party funding, combined with excellent research-driven teaching throughout the University. The University has three missions: research, higher education and contribution to the social, cultural and economic development of the country.
The Faculty of Humanities, Education and Social Sciences (FHSE) brings together expertise from the humanities, linguistics, cognitive sciences, social and educational sciences. People from across 20 disciplines are working within the Faculty. Along with the disciplinary approach a very ambitious interdisciplinary research culture has been developed.
The faculty's research and teaching focuses on social, economic, political and educational issues with the common goal of contributing to an inclusive, open and resourceful society. The FHSE offers 7 Bachelor and 20 Master degrees and a doctoral school providing students with the necessary knowledge and high-qualified skills to succeed in their future career.

Your Role...
The holder of the position will be a member of the Department of Education and Social Work within the Faculty of Humanities, Education and Social Sciences.
She/he is expected to:
• Develop and maintain research activities — with national embedding and of (inter)national relevance — explicitly focusing on school management and school development in fundamental education (e.g. pedagogical leadership, organisational management and change management, implementation of educational policies on the ground, quality development and assurance, communication and collaboration, professional competencies and continuing professional development, data and assessment literacy), possibly including the leveraging of digital opportunities (e.g., collaborative technologies), thus identifying and (further) developing best practices that can feed back into both teacher training and the school system;

The holder will mainly be teaching in the Bachelor en Sciences de l'Education, the new Bachelor en Formation Pédagogique and the new Master in School Management and Development (Master en Gestion et Développement des Ecoles).
The holder will also lead the new Master in School Management and Development (Master en Gestion et Développement des Ecoles).

The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Department of Life Sciences and Medicine (DLSM) belongs to the Faculty of Science, Technology and Medicine of the University of Luxembourg. We combine basic and translational, biomolecular and computational research to address critical questions in human health and disease with a main focus on cancer biology. We investigate mechanisms that govern tumor initiation, migration and invasion, metastasis, cell cycle control, the tumor microenvironment and drug resistance by using a combination of experimental in vitro, in vivo and in silico approaches. Next to its research mission, DLSM is coordinating all teaching programs in Life Sciences, Medicine, Nursing and Allied Health Professions.
Health and Medicine are a strategic priority of the University of Luxembourg and are presently in an ambitious phase of development. The department is therefore broadening its research focus to include cutting-edge trends in medical and biomedical sciences, extending beyond the field of cancer research. This strategic expansion requires additional expertise in teaching pharmacology across various fields, including Medicine, Life sciences, Nursing, and Allied Health Professions.

Your role:

The Faculty of Science, Technology and Medicine of the University of Luxembourg is looking for an Associate or Assistant Professor (depending on qualifications) in Pharmacology for its Department of Life Sciences and Medicine (DLSM).
The successful candidate will establish and lead an internationally recognized, independent pharmacological research programme in an area of biomedical relevance. The person will contribute to advancing the scientific profile of the institution through high-impact research, successful acquisition of competitive funding, and active interdisciplinary collaboration.
The candidate will additionally play a key role in shaping our educational mission by delivering high-quality teaching in pharmacology at the bachelor, master, and doctoral programmes, with a special focus on Medicine and Life Sciences.
In addition, the individual will mentor early-career researchers and contribute to academic leadership through strategic planning and team management.
Expertise in computational approaches - such as machine learning, artificial intelligence, or other data-driven methodologies - will be an asset.
This position is part of the University of Luxembourg's tenure-track scheme, which offers the assistant professor the possibility to obtain tenure and promotion to the rank of associate professor upon positive evaluation. title: Business Manager - Finance (M/F)
description:
Description de tâches:


BIL is a leading player in Luxembourg's financial market. Founded in 1856 as the country's first bank, BIL has contributed significantly to the development of Luxembourg's social and economic landscape. Today, BIL operates across digital banking, wealth management and corporate finance, supporting individuals, entrepreneurs, businesses, and both private and institutional investors. Headquartered in Luxembourg, BIL employs more than 1,800 people and maintains a presence in key financial centers including Luxembourg, Switzerland, France and China. As a major player in Luxembourg's finance industry and as a signatory of the UN Principles of Responsible Banking, BIL is committed to handing over a responsible and sustainable bank to future generations.


We are hiring a Business Manager to work directly with the Chief Finance Officer, a member of the Executive Committee.

More than a traditional business support role, this position acts as a strategic advisor and internal consultant to the CFO. You will tackle complex business challenges, drive transformation initiatives, support executive decision-making, and work across the organization to deliver strategic outcomes.

This is a unique opportunity for a former consultant or strategy professional seeking direct exposure to executive leadership and the ability to influence the direction of a leading financial institution.


Your next challenge:


1. Strategy Advisory & Information Management

Act as a trusted sparring partner to the CFO on strategic, organizational and business topics.
Structure complex topics, challenge assumptions, and prepare forward-looking positions.
Monitor internal and external developments (e.g. market trends, industry shifts, regulatory changes, finance trends) and flag relevant risks or opportunities.
Research and prepare materials, briefings, and presentations on diverse topics - either proactively or at the Executive's request.


2. Operational Support & Execution

Prepare high-quality content (slides, briefings, memos) and coordinate inputs from across the business line.
Ensure the Executive is fully briefed for meetings and urgent topics.
Coordinate and participate in meetings, taskforces, and workgroups - internally and externally - ensuring follow-up on action items.
Synthesize workshop documentation and ensure the Executive is always well-prepared.


3. Stakeholder Management & Communication

Act as a trusted liaison between the Executive and internal/external stakeholders.
Build a strong network within the Executive's departments and across the bank.
Facilitate alignment, cascade key messages, and ensure two-way communication across N-1/N-2 levels.
Identify conflicts, flag issues for intervention, and engage in brainstorming sessions with the Executive.


4. Project Leadership

Independently lead and drive complex, high-stakes projects aligned with the Executive's strategic priorities.
Take ownership of key issues before escalation and proactively propose solutions.
Demonstrate initiative, problem-solving, and leadership readiness.
Deepen your business acumen and gain a comprehensive understanding of the business line's functioning.
Act as an internal consultant on key business priorities, including organisational transformation, operating model improvements and strategic initiatives.


Your skills:

Master's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Engineering - or equivalent.
Minimum 6 years of experience in strategy consulting, banking, finance or a relevant strategic role, with a strong preference for candidates having gained experience in a top-tier consulting firm or a comparable strategic advisory, transformation or Chief of Staff environment.
Strong analytical skills and advanced Excel proficiency.
Solid understanding of finance.
Fluent in French and English; additional languages are a plus.
Strong knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, reporting, and project management.
Excellent communication and presentation skills: Ability to convey complex information clearly and persuasively in both written and verbal formats. This includes preparing and delivering impactful presentations to diverse audiences, ensuring clarity and strategic alignment.
Politically astute, discreet, and capable of navigating complex stakeholder environments.
Dynamic, proactive, and willing to go the extra mile.
Solution-oriented with complex problem-solving and critical thinking skills.

BIL offers a broad range of challenging projects and a huge choice of career paths .We will assist you in finding the one that best meets your skills and expectations. Your personal development is our priority and we greatly encourage you to dive into different business areas for the broadest possible experience.
BIL is firmly of the opinion that diversity & inclusion contribute towards increasing the collective performance of the Bank. We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion that encourages individual development with equal opportunities for all.

The University | About us...
The University of Luxembourg aspires to be a world-class research university. It strives for excellence in both fundamental and applied research, and in education. It drives innovation for society, has a high proportion of graduate students, and intertwines research, teaching and societal impact.
The University of Luxembourg has the profile of a research university with a strong activity in research, a high proportion of doctoral candidates and success in internationally competitive third-party funding, combined with excellent research-driven teaching throughout the University. The University has three missions: research, higher education and contribution to the social, cultural and economic development of the country.
The Faculty of Humanities, Education and Social Sciences (FHSE) brings together expertise from the humanities, linguistics, cognitive sciences, social and educational sciences. People from across 20 disciplines are working within the Faculty. Along with the disciplinary approach a very ambitious interdisciplinary research culture has been developed.
The faculty's research and teaching focuses on social, economic, political and educational issues with the common goal of contributing to an inclusive, open and resourceful society. The FHSE offers 7 Bachelor and 20 Master degrees and a doctoral school providing students with the necessary knowledge and high-qualified skills to succeed in their future career.

Your Role...
The holder of the position will be a member of the Department of Education and Social Work within the Faculty of Humanities, Education and Social Sciences.
She/he is expected to:
• Develop and maintain research activities — with national embedding and of (inter)national relevance — explicitly focusing on school management and school development in fundamental education (e.g. pedagogical leadership, organisational management and change management, implementation of educational policies on the ground, quality development and assurance, communication and collaboration, professional competencies and continuing professional development, data and assessment literacy), possibly including the leveraging of digital opportunities (e.g., collaborative technologies), thus identifying and (further) developing best practices that can feed back into both teacher training and the school system;
• Exercise leadership internally and externally both in their field of knowledge and, as a leading educationist, apply their general knowledge and skills as a researcher and scholar;
• Develop and sustain the scale and quality of teaching and learning in the full range of the Faculty's study programmes in Education;
• Undertake tutoring and internship supervision of BScE and BFP students, and engage with national education actors and stakeholders;
• Undertake doctoral and post-doctoral supervision and mentoring, further contributing to the development of doctoral education and training; and
• Undertake leadership roles that ensure that the Faculty further strengthens its position as a leading European multicultural and multilingual site of research and teaching in the field of educational and social sciences.

Teaching areas
The holder will mainly be teaching in the Bachelor en Sciences de l'Education, the new Bachelor en Formation Pédagogique and the new Master in School Management and Development (Master en Gestion et Développement des Ecoles).
The holder will also lead the new Master in School Management and Development (Master en Gestion et Développement des Ecoles).

• PhD in educational sciences or a closely related field (a multi/interdisciplinary research profile is particularly welcome);
• A minimum of five years of postdoctoral experience acquired in a university or comparable research centre (teaching and/or school management and development experience in a fundamental education setting is an advantage);
• An outstanding research record in educational and social sciences;
• International research and teaching experience (teaching experience in basic training and/or specialisation programmes for fundamental school teachers is an advantage);

Job Description & Summary

Meet your future team

Join the Core Project Unit (CPU), a team that supports PwC Luxembourg's internal transformation agenda by partnering with business stakeholders across the firm. You will work closely with Project Managers, business teams, and senior stakeholders to help translate strategic priorities into practical improvements and sustainable change initiatives.

What your role will look like

As a Project & Change Officer, you will contribute to transformation initiatives that improve how PwC Luxembourg works. In this junior role, you will develop your expertise in business analysis, project coordination, and change management while supporting projects from discovery through implementation and adoption.

• Support business analysis activities by gathering requirements, documenting processes, and identifying improvement opportunities with stakeholders.
• Contribute to workshops and discussions that help teams understand challenges, align priorities, and define practical solutions.
• Assist Project Managers in coordinating activities, tracking actions, and monitoring project progress against key milestones.
• Prepare project documentation, status updates, and reporting that support transparent decision-making and stakeholder alignment.
• Participate in change management activities, including communications, training coordination, and user engagement initiatives.
• Help assess the impact of change on teams and processes and contribute to actions that support successful adoption.
• Collaborate with colleagues across teams and functions to ensure transformation initiatives deliver value and positive outcomes.

Your growth and opportunities

You will gain hands-on experience across business analysis, project coordination, and change management while working on firm-wide transformation initiatives. As your responsibilities grow, you will build expertise in stakeholder management, process improvement, and project delivery, supported by experienced colleagues and exposure to a variety of business challenges.

The skills you bring

• University degree or equivalent qualification in Business, Management, Engineering, or a related field.
• Up to 2 years of professional experience, including internships or first experience in project management, business analysis, change management, or a related area.
• Fluent in English (French or German are considered as an asset)
• IT literacy, including MS Office, data tools (e.g. Power BI, Alteryx), and AI-assisted tools (e.g. Microsoft Copilot).
• Ability to organise information, coordinate activities, and communicate effectively with different stakeholders.

Ways of working

• You analyse information, identify patterns, and contribute to well-structured solutions.
• You collaborate effectively with colleagues and stakeholders to achieve shared goals and support team success.
• You proactively learn, adapt to new tools and ways of working, and embrace opportunities to develop your skills.
• You act with integrity, handle confidential information with care, and uphold high ethical standards in every situation.

Additional skills that would support your success

The skills listed reflect what matters most to succeed in this role. If your experience aligns with them, even if your path looks different, we encourage you to apply and start the conversation with us.

Take your next step

Contribute to initiatives that help shape how PwC Luxembourg evolves and works together. Build practical experience in transformation, collaborate with colleagues across the firm, and develop skills that will strengthen your future career. Bring your ideas, curiosity, and drive to a team focused on delivering meaningful change.

Grow here. Go further.

Som Online Game Presenter ansvarar du för att spel som Poker, Blackjack och Roulette genomförs korrekt och professionellt. Samtidigt är det ditt ansvar att spelarna vid ditt bord får en professionell och engagerande internationell spelupplevelse.

Du kommer att tillbringa större delen av arbetsdagen framför kameran, där du presenterar spelen och interagerar med spelarna. Rollen ger dig möjlighet att utveckla dina presentations- och kommunikationsfärdigheter samt din förmåga att hantera flera saker samtidigt.

Som Game Presenter tar du presentation och underhållning till en helt ny nivå.

Du kommer att ha livliga, positiva och interaktiva samtal med spelarna vid bordet och bidra till att skapa en engagerande spelupplevelse genom din energi, personlighet och förmåga att underhålla.

Vi kräver ingen specifik tidigare yrkeserfarenhet, men vi ser gärna att du har arbetat deltid eller heltid i minst ett till två år, gärna inom service, kundservice eller liknande.

De första tre veckorna av din anställning kommer att tillbringas på vår Academy, där du får utbildning i hur du presenterar Blackjack- och Roulette-spel samt hur du agerar professionellt framför kameran.

💭 Du talar och skriver svenska (eller finska) på modersmålsnivå och har goda kunskaper i engelska (stark B2-nivå).

🎓 1–2 års erfarenhet inom service, kundservice eller liknande är meriterande.

💻 Du är serviceinriktad och har god kommunikationsförmåga samt förmåga att hantera kunder professionellt online.

💪🏻 Du är snabblärd, flexibel och en lagspelare.

🥇 Du är professionell, mogen och ansvarsfull, har lätt för att följa arbetsrutiner och regler och har en naturlig vilja att prestera och nå dina mål.

title: Sales account representative Nederland (regio: Noord Brabant – Limburg - Zeeland)
description:
Zin om een job op te scheppen bij Belgian Ice Cream Group?

Belgian Ice Cream Group is een duurzame allround partner die sinds 1935 de wereld trakteert op innovatieve ijsproducten van Belgische makelij. Het bedrijf verrast met een verscheidenheid aan smaken, vormen en kwaliteiten. BIG is het meest gekend dankzij IJsboerke dat doorheen de jaren uitgroeide tot een sterk en geliefd merk waarmee waarschijnlijk ook jij opgroeide.

De productie van onze ijsproducten vindt plaats in Kasterlee, in het hart van de Belgische Kempen. BIG telt 360 werknemers die jaarlijks een omzet realiseren van 75 miljoen euro. Sinds 2017 maakt Belgian Ice Cream Group deel uit van het Nederlandse Baronie. Dit bedrijf staat bekend voor zijn sterke chocolademerken zoals Chocolade Jacques en Duc D’O.

Jouw rol

  • Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de prospectie en behandeling van nieuwe potentiële foodservice eindklanten in de provincies Noord-Brabant, Zeeland en Limburg.
  • Je behartigt de bestaande foodservice klanten in jouw regio en werkt met hen samen aan het correcte assortiment, de juiste PoS ondersteuning en optimale omzet.
  • Je communiceert over acties en promoties en volgt deze nauwgezet op
  • Je hebt op regelmatige basis contact met de medewerkers van alle groothandels uit Nederland en bouwt met hen een vertrouwensrelatie op.
  • Je werkt nauw samen met je customer service-, sales,- en marketingcollega’s en rapporteert aan de Sales Manager Foodservice.
  • Samen met de Sales Manager en de Accountmanagers in België spreek je bepaalde doelstellingen en focus af en voert deze uit in jouw regio.

WIE BEN JIJ?

  • Je behaalde een bachelor diploma, idealiter in een economische of bedrijfsgerichte richting, of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.

Heb jij een technische achtergrond, maar steek je ook graag zelf de handen uit de mouwen aan machines? Dan is dit de perfecte kans voor jou! Werkzaamheden Uitvoeren van Root Cause Analyses (RCA) op complexe elektronische en mechatronische systemen die retour komen van klanten of vanuit onze interne productie. Verantwoordelijk voor het opstellen en implementeren van containmentmaatregelen om non-conforme producten te beheren en een soepele productieflow te ondersteunen. Vertalen van jouw analyses naar concrete verbeteracties voor toekomstige productontwikkeling en procesoptimalisatie. Arbeidsvoorwaarden 25 betaalde vakantiedagen (exclusief nationale feestdagen) Flexibele werktijden Gratis toegang tot de bedrijfsfitness Dagelijks gratis lunch, diner en gezonde snacks op locatie beschikbaar Wat levert deze baan jou op? Een scherpe blik voor detail en een praktische instelling. Een groot verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel en het nemen van eigenaarschap over jouw werk. Een echte teamspeler met focus op gezamenlijke doelen. Als V&G-coördinator bij Groothuis Bouwgroep ben jij de drijvende kracht achter onze veiligheidscultuur. Bij Groothuis Bouwgroep werken we veilig. Je voert audits en veiligheidsinspecties uit, coördineert incidentonderzoeken en vertaalt bevindingen naar concrete verbetermaatregelen. Daarnaast adviseer je directie en management over trends, risico's en verbeterkansen, zodat veiligheid stevig verankerd blijft binnen onze bedrijfsvoering.
Met jouw expertise draag je bij aan continue verbetering: je maakt analyses, stelt KPI-rapportages op en zorgt dat veiligheidsinformatie actueel en toegankelijk is voor iedereen. Door jouw inzet worden veiligheid, arbo en bewust gedrag vanzelfsprekende onderde...

Offer Description
This fully funded 36-month postdoc project aims to test whether targeting the aminopeptidase ERAP2 can tackle EBV infection in Multiple Sclerosis (MS), and is a joint effort of our group at the Department of Ophthalmology of the UMC Utrecht and the ErasMS team at Erasmus MC Rotterdam. You will use state-of-the-art molecular and cellular techniques available at the Kuiper group and its collaborating labs to elucidate how ERAP2 shapes pathogenic immune responses and if this can be corrected with small molecular inhibitors.
This project aims to test whether targeting ERAP2 can selectively remove pathogenic EBV-infected B cells in MS. Almost everyone with MS carries EBV, and EBV-infected B cells help drive disease. ERAP2 shapes how these B cells present viral peptides to NK cells and CD8+ T cells.
- You will build disease-relevant cellular models of EBV-infected B cells, modulate ERAP2 activity, and read out the downstream consequences for antigen presentation, NK and CD8+ T cell cytotoxicity, and B cell survival. You will be embedded in the research group of Dr. Jonas Kuiper within the Center for Translational Immunology (CTI) at UMC Utrecht and collaborate closely with the groups of Dr. Marvin van Luijn and Dr. Joost Smolders at MS Center ErasMS in Rotterd...
