title: Senior lecturers in Electrical Engineering
description:
We are looking for up to two senior lecturers in Electrical Engineering for permanent employment at the School of Science and Technology.

Subject area

The subject area for this position is Electrical Engineering.

Background

We are looking for up to two new colleagues to strengthen our teaching and research related to electrical engineering, at the intersection of electrical engineering, robotics, and autonomous systems. Topics of interest include control theory, signal processing, sensors, electronics and mechatronics; potentially extending towards robot manipulation, robot perception and machine learning. If you are passionate about advancing knowledge in these fields and enjoy working in an internationally connected research and educational environment, we would love to hear from you.

The positions are based at the school’s unit for computer science, which conducts education in both computer science and electrical engineering, and is home to the research environment AASS (applied autonomous sensor systems) which is a dynamic and multi-disciplinary constellation at the intersection of computer science, robotics, artificial intelligence, computer vision, and cybersecurity. The successful candidate is also expected to interact with the university-wide centre for AI, Robotics and Cybersecurity (ARC). See also: https://www.oru.se/english/research/university-wide-centres/arc-ai-robotics-and-cybersecurity-center/

Duties and responsibilities

As a senior lecturer, you will divide your time between teaching at all levels, research, and any associated public engagement activities.

On the teaching side, you will contribute to courses spanning the breadth of electrical engineering, from foundational to advanced level. This includes courses in electrical circuits and electronics, digital electronics, control theory, digital signal conditioning and processing, and electrical machines. Over time you will be expected to develop your own courses. Teaching encompasses supervision, examination, course development and administration, planning and evaluation. Teaching can be done in Swedish and English. On the research side, you are expected to publish in relevant international venues and attract external research funding. You will be integrated into the research environment with possibilities to establish an independent research agenda connected to the unit's general topics.

There are also opportunities to take on leadership roles in research and education (for example, shaping degree programmes or leading a research team) and to contribute more broadly to the development of the unit's activities.

Qualifications

Those qualified for appointment as a senior lecturer are applicants who have demonstrated teaching expertise and been awarded a doctoral degree in a subject matter relevant for the position, or has the corresponding research competence or some other professional expertise that is of value in view of the subject matter of the position and the duties that it will involve.

A general eligibility criterion for teaching staff at Örebro University is to have completed courses on teaching and learning in higher education corresponding to 10 weeks. Knowledge and skills equivalent to such courses may also be assessed to establish whether these provide eligibility. A teacher who at the time of appointment lacks such training or the equivalent competence, must complete the required courses no later than within two years of taking up the position.

Assessment criteria

To see the job advertisement and the assessment criteria in its entirety, visit: https://www.oru.se/english/career/available-positions/job/?jid=20260201

Information

This is a permanent full-time position. At Örebro University, salary depends on the successful candidate’s qualifications and experience, and positions announced are, where appropriate, subject to a trial period.

For more information about the position, contact head of unit Martin Magnusson, +46 19 30 38 70, email: martin.magnusson@oru.se, or head of school Henrik Olsson, +46 19 30 12 36, email: henrik.olsson@oru.se.

At Örebro University, we expect each member of staff to be open to development and change; take responsibility for their work and performance; demonstrate a keen interest in collaboration and contribute to development; as well as to show respect for others by adopting a constructive and professional approach.

Örebro University actively pursues equal opportunities and gender equality as well as a work environment characterised by openness, trust and respect. We value the qualities that diversity adds to our operations.

Application

The application is made online. Click the button “Apply” to begin the application procedure.

For the application to be complete, the following electronic documents must be included:

    Covering letter, outlining how you believe you can contribute to the continued development of Örebro University
    CV with a relevant description of your overall qualifications and experience
    Teaching portfolio (as instructed in Örebro University's guidelines:  https://www.oru.se/globalassets/inforum-en/key_documents/human-resources/template-for-teaching-portfolio.pdf)
    Research portfolio
    Publication list
    Relevant scientific publications (maximum of five and in full-text format)
    Copies of relevant course/degree certificates and references verifying eligibility and criteria met

Only documents written in Swedish, English, Norwegian and Danish can be reviewed.

More information for applicants will be found on our career site: https://www.oru.se/english/career/available-positions/applicants-and-external-experts/

The application deadline is 2026-08-31. We look forward to receiving your application!

After the application deadline, no supplements can be made electronically. If you have scientific publications that cannot be attached electronically to the application, please cite them in your application and contact hr@oru.se.

As we have already made our choices in terms of external collaboration partners and marketing efforts for this recruitment process, we decline any contact with recruitment agencies and advertisers.

As directed by the National Archives of Sweden (Riksarkivet), we are required to deposit one file copy of the application documents, excluding publications, for a period of two years after the appointment decision has gained legal force.

title: Sales Engineer
description:
Nolato MediTech develops and manufactures polymer products and systems for global Medtech and Pharma customers. We offer extensive turnkey solutions within plastic and silicone molding, as well as innovative assembly solutions.

Do you want to combine engineering expertise with customer collaboration in an industry where quality, structure and long-term partnerships matter?

As a Sales Engineer, you will be the technical-commercial link between our customers and Nolato MediTech. You will help turn customer needs into robust manufacturing solutions, working closely with engineering, quality, purchasing and controlling throughout the quotation and project process.

About the role

In this role, you will support sales within the contract manufacturing of medical devices. You will lead and structure the technical-commercial dialogue from request for quotation to signed agreement, ensuring that customer requirements are understood, evaluated and translated into feasible, high-quality solutions.

Rather than selling a standard product, you will work with complex, customer-specific projects and long product life cycles. Your engineering background will enable you to engage confidently in technical discussions, coordinate input from internal specialists and explain our proposed manufacturing set-ups clearly to customers.

You report directly to the Managing Director, who holds the overall sales responsibility. You will work closely with a senior Sales Account Manager, who will provide mentoring and commercial support. The position supports our facilities in Hörby and Lomma and is based at our Hörby site.

Main responsibilities

    Develop business opportunities with new and existing customers in line with Nolato MediTech’s strategy and established ways of working.
    Act as a technical-commercial contact for customers, clarifying requirements, coordinating technical input and supporting discussions on manufacturing solutions.
    Drive, coordinate and prepare quotations in accordance with the Quotation Review process, working with engineering, quality, purchasing and controlling.
    Support the evaluation of manufacturability, technical risks, quality requirements and proposed production set-ups during the quotation phase.
    Communicate and negotiate product pricing, services and commercial terms together with the relevant internal stakeholders.
    Lead and facilitate Business Review meetings with customers, ensuring follow-up on technical, commercial and operational topics.
    Work closely with the Medical Solutions business area to align customer strategies, pipeline activity and business opportunities.
    Ensure that technical and commercial commitments are clearly documented and handed over effectively to the project and operational teams.



Background and skills

We welcome candidates at an earlier stage of their commercial career who bring a strong technical foundation and the motivation to develop in a customer-facing role. Relevant experience from sales, application engineering, project engineering, product development, manufacturing engineering or technical project coordination is valuable, but extensive sales experience is not a requirement.

    Education — A university degree in engineering, for example mechanical engineering, materials/polymer engineering, industrial engineering, biomedical engineering or a comparable technical discipline.
    Technical understanding — Ability to understand and discuss technical solutions, manufacturing processes, drawings, specifications and production set-ups with customers and internal specialists.
    Relevant environment — Experience from medical devices, life science, contract manufacturing or another technically advanced and regulated industry is an advantage.
    Structured working style — Ability to document, coordinate and follow defined processes in a complex project environment.
    Communication — Strong communication skills and the ability to build confidence with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
    Languages — Fluency in Swedish and English, spoken and written.

Profile

We believe you are someone who:

    Is curious about technology and enjoys understanding how products and manufacturing processes work.
    Can translate customer needs into clear questions and practical next steps for internal experts.
    Works in a structured and methodical way, with attention to quality and detail.
    Uses the organisation’s expertise naturally and knows when to involve the right people.
    Builds long-term, trust-based relationships with customers and colleagues.
    Is comfortable developing into a commercial role and taking responsibility for customer dialogue over time.
    Has a professional, collaborative and confident manner in discussions and negotiations.

We offer

    A key technical-commercial role in a growing medical technology company.
    A structured organisation with clear mandates, processes and decision paths.
    Close collaboration with experienced colleagues in sales, engineering, quality and regulatory affairs.
    Mentoring and support as you develop your technical-commercial career.
    Long-term development opportunities within Nolato MediTech and the Nolato Group.

Application

We look forward to receiving your application via hr.meditech@nolato.com and attaching your CV and cover letter.

The last day of application is 2026-09-13

If you want to know more about the position, please contact:

Managing Director; Hanna Ingesson, 072-237 46 42, hanna.ingesson@nolato.com

HR Director; Stefan Hasselblad, 0768–617183, stefan.hasselblad@nolato.com

title: FULL-STACK DEVELOPER – LEGAL PROFESSIONALS CONTACT PLATFORM
description:
FULL-STACK DEVELOPER – LEGAL PROFESSIONALS CONTACT PLATFORM

Project Description:

Build a contact platform where visitors can search for legal professionals, view profiles, and send inquiries. The legal professionals must be able to update their own selected profile information without a user account.

Existing Tools:

- Domain

- Hostup.se web hosting

- Storage via Hostup.se

- Sitejet / Sitepad

- PHP/MySQL

- Softaculous

- cPanel

Use Hostup.se and free/open-source components where practical.

Technical Requirements:

- PHP/MySQL or equivalent

- Hostup.se

- Open-source code where practical

- Simple architecture

- Responsive design for Android, iOS, and desktop

- Complete source code delivered to the client

Security, GDPR, and Spam Protection:

1. Admin panel protected by appropriate authentication.

2. HTTPS/TLS for all communication.

3. Protection against SQL injection, XSS, CSRF, and unauthorized access, following relevant OWASP guidance.

4. Inquiry data protected against unauthorized access.

5. Spam protection using CAPTCHA, honeypot, rate limiting, or equivalent.

6. GDPR requirements for data minimization, storage limitation, deletion, and security must be supported.

Security Testing:

Before delivery, the application must undergo web-application security testing based on recognized industry practices, preferably relevant OWASP WSTG and/or ASVS requirements.

Testing must cover:

- Authentication and authorization

- Access control

- Session/token security

- SQL injection

- XSS

- CSRF

- Sensitive-data exposure

- Security misconfiguration

- Brute-force/token-guessing resistance

- Unauthorized access to other legal professionals' data

- Unauthorized access to administration functions

A penetration test or equivalent platform security assessment must be completed before final acceptance.

A security-testing report must be provided.

No unresolved critical or high-risk security vulnerabilities may remain at final acceptance.

Functional Requirements:

1. Legal Professionals Database

Fields:

- Name

- Firm

- Region

- City

- Contact information

- Website

- Practice areas

- Hourly rate

- Payment terms

- Languages

- Remote meetings

- Legal expenses insurance

- Legal aid

- Accepting new clients: Yes/No/Limited

- Bio

2. Search and Filtering

Filter by:

- Region

- City

- Practice area

- Languages

- Hourly rate

- Remote meetings

- Legal expenses insurance

- Legal aid

- Accepting new clients

3. Profile Page

Display:

- Name/firm

- Region

- City

- Practice areas

- Hourly rate

- Remote meetings

- Payment terms

- Languages

- Accepting new clients

- Bio

Include a "Send Inquiry" button.

4. Inquiry Form

Collect:

- Name

- Email

- Phone

- Message

- Matter type

Options:

- Remote meeting

- Legal expenses insurance

- Legal aid

No visitor login is required.

The inquiry must be sent to the legal professional and stored securely in the database.

5. Legal Professionals' Self-Service

Each legal professional receives a unique, cryptographically random update token.

The update link must allow the legal professional to change:

- Accepting new clients: Yes/No/Limited

- Hourly rate

- Bio

The token must:

- Be unpredictable and sufficiently long

- Not rely on a sequential ID

- Only provide access to that legal professional's own editable data

- Not provide admin access

- Be protected against guessing/brute force

- Be revocable

- Be replaceable with a new token

The developer must describe the token implementation in the offer.

6. Email

When an inquiry is submitted, the legal professional receives:

- Subject: CLIENT INQUIRY

- Inquiry information

- Platform information

- Personal update link

The visitor receives an automatic confirmation email.

7. Administration

The admin panel must allow:

- Add/edit/remove legal professionals

- Publish/unpublish profiles

- Edit practice areas and locations

- Generate/resend update links

- Revoke/replace update links

8. Website

- Website search

- Practice area, region, and city filters

- Responsive design

- User-friendly interface

9. Out of Scope

- Mobile app

- CRM

- Consumer accounts

- Legal professionals' accounts/password login

- Chat

- Payments

- Booking

- Advanced analytics

- AI

- Automatic matching

The secure legal professionals' update link is included.

Testing and Acceptance:

Test:

- Adding/removing legal professionals

- Publishing/unpublishing

- Search/filtering

- Profiles

- Self-service updates

- Availability changes

- Rate changes

- Bio changes

- Token generation/replacement/revocation

- Inquiry submission

- Spam protection

- Email delivery

- Android, iOS, and desktop

Security testing must also verify that update tokens cannot be used to:

- Guess/access another professional

- Modify another professional's data

- Access admin functions

- Access inquiry data

Critical and high-risk vulnerabilities must be resolved and retested before acceptance.

Delivery:

Provide:

- Production-ready website

- Complete source code

- Database and database structure

- Admin panel

- Update-link system

- Installation instructions

- Configuration instructions

- Security-testing report

Payment and Acceptance:

Payment is made after delivery and a two-week acceptance period.

During this period, the client may test functionality, security, and compatibility.

Final acceptance requires:

1. Required functionality delivered

2. Security testing completed

3. No unresolved critical or high-risk vulnerabilities

4. Material defects fixed and retested

Payment will be made through Invozio, a freelance company.

Budget:

Low-budget, cost-effective.

Use existing hosting and free/open-source components where practical.

Application and Quote:

Include:

1. Fixed price excluding VAT

2. Estimated delivery time

3. Technology stack

4. Similar projects

5. Hostup.se compatibility

6. Source-code delivery method

7. External costs

8. Technical solution

9. Testing approach

10. GDPR approach

11. Security measures

12. Spam protection

13. Update-token security

14. Security-testing methodology

15. Confirmation that security testing is included in the price

16. Hostup.se limitations

Application:

Send application and quotation to Zia Zenith: zia.zenith.llc@gmail.com

title: Natural Hazards Mission Lead
description:
ETH Zurich is establishing the ETH Swiss GeoLab, a new interdisciplinary unit of ETH Zürich I Space. ETH Space will soon become one of few strategic centres of ETH Zurich, and encompasses overall five units.

The GeoLab is focused on Earth observation and its applications. The GeoLab uses satellite, airborne, ground-based and in-situ observations. To these diverse data sets it applies AI-driven analysis methods and high-performance computing to develop solutions for specific societal and economic challenges.

Located at the D4 Business Village in Root, close to Lucerne, ETH Swiss GeoLab works at the interface of research, technology development and practical application. In its first phase, the GeoLab is focusing on few selected high-impact application areas where Earth observation, geodata and AI-based analytics can create tangible value for Switzerland. The Natural Hazards Mission focuses initially on mass movements, including landslides and rockfalls, with the aim of improving early detection, monitoring, preparedness and decision support for Swiss practitioners, authorities and infrastructure stakeholders. It builds on stakeholder engagement, solution scoping and community-building activities already underway within GeoLab, including contributions from senior domain experts and partners in the Swiss natural hazards community.

The ETH Swiss GeoLab is led by Prof. Dr Verena Griess and Prof. Dr Thomas Zurbuchen, with Dr Felix Seidel as Managing Director, responsible for the day-to-day operations of this exciting activity. The GeoLab will grow into a project-based hub of around 100 experts over the coming years and will collaborate closely with other ETH units, the Swiss National Supercomputing Centre (CSCS), Swiss research institutions, public-sector stakeholders, natural hazard organisations, industry partners, start-ups and international stakeholders.

This position is offered as a fixed-term appointment for an initial period of two years, with the possibility of extension.

As Natural Hazards Mission Lead, you will lead the research and development portfolio, integration and delivery of GeoLab’s Natural Hazards Mission. Initially focused on landslides and rockfalls, and later expanding to other natural hazards, you will help define the mission vision, translate user needs into research and product requirements, and ensure that GeoLab activities create measurable value for Swiss practice and public decision-making. You will build on ongoing interchange with key stakeholders and solution-scoping activities already underway within GeoLab, and work closely with senior domain-relevant partners, technical teams and experts.

You will report to the Managing Director of ETH Swiss GeoLab and work closely with GeoLab’s Natural Hazards Community & Solutions Lead, other GeoLab mission teams, the Research Program Support team, and the Geo-Intelligence team and external partners. You will define priorities, milestones and decision points, lead mission delivery and will have the authority to prioritize, redirect, and pivot or pause activities within your research and development portfolio, the approved mission charter, budget and governance framework.

As part of your role, you will:

On behalf of the GeoLab leadership team, define an ambitious and coherent research and development portfolio for the Natural Hazards Mission, initially centred on landslides and rockfalls
Translate identified critical operational gaps into measurable outcomes that create value for practitioners, authorities and decision-makers
Engage with local, cantonal and federal authorities, infrastructure operators, practitioners, industry and expert communities, in coordination with GeoLab leadership and existing Natural Hazards community activities
Translate operational challenges into research, data, product and technical requirements
Establish measurable mission outcomes, roadmaps, assumptions and success criteria aligned with Swiss natural hazard needs and the overall GeoLab strategy; you will also track progress actively against these outcomes
Manage the delegated mission budget and define priorities, milestones, decision points and success criteria and track finances and successes in that framework, through regular reporting activities to GeoLab leadership and other stakeholders
Work with the Geo-Lab’s Intelligence team – the team deeply focused on AI and Earth  observation foundational models - and external performers to drive pilots, field validation, operational testing and integration into user workflows
Assess evidence and performance, and recommend continuation, redirection, scaling, pausing or termination of activities
Identify and mobilise strong ETH groups, research institutions, engineering and geology offices, remote-sensing companies, public agencies and implementation partners
Represent ETH Swiss GeoLab in Swiss natural hazard, scientific, policy and industry communities, in coordination with GeoLab leadership and existing Natural Hazards community activities
Communicate mission goals, progress, evidence and lessons learned to internal and external stakeholders
Guide and train students, researchers and external contributors where required and support the transfer of resulting capabilities into operational practice
In summary, you understand the needs of practitioners and decision-makers in the field of natural hazards and their relation to Earth observations from space and are motivated by the opportunity to translate research and technology into practical solutions with measurable impact.

Specifically, we are looking for someone with:

A Master’s or PhD degree (preferred) in natural hazards, geosciences, engineering, risk management or related fields
Several years of experience in natural hazard practice, applied research, public administration, consulting, engineering or industry, preferably but not necessarily in Switzerland
Strong expertise and understanding of natural hazards with demonstrated examples of dashboard and tracking tools for others to gain insights in these projects
Proven ability to identify important operational problems and translate them into actionable initiatives
With a track-record of successful collaborations in diverse teams and have demonstrated your excitement to not only do research but apply that research to the benefit of others.
Experience in mission, programme or applied R&D portfolio design
Strong project, portfolio and budget management skills with demonstrated examples of transparent reporting, dashboard and tracking tools for others to gain insights in these projects
Excellent stakeholder management skills across diverse public authorities, academia, industry and expert communities
The ability to work across disciplinary and organisational boundaries and to lead through influence
Strong judgement skills under uncertainty and the willingness to challenge established approaches constructively
Excellent communication and listening skills, and great presentation skills in various modalities
Excellent written and spoken English and German; French is an asset
You are mission-driven, entrepreneurial, a strong learner and comfortable working in a newly established and evolving organisation. You have a track-record of successful team participation and leadership and an excitement for hard and impactful work. You combine scientific credibility with pragmatic decision-making, economic awareness and a clear focus on adoption, operational relevance and measurable value. In doing so, you want to work on the best idea, not necessarily your best idea.

A rare opportunity to help build ETH Swiss GeoLab from its early phase and shape a new national initiative for Earth observation
A mission-driven role with high visibility and strong societal relevance
The opportunity to develop solutions for pressing natural hazard challenges in Switzerland, and with broad international impact through transferable methods and lessons learned
A workplace in Root/Lucerne, embedded in an active innovation ecosystem and closely connected to ETH Zurich
We look forward to receiving your online application with the following documents:

Your CV
Diplomas and work certificates
A short motivation statement outlining your interest in ETH Swiss GeoLab and the Natural Hazards Mission
A video (max 2 mins) about you and your motivation for this position
Please note that we exclusively accept applications submitted through the ETH Zurich online application portal. Applications via email or postal services will not be considered.

Further information about ETH Swiss GeoLab can be found on our website. Questions regarding the position should be directed to Dr Felix Seidel, Managing Director ETH Swiss GeoLab, felix.seidel@eaps.ethz.ch.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Located at the D4 Business Village in Root, close to Lucerne, ETH Swiss GeoLab works at the interface of research, technology development and practical application. With domain experts from academia and the tech industry, you will help define the technical strategy and architecture for multimodal foundation models, agentic AI systems, geospatial tools, data pipelines and compute infrastructure.

You will work closely with Research Program Support teams (plus the external partners mentioned above). Encourage, enable or direct prototyping, benchmarking, validation and integration activities

title: Growth Marketer – E-Commerce
description:
Growth Marketer – E\-Commerce  
Location: Sonnentalstrasse 21, 8600 Dübendorf  
Work model: Hybrid – 4 days in the office  
Who we are  
Pflegewegweiser, part of the Entyre Group, is one of the fastest\-growing health\-tech scale\-ups in Switzerland and the US — 500\+ employees, locations from Zurich to Boston, and a mission that truly matters: helping people live independently at home. We make sure families are compensated for caring for their loved ones, and supply them with the homecare products they rely on every day.  
Pflegewegweiser Shop is a startup within this scale\-up. We're building an e\-commerce business from the ground up. That means: no legacy accounts to inherit, no 40\-page media plans, and no waiting three quarters for your test to go live. You launch it, you own it, you read and interpret the numbers, and you act accordingly.  
What you'll own  
The paid engine. You own Google Search, Shopping, and PMax end\-to\-end — from campaigns to assets to budget. You run the Merchant Center and the shopping feed like they're yours — because they are: clean data, healthy diagnostics, well\-maintained feeds.  
Meta \& creatives. You plan, launch, and optimize our Meta campaigns. You drive the creatives that feed them — static and video — from in\-house production to briefing and directing agencies. You know a winning ad isn't luck, it's a testing pipeline.  
Funnels. You build marketing funnels across the entire customer journey and continuously optimize them — from first click to repeat purchase.  
Growth sprints. You design experiments that open up new growth opportunities beyond day\-to\-day optimization. You find the growth opportunities we haven't identified or tapped yet.  
New bets. You develop new business models together with the Head of E\-Commerce, stress\-test them, and make them better — expanding what the shop can be.  
The setup. You question existing setups and processes, iterate on them, and make them better. If something is slow, manual, or "just grew that way," you challenge it.  
The shop. You help improve the shop experience, drive e\-commerce sales, and elevate the customer experience — your insights and improvement suggestions can be implemented quickly and directly to give our customers a better experience.  
The numbers. You analyze marketing and sales KPIs to find growth opportunities and efficiencies. Your analysis doesn't just go into a report — it directly influences our spending and budget allocations.  
What you bring  
2–5 years of marketing experience, preferably at a startup, scale\-up, or agency  
Hands\-on experience with paid campaigns on Google Ads and Meta — you've set up and optimized campaigns yourself, not just watched a dashboard  
A data\-driven understanding of marketing and e\-commerce KPIs — comfortable with reporting and able to move quickly from raw data to an actionable recommendation  
Ownership from day one — you'd rather build the process than wait for one  
Comfort with ambiguity and a healthy balance between speed and quality  
German and English \- both C1\+  
Nice to have  
Experience with Google Merchant Center and shopping feeds  
Familiarity with Shopify or a comparable e\-commerce platform  
Basic creative skills (Canva, CapCut, Figma, video production) and experience briefing creative agencies  
Knowledge of A/B testing, CRO, and funnel analytics  
An affinity for healthcare/homecare — or the curiosity to dive deep  
Why this role  
0 to 1, for real. You build the growth engine instead of waiting for someone else to.  
Direct line to leadership. You report to the Senior Growth Manager and work closely with the Chief Business Development Officer. Short paths, fast decisions, no bureaucracy. You learn fast, get direct feedback, and quickly gain ownership of your own topics and areas of responsibility.  
Impact you can see. Small, independent team; your tests land in the business immediately.  
Scale at your back. The pace and autonomy of a startup, backed by the resources of an international group — in one of the biggest growth markets there is: homecare and digital health.  
How we operate — non\-negotiable:  
"Insanely great" for families — delivered now  
Forget mere "satisfaction." We deliver support that makes caregivers feel seen, understood, and valued. Anticipate their needs and solve problems quickly. The standard is "insanely great," period. Anything less slows us down and fails our families.  
Speed is king — ruthless focus is key  
Velocity comes from focus. Eliminate distractions. Concentrate all effort on the \#1 critical objective until it's done, then move to the next. Decide what not to do and cut it ruthlessly. Being a mile wide and an inch deep is failure — move the needle now.  
Raise the bar — crush mediocrity  
Mediocrity kills speed, morale, and companies. Hunt it down and eliminate it. Good enough is never good enough. Demand top performance from yourself and everyone around you. Own your work, deliver excellence fast, and accept no excuses.  
The speed algorithm — question, delete, simplify, accelerate  
Build momentum by questioning every requirement: who asked, and why? Delete ruthlessly — parts, processes, bureaucracy. Simplify what remains. Accelerate cycle times relentlessly. "It can't be done" means "you haven't figured it out yet — go do it." Break bottlenecks, find shortcuts, remove friction.  
Act like owners — bold bets, fast action  
This is your company. Own the mission and the results. Take initiative, make bold bets that leapfrog progress, and act decisively. If you stumble, learn faster and go again. Bias for action is everything.  
The bottom line:  
We are building something vital at lightning speed. This requires intensity, focus, and a relentless drive to execute. If reading this makes you want to jump in and build faster, welcome to Pflegewegweiser!  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
Deutsch:  
Wer wir sind  
Pflegewegweiser, Teil der Entyre Group, ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Health\-Tech\-Scale\-ups in der Schweiz und den USA – 500\+ Mitarbeitende, Standorte von Zürich bis Boston und eine Mission, die wirklich zählt: Menschen zu helfen, selbstbestimmt zu Hause zu leben. Wir sorgen dafür, dass Familien für die Pflege ihrer Angehörigen entschädigt werden, und beliefern sie mit den Homecare\-Produkten, auf die sie sich täglich verlassen.  
Der Pflegewegweiser Shop ist ein Startup innerhalb dieses Scale\-ups. Wir bauen ein E\-Commerce\-Business von null auf. Das heisst: keine Alt\-Accounts, die du erbst, keine 40\-seitigen Mediapläne und kein Warten über drei Quartale, bis dein Test live geht. Du launchst es, du ownst es, du liest und interpretierst die Zahlen, und handelst entsprechend.  
Was du ownst  
Die Paid\-Engine. Du ownst Google Search, Shopping und PMax end\-to\-end – von Kampagnen über Assets bis Budget. Du führst das Merchant Center und den Shopping\-Feed, als wären sie deine – denn das sind sie: saubere Daten, gesunde Diagnostics, top gepflegte Feeds.

Growth Sprints. Du designst Experimente, die neue Wachstumschancen jenseits der täglichen Optimierungen ermöglichen. Du findest die Wachstumsmöglichkeiten, die wir noch nicht kennen und erschlossen haben.  
Neue Bets. Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Head of E\-Commerce neue Geschäftsmodelle, prüfst sie auf Herz und Nieren und machst sie besser – und erweiterst so, was der Shop sein kann.  
Das Setup. Du hinterfragst bestehende Setups und Prozesse, iterierst sie und machst sie besser. Ist etwas langsam, manuell oder «einfach so gewachsen», stellst du es infrage.

Was du mitbringst  
1–2 Jahre Marketing\-Erfahrung, bevorzugt in Start\-ups, Scale\-ups oder Agentur  
Hands\-on\-Erfahrung mit Paid\-Kampagnen auf Google Ads und Meta – du hast selbst Kampagnen aufgesetzt und optimiert, nicht nur ein Dashboard beobachtet  
Ein datengetriebenes Verständnis von Marketing\- und E\-Commerce\-KPIs – fit in Reportings und in der Lage, von Rohdaten zu einer belastbaren Empfehlung zu kommen  
Ownership ab Tag eins – du baust lieber den Prozess, als auf einen zu warten  
Einen Umgang mit Ambiguität und eine gesunde Balance zwischen Speed und Qualität  
C1\+ Deutsch und Englisch  
Pluspunkte  
Erfahrung mit Google Merchant Center und Shopping\-Feeds  
Vertrautheit mit Shopify oder einer vergleichbaren E\-Commerce\-Plattform  
Basic Creative\-Skills (Canva, CapCut, Figma, Video Production) und Erfahrung im Briefen von Kreativagenturen  
Kenntnisse in A/B\-Testing, CRO und Funnel\-Analytik  
Eine Affinität zu Healthcare/Homecare – oder die Neugier, tief einzutauchen  
Warum dieser Platz  
0\-to\-1, wirklich. Du baust die Growth\-Engine, anstatt auf andere zu warten.

title: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH Langzeitpflege 80-100% für die Region Moutier gesucht
description:
- Für ein bekanntes Haus im Bereich Pflege und Medizin in der Region Moutier suchen wir Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH – Schwerpunkt Langzeitpflege.

### Kurz zusammengefasst: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Moutier

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Langzeitpflege

**Pensum:** 80–100 %

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Moutier

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Moutier liegt im Berner Jura und besticht durch seine malerische Lage zwischen Natur und Infrastruktur. Die ausgezeichnete Verkehrsanbindung mit direkten Bahnverbindungen nach Biel und Basel macht pendeln problemlos möglich. Als Arbeitsort bietet die Region Sie mit einem stabilen Arbeitsmarkt, günstigen Mieten und hoher Lebensqualität an, während Sie gleichzeitig die Nähe zu Grünflächen und kulturellen Angeboten geniessen.

### Ihr Aufgabengebiet als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Langzeitpflege in Moutier

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Das setzen wir für diese Stelle voraus

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Langzeitpflege

Die Langzeitpflege lebt von Beziehung: Sie begleiten Menschen über lange Zeit, kennen ihre Gewohnheiten und bauen echtes Vertrauen auf. Dabei begleiten Sie auch komplexe, chronische Verläufe – mit Ruhe und Kontinuität statt Hektik.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Langzeitpflege in Moutier verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Darum lohnt sich diese Stelle doppelt.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Somit entsteht Pflegequalität, die ankommt.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Die Langzeitpflege in der Region Moutier verzeichnet eine konstant hohe Nachfrage nach diplomierten Pflegefachkräften, insbesondere für Positionen im Umfang von 80-100%. Sie profitieren als Fachperson HF/FH von ausgezeichneten Chancen auf dem Arbeitsmarkt und können zwischen verschiedenen etablierten Einrichtungen wählen. iPersonal unterstützt Sie als spezialisierter Vermittler durch fundierte Kenntnis des lokalen Arbeitsmarktes, persönliche Begleitung während des Bewerbungsprozesses und direkte Kontakte zu renommierten Arbeitgebern, was Ihren Einstieg erheblich vereinfacht und beschleunigt.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Moutier

- Gratis-Weiterbildungen dank [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – denn wir fördern Ihre Karriere aktiv

title: MTR/MTRA (w/m/d) - MRT + Angiographie - Spital in der Nordschweiz - 3 Fachkräfte gesucht (Medizinische/r Technologe/Technologin - Radiologie)
employer: Personal Spezial Personalservice & Vermittlung Hansjürgen Mathiak
description:
Bereit für das nächste große Kapitel? Erfülle Deine Berufung in der Schweiz!
Du liebst Deinen Beruf als MTR / MTRA, aber spürst, dass es Zeit für eine echte Veränderung ist? Für mehr Wertschätzung, modernste Technik und Lebensqualität, die diesen Namen auch verdient?
Wir verstehen Dich. Seit 25 Jahren begleiten wir als erfolgreiche Vermittlungsagentur Menschen wie Dich dabei, den Arbeitsplatz zu finden, der nicht nur zum Lebenslauf, sondern perfekt zum Leben passt. Für eine renommierte Klinikgruppe in der malerischen Nordschweiz suchen wir genau jetzt Deine Expertise.
Schließe kurz die Augen und stell Dir vor, wie es sich anfühlt, in einem Umfeld zu arbeiten, in dem Deine Leistung täglich gesehen und honoriert wird. Wir haben aktuell 3 exklusive Vakanzen zu besetzen – eine davon wartet vermutlich genau auf Dich.
Deine zukünftigen Highlights: MRT & Angiologie auf Top-Niveau
Du bist der Experte, der Bilder sprechend macht. In Deiner neuen Rolle verbindest Du technologische Präzision mit menschlicher Empathie:
High-End-Diagnostik im MRT: Du steuerst modernste MRT-Systeme und meisterst komplexe Fragestellungen mit Leichtigkeit.
Dynamik in der Angiologie: Bei interventionellen Eingriffen und Gefäßdarstellungen bist Du die unverzichtbare rechte Hand des Teams – ruhig, fokussiert und kompetent.
Patienten-Empathie: Du schenkst Menschen in Ausnahmesituationen Sicherheit und das Gefühl, in den besten Händen zu sein.
Warum dieser Schritt Dein Leben verändern wird
Vielleicht hast Du schon länger über die Schweiz nachgedacht. Lass uns gemeinsam hinschauen, was Dich hier wirklich erwartet:
Spürbare Wertschätzung & Spitzen-Gehalt: Schweizer Saläre und hervorragende Sozialleistungen bieten Dir eine finanzielle Freiheit und Sicherheit, die Du so wahrscheinlich noch nicht kennst.
Zeit für das Wesentliche: Ein exzellenter Personalschlüssel sorgt dafür, dass Du Dich wieder voll und ganz auf Deine Patienten und die Bildqualität konzentrieren kannst – ohne permanenten Stress.
Lebensqualität pur: Die Nordschweiz bietet Dir die perfekte Balance. Atemberaubende Natur, die Alpen vor der Haustür und gleichzeitig die unmittelbare Nähe zur deutschen Heimat.
Dein Rundum-Sorglos-Paket: Wir sind an Deiner Seite. Von der SRK-Anerkennung Deines Diploms über die Wohnungssuche bis hin zu allen bürokratischen Schritten – wir halten Dir den Rücken frei.
Das bringst Du mit auf diese Reise:
Eine erfolgreich abgeschlossene Ausbildung als MTR / MTRA.
Fundierte, professionelle Erfahrung in den Bereichen MRT und Angiologie/DSA.
Die Bereitschaft, Dich auf ein neues, wertschätzendes System einzulassen und Dich weiterzuentwickeln.
Du musst diesen Weg nicht alleine gehen. Vertraue auf 25 Jahre Erfahrung und ein Netzwerk, das Türen öffnet. Lass uns in einem ganz unverbindlichen, vertraulichen Telefongespräch herausfinden, ob diese Chance Dein Herz höherschlagen lässt.
Mach jetzt den ersten Schritt in Deine neue Freiheit.

☎️ +49 170 311 41 39

📧 h.mathiak@arzt-job-schweiz.ch (https://mailto:h.mathiak@arzt-job-schweiz.ch)

title: Research Fundraiser  80% - 100%
description:
Research Fundraiser (m/f/d) 80% \- 100%  
Eawag, the Swiss Federal Institute of Aquatic Science and Technology, is an internationally networked aquatic research institute within the ETH Domain (Swiss Federal Institutes of Technology). Eawag conducts research, education and expert consulting to achieve the dual goals of meeting direct human needs for water and maintaining the function and integrity of aquatic ecosystems.  
Eawag is currently developing its institutional fundraising activities to strengthen support for research, infrastructure, and strategic initiatives. To drive these efforts and foster meaningful engagement with philanthropic and funding partners, we are looking for a dedicated  
Research Fundraiser (m/f/d) 80% \- 100%  
Would you like to help shape the fundraising activities of an internationally renowned environmental research institute? As part of the ETH Domain, Eawag offers a unique opportunity to build and further develop institutional fundraising in a collaborative and purpose\-driven environment. You will identify suitable funding opportunities and develop sustainable funding partnerships with foundations, institutional funding organisations, philanthropic partners and selected major donors. Working closely with researchers, the Directorate and the Communications team, you will develop compelling funding concepts that communicate Eawag's scientific strengths and strategic objectives in a clear and attractive way to funding partners  
This position offers you a high degree of responsibility and autonomy, as well as the opportunity to actively shape Eawag's fundraising activities and strategic partnerships.  
Your responsibilities  
Conduct research, analysis and identification of potential funding partners, in particular foundations and private major donors.  
Assess and evaluate research projects regarding their fundraising potential.  
Work closely with researchers to develop audience\-specific fundraising materials, such as funding cases, project proposals and progress reports.  
Build and maintain long\-term relationships with funding partners and donors, support the acquisition of new partners and manage funding partnerships throughout the entire funding cycle.  
Manage administrative fundraising processes, including contract management, payment processing and maintenance of data in the CRM system.  
In close collaboration with the Communications team, plan and coordinate visits and events for existing and potential funding partners and develop fundraising\-specific content for Eawag's communication channels.  
Your qualifications  
At least five years of professional experience in fundraising, ideally in foundation fundraising, institutional fundraising or major donor fundraising.  
Proven track record in developing successful funding proposals as well as establishing and maintaining long\-term funding partnerships.  
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, combined with a strong service\-oriented mindset. You build trusted relationships with internal and external stakeholders and collaborate effectively with different research groups.  
A structured and independent working style, with strong organisational skills.  
A strong interest in scientific topics, particularly environmental research; experience in research, higher education, environmental sustainability or healthcare is an advantage.  
Confident use of common digital tools, including CRM systems.  
You have excellent command of German or French and good knowledge of the other language. You are fluent in English at a professional level and able to communicate and negotiate confidently.  
At Eawag, we have a working environment in which people with different experiences, strengths, and perspectives can fully contribute and further develop. Here, you can help us advance! We promote genuine participation, exchange, and mutual understanding. We create structures that enable the compatibility of work and other areas of life, such as care work, and continuously make efforts to reduce barriers.  
Do you have specific requirements regarding the application process or the position, or do you need additional information? Talk to us about it \- we will be happy to support you with possible flexible workplace, working hours, and job design solutions. For further information please visit our website about Eawag as well as our conditions of employment.  
Applications must be submitted by September 15th, 2026, or until the position is filled. However, screening of applicants will begin immediately. Your application should include a cover letter giving a description of the motivation to apply and highlighting the relevant experience, curriculum vitae, and the names (with email addresses and phone numbers) of at least two potential references  
For further information, please contact , Deputy Director, via email.  
We look forward to receiving your application. Please send it through this webpage, as any other way of applying will not be considered. A click on the button below will take you directly to the application form.  
Applications from employment agencies/personnel consultants are not welcome and will not be considered.

Das Luzerner Kantonsspital mit den Standorten Luzern, Sursee und Wolhusen ist ein Unternehmen der LUKS Gruppe und gehört damit einer der führenden Spitalgruppen der Schweiz an. Die über 8500 Mitarbeitenden sind mit Herzlichkeit, Kompetenz und Engagement rund um die Uhr für das Wohl der Patientinnen und Patienten da. Die Kliniken und Institute der LUKS Gruppe bieten medizinische Leistungen von höchster Qualität. Für unser Team suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung Verstärkung.  
Ihr Wirkungsfeld  
In dieser Position sind Sie verantwortlich für das Aufnahmeverfahren elektiver Patientinnen und Patienten am Schalter der chirurgischen Tagesklinik sowie in der Holding Area der Frauenklinik  
Sie koordinieren und organisieren die Patienteneintritte, übernehmen administrative Aufgaben und stellen eine effiziente Planung sowie Korrespondenz im EPIC\-Betriebssystem sicher  
Sie priorisieren Ihre Aufgaben eigenständig, reagieren flexibel auf unvorhergesehene Situationen und tragen aktiv zur Optimierung von Arbeit  
Mit Ihrer ausgeprägten Kundenorientierung und Ihrem hohen Anspruch an Servicequalität unterstützen Sie bei Bedarf auch andere Organisationseinheiten innerhalb der Tagesklinik Chirurgie und übernehmen kompetenzgerecht logistische, administrative sowie hauswirtschaftliche Aufgaben  
Ihre Erfahrung  
Für diese Position setzen wir eine abgeschlossene medizinische Ausbildung sowie Berufserfahrung im medizinischen Umfeld voraus  
Sie sind mit der medizinischen Terminologie und den Abläufen in einem Spital vertraut und verfügen über gute PC\-Kenntnisse; Erfahrungen mit dem EPIC\-System sind von Vorteil  
Mit Ihrem ausgeprägten Organisationstalent, Ihrer hohen Eigenverantwortung und Ihrem Qualitätsbewusstsein leisten Sie einen wesentlichen Beitrag zu einem reibungslosen Ablauf in beiden Tageskliniken  
Zudem zeichnen Sie sich durch eine belastbare, flexible und kommunikative Persönlichkeit aus und behalten auch in herausfordernden Situationen den Überblick sowie die nötige Ruhe  
Ihre Perspektiven  
Wir bieten Ihnen eine herausfordernde Tätigkeit in einem dynamischen Umfeld, wo Ihre Fachkompetenz geschätzt wird und Sie sich kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln können  
Sie sind Teil vom dynamischen, engagierten und interprofessionellen Team der Tagesklinik und können Ihre eigene Persönlichkeit authentisch mit einbringen  
Wir fördern Ihre fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung durch gezielte Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und bieten Ihnen die Möglichkeit, aktiv an der Gestaltung Ihres beruflichen Werdegangs mitzuwirken  
Sie profitieren von geregelten Arbeitszeiten (keine Wochenendarbeit), sehr guten Sozialleistungen und Anstellungsbedingungen. Sie finden diese und weitere Informationen unter folgendem Link:  
Wir freuen uns auf Ihre vollständige online Bewerbung. Bei Fragen wenden Sie sich bitte an Sabina , Abteilungsleiterin Tagesklinik, Tel.: Renate , Teamleitung Tagesklinik, Tel.: .

title: Poêlier - Fumiste
description:
Poêlier-fumiste qualifié et autonome

Pour l’un de nos clients, nous recherchons un poêlier-fumiste qualifié, expérimenté et autonome pour intervenir sur des chantiers de construction, de rénovation ou chez des particuliers.

Vos missions :
Installer et monter des poêles, cheminées, foyers, conduits de fumée et systèmes d’évacuation selon les plans et les normes en vigueur.
Préparer le chantier, effectuer les prises de mesures et adapter les installations aux contraintes techniques du bâtiment.
Réaliser les raccordements, les habillages et les finitions avec soin.
Assurer les travaux de montage et les adaptations de maçonnerie, peinture, ferblanterie/couverture liées à l’installation.
Contrôler la conformité, l’étanchéité et le bon fonctionnement des installations.
Intervenir sur des travaux neufs, de rénovation, de transformation ou de remise en état.
Veiller au respect des normes techniques, des règles de sécurité et des prescriptions de protection incendie.

Votre profil :
Vous êtes qualifié ou expérimenté, capable de travailler de manière autonome.
Vous maîtrisez l’installation de poêles, cheminées et conduits de fumée.
Vous êtes précis, soigneux et attaché à la qualité du travail réalisé.
Vous savez lire les plans, prendre des mesures et vous adapter aux contraintes du chantier.
Vous êtes fiable, polyvalent et appréciez le travail bien fait.

title: Supervisor Engine Shop Floor 100%
description:
We are a world leading Engine MRO service provider, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, with over 90 years of operational experience. Our unwavering dedication to innovation, excellence and environmental responsibility propels us forward on our journey to becoming the leading, most customer-centric, and sustainable Engine focused MRO worldwide.

Working with an extensive network of partners and business development offices in Europe, the USA, Asia and the Middle East, we offer comprehensive, fully customized solutions for the Maintenance, Repair and Overhaul of aircraft engines, airframes and components sales business including impeccable technical support to over 500 customers worldwide. Our mission: We safely power your flight.

We are looking for dedicated and skilled individuals to join our shop floor across several areas and departments at Zurich-Airport. If this sounds appealing to you, we encourage you to apply for our Supervisor position.

As a Supervisor Engine Shop Floor you will be responsible for the development and management of a highly effective Team of approximately 20 to 25 employees, striving for safety and quality, while delivering in time and on cost expectations. You will coordinate the team’s work with its direct stakeholders at SR Technics to the goals and missions of the organization.

Supervisor Engine Shop Floor 100%

Your tasks

- Promote a positive Safety Culture and ensure that Safety and Quality Policy are communicated/promoted and implemented within the Organization.
- Lead and manage a multi-cultural team, fostering performance, engagement, and a positive work environment.
- Drive performance culture through periodic target setting and regular structured follow up with all employees. Apply performance management process (PMP) and leadership with a focus on employee motivation.
- Plan and allocate resources to ensure high productivity and monitor labor efficiency
- Drive personnel development and skill management to meet capacity requirements (OJT, qualifications, certifications, performance evaluations).
- Execute and promote Continuous Improvements in applying Lean principles and 5S to achieve the organization targets and key performance indicators (KPI).
- Participate in, prepare for and be responsible for internal and external audits

Your Profile

- Technical background or technical education (aviation experience is a plus)
- Leadership experience with strong interpersonal skills and leadership skills with the ability to lead, motivate, and develop teams. Minimum 3 years team leadership or strong project leadership preferred.
- Excellent communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills in a fast-paced environment and strong focus on safety, quality, and cost efficiency
- Proactive, independent, and self-initiated working style with high performance drive
- Knowledge and experience in applying Lean/Six Sigma methodology
- Proficient in English (B2+), German is an advantage
- Proficiency with maintenance documentation systems. Microsoft Office required, SAP is an advantage

title: Natural Hazards Mission Lead
description:
ETH Zurich is establishing the ETH Swiss GeoLab, a new interdisciplinary unit of ETH Zürich I Space. ETH Space will soon become one of few strategic centres of ETH Zurich, and encompasses overall five units.

The GeoLab is focused on Earth observation and its applications. The GeoLab uses satellite, airborne, ground-based and in-situ observations. To these diverse data sets it applies AI-driven analysis methods and high-performance computing to develop solutions for specific societal and economic challenges.

Located at the D4 Business Village in Root, close to Lucerne, ETH Swiss GeoLab works at the interface of research, technology development and practical application. In its first phase, the GeoLab is focusing on few selected high-impact application areas where Earth observation, geodata and AI-based analytics can create tangible value for Switzerland. The Natural Hazards Mission focuses initially on mass movements, including landslides and rockfalls, with the aim of improving early detection, monitoring, preparedness and decision support for Swiss practitioners, authorities and infrastructure stakeholders. It builds on stakeholder engagement, solution scoping and community-building activities already underway within GeoLab, including contributions from senior domain experts and partners in the Swiss natural hazards community.

The ETH Swiss GeoLab is led by Prof. Dr Verena Griess and Prof. Dr Thomas Zurbuchen, with Dr Felix Seidel as Managing Director, responsible for the day-to-day operations of this exciting activity. The GeoLab will grow into a project-based hub of around 100 experts over the coming years and will collaborate closely with other ETH units, the Swiss National Supercomputing Centre (CSCS), Swiss research institutions, public-sector stakeholders, natural hazard organisations, industry partners, start-ups and international stakeholders.

This position is offered as a fixed-term appointment for an initial period of two years, with the possibility of extension.

As Natural Hazards Mission Lead, you will lead the research and development portfolio, integration and delivery of GeoLab’s Natural Hazards Mission. Initially focused on landslides and rockfalls, and later expanding to other natural hazards, you will help define the mission vision, translate user needs into research and product requirements, and ensure that GeoLab activities create measurable value for Swiss practice and public decision-making. You will build on ongoing interchange with key stakeholders and solution-scoping activities already underway within GeoLab, and work closely with senior domain-relevant partners, technical teams and experts.

You will report to the Managing Director of ETH Swiss GeoLab and work closely with GeoLab’s Natural Hazards Community & Solutions Lead, other GeoLab mission teams, the Research Program Support team, and the Geo-Intelligence team and external partners. You will define priorities, milestones and decision points, lead mission delivery and will have the authority to prioritize, redirect, and pivot or pause activities within your research and development portfolio, the approved mission charter, budget and governance framework.

As part of your role, you will:

On behalf of the GeoLab leadership team, define an ambitious and coherent research and development portfolio for the Natural Hazards Mission, initially centred on landslides and rockfalls
Translate identified critical operational gaps into measurable outcomes that create value for practitioners, authorities and decision-makers
Engage with local, cantonal and federal authorities, infrastructure operators, practitioners, industry and expert communities, in coordination with GeoLab leadership and existing Natural Hazards community activities
Translate operational challenges into research, data, product and technical requirements
Establish measurable mission outcomes, roadmaps, assumptions and success criteria aligned with Swiss natural hazard needs and the overall GeoLab strategy; you will also track progress actively against these outcomes
Manage the delegated mission budget and define priorities, milestones, decision points and success criteria and track finances and successes in that framework, through regular reporting activities to GeoLab leadership and other stakeholders
Work with the Geo-Lab’s Intelligence team – the team deeply focused on AI and Earth  observation foundational models - and external performers to drive pilots, field validation, operational testing and integration into user workflows
Assess evidence and performance, and recommend continuation, redirection, scaling, pausing or termination of activities
Identify and mobilise strong ETH groups, research institutions, engineering and geology offices, remote-sensing companies, public agencies and implementation partners
Represent ETH Swiss GeoLab in Swiss natural hazard, scientific, policy and industry communities, in coordination with GeoLab leadership and existing Natural Hazards community activities
Communicate mission goals, progress, evidence and lessons learned to internal and external stakeholders
Guide and train students, researchers and external contributors where required and support the transfer of resulting capabilities into operational practice
In summary, you understand the needs of practitioners and decision-makers in the field of natural hazards and their relation to Earth observations from space and are motivated by the opportunity to translate research and technology into practical solutions with measurable impact.

Specifically, we are looking for someone with:

A Master’s or PhD degree (preferred) in natural hazards, geosciences, engineering, risk management or related fields
Several years of experience in natural hazard practice, applied research, public administration, consulting, engineering or industry, preferably but not necessarily in Switzerland
Strong expertise and understanding of natural hazards with demonstrated examples of dashboard and tracking tools for others to gain insights in these projects
Proven ability to identify important operational problems and translate them into actionable initiatives
With a track-record of successful collaborations in diverse teams and have demonstrated your excitement to not only do research but apply that research to the benefit of others.
Experience in mission, programme or applied R&D portfolio design
Strong project, portfolio and budget management skills with demonstrated examples of transparent reporting, dashboard and tracking tools for others to gain insights in these projects
Excellent stakeholder management skills across diverse public authorities, academia, industry and expert communities
The ability to work across disciplinary and organisational boundaries and to lead through influence
Strong judgement skills under uncertainty and the willingness to challenge established approaches constructively
Excellent communication and listening skills, and great presentation skills in various modalities
Excellent written and spoken English and German; French is an asset
You are mission-driven, entrepreneurial, a strong learner and comfortable working in a newly established and evolving organisation. You have a track-record of successful team participation and leadership and an excitement for hard and impactful work. You combine scientific credibility with pragmatic decision-making, economic awareness and a clear focus on adoption, operational relevance and measurable value. In doing so, you want to work on the best idea, not necessarily your best idea.

A rare opportunity to help build ETH Swiss GeoLab from its early phase and shape a new national initiative for Earth observation
A mission-driven role with high visibility and strong societal relevance
The opportunity to develop solutions for pressing natural hazard challenges in Switzerland, and with broad international impact through transferable methods and lessons learned
A workplace in Root/Lucerne, embedded in an active innovation ecosystem and closely connected to ETH Zurich
We look forward to receiving your online application with the following documents:

Your CV
Diplomas and work certificates
A short motivation statement outlining your interest in ETH Swiss GeoLab and the Natural Hazards Mission
A video (max 2 mins) about you and your motivation for this position
Please note that we exclusively accept applications submitted through the ETH Zurich online application portal. Applications via email or postal services will not be considered.

Further information about ETH Swiss GeoLab can be found on our website. Questions regarding the position should be directed to Dr Felix Seidel, Managing Director ETH Swiss GeoLab, felix.seidel@eaps.ethz.ch.

We look forward to receiving your application!

We would like to point out that the pre-selection is carried out by the responsible recruiters and not by artificial intelligence.

title: SAP Technical Service Delivery Lead 100%
description:
SAP Technical Service Delivery Lead 100% (f/m/d)  
Rieter is the world’s leading system supplier for processing natural and man\-made fibers into short\-staple and long\-staple yarn, as well as for the production of filament yarns, man\-made fibers and nonwovens. With its comprehensive technology portfolio, Rieter covers the entire textile value chain – from fiber to yarn, and from polymer melt to texturized filament, synthetic staple fibers and nonwoven. Headquartered in Winterthur, Switzerland, the company designs and engineers complex spinning plants, machines, systems, and components that enable an efficient and economical production. Rieter’s leading technologies ensure minimal resource consumption, making a significant contribution to sustainability across the global textile value chain. Rieter has a history spanning more than 230 years, operates 22 production sites in nine countries, and employs around 6 400 people worldwide, approximately 9% of them in Switzerland. Rieter is listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange under the ticker symbol RIEN.  
We are seeking an experienced SAP Technical Service Delivery Lead to manage our enterprise SAP landscape, specialising in RISE with SAP, cloud transformation, and SAP technical operations. About us  
The Space Research and Planetary Sciences Division (WP) at the University of Bern has been at the forefront of space research for over 50 years. Since conducting its first experiment on the Moon as part of the Apollo 11 mission, the division has participated in numerous missions led by major space agencies such as ESA, NASA, and JAXA.  
The Space Research and Planetary Sciences Division at the University of Bern is seeking a skilled and motivated Test or Electrical Engineer to support ongoing work with the ground reference model of NIM (Neutral and Ion Mass spectrometer), part of ESA's JUICE (JUpiter ICy moons Explorer) mission. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute directly to the engineering, testing, and scientific support of one of Europe's premier planetary science missions.  
Key Responsibilities  
The successful candidate will play a central role in supporting the development, testing, and operation of NIM, including:  
Planning and conducting calibrations and tests of the instrument under various operational conditionsLeading the diagnosis, troubleshooting, and repair of hardware and system issuesCharacterizing and optimizing critical components and subsystemsParticipating in the development and validation of operation and software tools  
Helping investigate in\-flight issues and support related analysis  
Maintaining and improving technical documentation, including design and operations manuals  
Managing inventory and procurement activities for hardware

A higher education degree (ETH, Uni, FH) in engineering, physics, or a related technical field

A motivated, hands\-on, and collaborative approach to problem\-solving (team player)  
Proficient written English skills required; basic knowledge of German is desirable.  
We offer  
A dynamic and collaborative environment at one of Europe's leading space research institutes

Opportunities to grow technical and scientific expertise in a cutting\-edge laboratory  
Highly interdisciplinary work environment (including mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, and software engineering)  
Flexible working arrangements and support for professional development  
The position is initially for one year with the possibility of extension.

International reputation  
Team\-oriented work

Strong research infrastructure and international network

The University of Bern not only offers exciting tasks but also an environment that actively promotes development, diversity, and equal opportunities. Discover what makes us stand out as an employer and how you can grow with us.
