title: Agriculture Mission Lead – Earth Observation and Agricultural Decision Support
description:
ETH Zurich is establishing the ETH Swiss GeoLab, a new interdisciplinary unit of ETH Zürich I Space. ETH Space will soon become one of few strategic centres of ETH Zurich, and encompasses overall five units.

The GeoLab is focused on Earth observation and its applications. The GeoLab uses satellite, airborne, ground-based and in-situ observations. To these diverse data sets it applies AI-driven analysis methods and high-performance computing to develop solutions for specific societal and economic challenges.

Located at the D4 Business Village in Root, close to Lucerne, ETH Swiss GeoLab works at the interface of research, technology development and practical application. In its first phase, the GeoLab is focusing on few selected high-impact application areas where Earth observation, geodata and AI-based analytics can create tangible value for Switzerland. In agriculture, this includes challenges related to productivity, resilience, resource efficiency, environmental performance and decision support for practitioners and policymakers.

The ETH Swiss GeoLab is led by Prof. Dr Verena Griess and Prof. Dr Thomas Zurbuchen, with Dr Felix Seidel as Managing Director, responsible for the day-to-day operations of this exciting activity. The GeoLab will grow into a project-based hub of around 100 experts over the coming years and will collaborate closely with other ETH units, the Swiss national centre for supercomputing (CSCS), Swiss research institutions, public-sector stakeholders, agricultural organisations, industry partners, start-ups and international stakeholders.

This position is offered as a fixed-term appointment for an initial period of two years, with the possibility of extension.

As Agriculture Mission Lead, you will spearhead the agriculture focused initiative - the GeoLab Agriculture Mission - within GeoLab. You will identify high-impact challenges in Swiss agriculture through direct interchange with key stakeholders and rely on domain-relevant data and experts. Moreover, you will define ambitious mission outcomes, translate practitioner needs into research and product goals, and drive solutions through field validation and adoption.

You will work closely with other GeoLab mission teams, its Research Program Support team, and the Geo-Intelligence team (plus the external partners mentioned above). You will lead cross-functional and external experts and will have the authority to prioritize, redirect, and pivot or pause activities within the approved mission charter, budget and governance framework.

As part of your role, you will:

On behalf of the GeoLab leadership team, define an ambitious and coherent Agriculture Mission addressing major opportunities in productivity, resilience, resource efficiency and environmental performance
Identify operational gaps where ETH Swiss GeoLab can create distinctive value for Swiss agriculture
Engage directly with farmers, agricultural advisory services, producer organisations, cooperatives, cantonal and federal authorities, insurers, technology providers and industry partners
Identify unmet needs, operational constraints, incentives and economic drivers in agricultural practice
Translate agricultural challenges into clear research, data, product and technical requirements
Assess user value, economic viability, scalability and adoption potential
Establish measurable mission outcomes, roadmaps, assumptions and success criteria aligned with Swiss agricultural needs and the overall GeoLab strategy; you will also track progress actively against these outcomes
Manage the delegated mission budget and define priorities, milestones and decision points and track finances and successes in that framework, through regular reporting activities to GeoLab leadership and other stakeholders
Work with GeoLab’s Geo-Intelligence team – the team deeply focused on AI and analyses of big data amounts - and external performers to drive field pilots, validation, operational testing and integration into agricultural workflows
Identify and mobilise strong research groups, agricultural organisations, technology companies, start-ups, service providers, insurers, public agencies and implementation partners
Represent ETH Swiss GeoLab within Swiss agricultural, scientific, policy and innovation communities
Communicate mission goals, progress, evidence and lessons learned at field events, workshops and conferences
Guide and train students, researchers and external contributors where required and support knowledge transfer into agricultural practice.
In summary, you understand the realities of agricultural practice and are motivated by the opportunity to translate research, Earth observation data and data-driven technologies into practical solutions with measurable impact.

Specifically, we are looking for someone with:

A Master’s or PhD degree (preferred) in agricultural sciences, agronomy, crop science, agricultural engineering, environmental sciences or related fields
Several years of experience applied research, program delivery or operational implementation, in agricultural practice, advisory services, agri-technology, public administration or industry, preferably but not necessarily in Switzerland
Strong expertise and understanding in agricultural practice, production systems, agronomy and crop management
Proven ability to identify important operational problems and translate them into actionable initiatives
With a track-record of successful collaborations in diverse teams and have demonstrated your excitement to not only do research but apply that research to the benefit of others.
Experience in mission, programme or applied R&D portfolio design
Strong project, portfolio and budget management skills with demonstrated examples of dashboard and tracking tools for others to gain insights in these projects
Excellent stakeholder management skills across diverse practitioners, public authorities, academia, industry and expert communities
The ability to work across disciplinary and organisational boundaries and to lead through influence
Strong judgement skills under uncertainty and the willingness to challenge established approaches constructively
Excellent communication and listening skills, and great presentation skills in various modalities
Excellent written and spoken English and German; French is an asset
You are mission-driven, entrepreneurial, a strong learner and comfortable working in a newly established and evolving organization. You have a track-record of successful team participation and leadership and an excitement for hard and impactful work. You combine scientific credibility with pragmatic decision-making, economic awareness and a clear focus on adoption, scalability and public value. In doing so, you want to work on the best idea, not necessarily your best idea.

The great and rare opportunity to help build ETH Swiss GeoLab from its early phase and shape a new national initiative for Earth observation
A mission-driven role with high visibility and strong relevance for Swiss agriculture and with broad international impact due to the learnings from it
A dynamic, interdisciplinary and entrepreneurial environment at one of the world’s leading technical universities
A workplace in Root/Lucerne, embedded in an active innovation ecosystem and closely connected to ETH Zurich and particularly ETH Zurich I Space
We look forward to receiving your online application with the following documents:

Your CV
Diplomas and work certificates
A short motivation statement outlining your interest in ETH Swiss GeoLab and the Agriculture Mission
A video (max 2 mins) about you and your motivation for this position.

title: Gasoline Blending Operator #R-018360#
employer: TRAFIGURA PTE LTD, Singapour,succursale de Genève
description:
Main purpose
Responsible for execution of Gasoline Blending operations and trader support. The role co-ordinates all aspects of post-deal trading activity to ensure contract execution runs efficiently, provides commercial and market information to the trader as necessary, and reviews and comments on contracts and tenders to ensure consistency with the trade ticket and recap.

Key responsibilities
For all Gasoline blended cargoes, be the key point of contact between the commercial desk and external stakeholders.
Liaise with terminals and vessels to ensure commercial blending plans are followed in line with the traders’ expectations.
Ensure with inspection companies that quality is as per blend plans and in line with contractual provisions.
Investigate Quantity losses and explore remedial action.
Trouble shoot when plans change and provide solutions.
Actively manage the terminals line up to mitigate demurrage.
Review stowage plans and monitor vessel progress during voyages.
Appoint third-party providers in line with group policy; oversee clean acceptance of vessels on subjects and chartering progress.
Liaise and co-ordinate with Finance, providing accurate and timely data needed for the issuance of L/Cs and P/Us.
Issue documentary instructions to suppliers and handle all aspects of customs exportation/importation where applicable.
Maintain good contract and shipping files electronically; keep Pluto updated regularly and minimise exceptions.
Complete voyage and storage reconciliations to identify and investigate loss/gain differences for each operation.
Monitor and advise the deals desk of all costs related to each transaction, maintaining P&L awareness.
Ensure operations are optimised to best commercial advantage, meeting all contractual obligations (e.g. minimising demurrage exposure).
Maximise recoveries; document, present and secure payment of all claims to third parties.
Maintain strong working relationships with trade support divisions — claims, deals desk, trade finance and chartering — and with counterparts and third-party service providers.
Train and develop less experienced members of the operations team to increase knowledge and commercial awareness.
Follow internal procedures and company policies; adhere to Trafigura's Code of Conduct, HSEC Policy and Business Principles.
Identify operational issues and escalate to the Regional Manager as appropriate.

Required qualifications
At least 5 years' experience in cargo operations in a global oil trading company.
Experience working on Gasoline cargo operations with a preference for experience with blending operations.
Ability to interpret the operational requirements of contracts and comment on operational aspects; understanding of the basic legal framework supporting oil contracts.
Ability to interpret charter party terms against the interacting oil contract; good understanding of common ship operations and terminology.
Good understanding of relevant petroleum product specifications, analytical methods, laboratory precision and inspection procedures.
Good understanding of different types of financial instruments, their uses, and the importance of LOIs and shipping documents within the trading process.

Preferred qualifications
Experience across multiple product desks (Gasoline, Distillates and Fuel Oil).
Familiarity with Pluto or similar trade operations management systems.
Exposure to storage logistics and reconciliation processes.

Attributes for success
Strong decision-making ability — comfortable navigating ambiguity and complexity in a fast-moving trading environment.
Effective networker who builds and maintains relationships with counterparts, service providers and internal stakeholders.
Organised and detail-oriented, with strong planning and prioritisation skills.
Resourceful and commercially aware, with a proactive approach to problem-solving.

Department overview
The Oil Cargo Operations department is responsible for the efficient and effective management of the physical movement of oil and petroleum products. The team ensures commodities are transported from origin to destination, meeting all contractual obligations and regulatory requirements. The department works closely with Traders, Finance, Deals Desk (Risk and P&L) and Chartering to support the full trade lifecycle.

Unternehmensbeschreibung

Unser Herz schlägt türkis.

Arbeiten bei Motel One ist wie zu Freunden kommen, wo Wertschätzung und Unterstützung großgeschrieben werden und die individuelle Persönlichkeit willkommen ist. Wir begegnen uns auf Augenhöhe und verstehen uns als ein Team: von der Geschäftsführung bis zu den Auszubildenden.

Als Begründer und Vorreiter des Budget Design Konzepts expandieren wir erfolgreich in den Metropolen Europas und darüber hinaus. Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams und gestalten Sie gemeinsam mit uns Motel One.

Stellenbeschreibung

Benefits:

Du bist bei uns genau richtig, wenn Du ein herzlicher Gastgeber bist und Leidenschaft für die Hotellerie mitbringst. Ausserdem hast Du ein Auge fürs Detail, sowie für Sauberkeit und Ordnung. Du zeichnest dich durch ein hohes Qualitätsbewusstsein und Serviceorientierung aus und bist bereit dich stetig weiterzuentwickeln.

title: Security Engineer (gn) Microsoft Modern Workplace (IT-Administrator/in)
description:
Why SoftwareOne?

SoftwareOne is a global provider of software and cloud solutions. With a presence in over 70 countries and more than 12,000 professionals, we help organizations optimize software investments, modernize applications, and unlock the value of cloud, data, and AI.

Our people are at the core of everything we do. We enable collaboration across borders, continuous learning, and opportunities to grow in a fast-evolving technology landscape. Whether your focus is on technology, customer success, or business operations, your ideas matter, and your contributions make a difference.

Join a global team where you can build your skills, work with leading technologies, and make a real impact for our customers.

Secruity Engineer (gn) Microsoft Modern Workplace

- Are you equally comfortable with technical and conceptual topics and ready to take ownership in diverse customer projects?
- Are you looking for an environment where you can work cross-functionally, help shape innovation, and create real value together with Sales, Delivery, and technology partners?

Practical information:
Location: Romandie-Switzerland | Working model: Hybrid | Seniority: Senior | Language requirements: Very good written and spoken French and English

The Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Security Engineer with strong expertise in Microsoft Security, Identity and/or Compliance and AI-enabled Modern Workplace or Cloud Services. The successful candidate will design, implement and deliver enterprise-scale security transformations across Microsoft 365, Azure and Microsoft Security technologies, helping customers strengthen their security posture while enabling productivity and innovation.

Key Responsibilities

Security & Identity

- Design and implement enterprise security architectures aligned with Zero Trust principles.
- Lead customer engagements around Identity & Access Management, Identity Governance and Privileged Access Management.
- Implement and optimize Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, MFA, Passwordless Authentication, Identity Governance, Access Reviews, Lifecycle Workflows and Privileged Identity Management.
- Support hybrid identity transformations involving Active Directory, Entra ID and federated identity providers.

Cloud Security

- Design and deploy security solutions across Azure and Microsoft cloud environments.
- Implement and optimize Microsoft Defender for Cloud capabilities, including workloads such as servers, storage, databases, containers and Kubernetes where relevant.
- Conduct cloud security posture reviews and support customers in improving governance, policy management and secure workload design.
- Threat Protection & SOC Modernization
- Design, implement and optimize Microsoft Defender for Cloud. Defender XDR solutions including Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Defender for Office 365 and Defender for Cloud Apps.
- Implement and tune Microsoft Sentinel including data onboarding, detection engineering, analytics rules, automation and SOAR use cases.
- Contribute to threat hunting, incident response readiness and security operations process improvement.

Data Security & Compliance

- Design and deploy Microsoft Purview solutions for information protection, sensitivity labels, data classification, DLP, records management and data lifecycle management.
- Support customers in meeting compliance, governance and data protection objectives.
- Translate regulatory and business requirements into practical security and compliance controls.

AI & Security Innovation

- Lead customer discussions around secure AI adoption and responsible use of Microsoft Copilot and Security Copilot.
- Deliver readiness assessments and governance frameworks for Copilot-enabled environments.
- Define controls to protect sensitive data and identities in AI-enabled collaboration and cloud scenarios.

Professional Experience

- Years of experience in enterprise security consulting, engineering or architecture.
- Proven experience delivering Microsoft security, identity, and/or compliance or cloud security projects.
- Experience working directly with enterprise customers and senior stakeholders.
- Strong consulting mindset with the ability to translate business requirements into pragmatic security solutions.
- Structured, self-reliant, solution-oriented working style with strong customer and team orientation.

Preferred Certifications

- SC-100 – Cybersecurity Architect Expert
- SC-300 – Identity and Access Administrator
- SC-200 – Security Operations Analyst
- SC-400 – Information Protection Administrator
- AZ-500 – Azure Security Engineer
- MS-102 – Microsoft 365 Administrator
- Additional Microsoft Security, Azure, Purview, Sentinel, Copilot or Security Copilot etc. certifications are a plus

Our company benefits vary based on your location, but always include:

- Global company culture: We defined our 6 core values through our company culture (https://www.softwareone.com/en/our-story/our-values)
- A mentor who supports your successful start and is at your side with advice and action
- President’s Club: Recognition awarded by leadership and your peers
- Flexible work: Do great work from anywhere but also visit local office to deliver excellence in team relationship
- Lifelong education: A variety of training and development opportunities
- Hire to Grow: We optimize our internal structures and feedback culture constantly to be your Employer of Choice, today and in future
- You can find all current benefits here: https://www.softwareone.com/de-at/karriere/dach/benefits (https://www.softwareone.com/de-at/karriere/dach/benefits)

title: Supervisor Engine Shop Floor 100%
description:
We are a world leading Engine MRO service provider, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, with over 90 years of operational experience. Our unwavering dedication to innovation, excellence and environmental responsibility propels us forward on our journey to becoming the leading, most customer-centric, and sustainable Engine focused MRO worldwide.

Working with an extensive network of partners and business development offices in Europe, the USA, Asia and the Middle East, we offer comprehensive, fully customized solutions for the Maintenance, Repair and Overhaul of aircraft engines, airframes and components sales business including impeccable technical support to over 500 customers worldwide. Our mission: We safely power your flight.

We are looking for dedicated and skilled individuals to join our shop floor across several areas and departments at Zurich-Airport. If this sounds appealing to you, we encourage you to apply for our Supervisor position.

As a Supervisor Engine Shop Floor you will be responsible for the development and management of a highly effective Team of approximately 20 to 25 employees, striving for safety and quality, while delivering in time and on cost expectations. You will coordinate the team’s work with its direct stakeholders at SR Technics to the goals and missions of the organization.

Supervisor Engine Shop Floor 100%

Your tasks

- Promote a positive Safety Culture and ensure that Safety and Quality Policy are communicated/promoted and implemented within the Organization.
- Lead and manage a multi-cultural team, fostering performance, engagement, and a positive work environment.
- Drive performance culture through periodic target setting and regular structured follow up with all employees. Apply performance management process (PMP) and leadership with a focus on employee motivation.
- Plan and allocate resources to ensure high productivity and monitor labor efficiency
- Drive personnel development and skill management to meet capacity requirements (OJT, qualifications, certifications, performance evaluations).
- Execute and promote Continuous Improvements in applying Lean principles and 5S to achieve the organization targets and key performance indicators (KPI).
- Participate in, prepare for and be responsible for internal and external audits

Your Profile

- Technical background or technical education (aviation experience is a plus)
- Leadership experience with strong interpersonal skills and leadership skills with the ability to lead, motivate, and develop teams. Minimum 3 years team leadership or strong project leadership preferred.
- Excellent communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills in a fast-paced environment and strong focus on safety, quality, and cost efficiency
- Proactive, independent, and self-initiated working style with high performance drive
- Knowledge and experience in applying Lean/Six Sigma methodology
- Proficient in English (B2+), German is an advantage
- Proficiency with maintenance documentation systems. Microsoft Office required, SAP is an advantage

description:
At Ypsomed, we are shaping the future of medical technology together \- with the aim of sustainably improving the quality of life for people with chronic conditions. We promote an open corporate culture in which diversity is valued, and new perspectives are welcome. Our employees take responsibility, work in an interdisciplinary manner and develop innovative solutions with real added value for society.  
As our Human Factors Engineer \& Service Lead, you will build and grow Ypsomed's Human Factors service offering for pharmaceutical partners worldwide. You will advise customers on Human Factors strategies, lead international HF programs, and contribute to innovative combination products. With your expertise, you will help deliver user\-centered solutions that support successful regulatory approvals.  
Human Factors Engineer \& Service Lead \| 80 \- 100%  
Ref. No. 7961  
Location: Burgdorf \| Hybrid  
Your main tasks  
Take end\-to\-end responsibility for establishing Human Factors (HF) as a service offering and drive the acquisition of HF service projects in close collaboration with Business Development  
Act as a trusted advisor to pharmaceutical customers on HF strategies for combination products, with a strong focus on efficient regulatory pathways and ensuring that service offerings are aligned with customer needs  
Conduct and coordinate international HF studies, including setting timelines and budgets and planning, monitoring, and documenting formative, summative, and comparative use HF studies, including studies involving large participant cohorts  
Manage external consultants, vendors, and testing facilities as required  
Lead or support HF activities related to Instructions for Use (IFU) and user interfaces as part of the overall HF program  
Create, maintain, and review usability engineering documentation required for regulatory submissions, such as study reports, HF reports, and threshold analyses, in close collaboration with customer teams and internal stakeholders  
Collaborate closely within the Science \& Evidence team to translate insights from HF studies and user populations into strategic publications, evidence\-generation activities, and market differentiation  
Stay current with the global HF regulatory landscape and contribute to shaping Ypsomed’s position in collaboration with industry bodies and consortium representatives  
Your profile  
A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Factors, Ergonomics, Usability Engineering, Product Design, Psychology, or a related field, combined with at least 7 years of professional experience as a Human Factors consultant, including experience within the combination product or related medical device industry  
An entrepreneurial mindset, a strong sense of ownership, strong business acumen, and a clear understanding of how to develop, position, and scale value\-adding service offerings in a customer\-focused environment  
Extensive hands\-on experience in planning, conducting, and documenting large\-scale Human Factors studies for medical devices and/or combination products, as well as strong project management skills and proven experience managing multiple complex projects simultaneously  
Experience with international development programs and regulatory submissions across key markets, including the United States (FDA), the European Union (EU MDR), China (NMPA), and Canada (Health Canada)  
Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with English proficiency at C1 level or above; German is an asset. Demonstrated ability to work effectively across cultures in diverse, international environments  
Willingness to travel internationally approximately 20% of the time, including to the United States; authorization to travel to the United States is therefore required  
Ypsomed \- making the treatment of chronic diseases possible  
More than 2,000 employees worldwide develop and produce injection and infusion systems for self\-medication with the Ypsomed Group. We are a successful, rapidly growing, family\-owned company headquartered in Burgdorf (CH) with various production sites and subsidiaries around the world. With our market\-leading products and solutions, we enable people all over the globe to self\-treatment. Despite chronic diseases such as diabetes, obesity, or certain types of cancer, they are provided with the greatest possible quality of life.  
Contact  
Heiko Sieger  
Workforce Acquisition \& Engagement Partner  
Your future place of work  
Burgdorf

description:
Events Planning Manager  
People at 1800m above sea level are shaping the Luxury Mountain Travel. Our dynamic and international community offers our guests smart Luxury for an inimitable holiday experience. As a member of the Luxury Kulm Group you are part of the key to our success. Together, we make every stay deeply inspiring, unique and distinctive. And as such, we embrace our culture: understated luxury, inspiration, and a life experience. Together, we make it happen. This is your chance to be a member of our shaping culture:  
This is what you move with us  
Elegant gala dinners, exclusive weddings, high\-profile business events and bespoke celebrations \- across two of the most distinguished houses in Switzerland. As Events Planning Manager, you guide the entire planning journey from proposal through to operational handover, ensuring that every event is accurately planned, efficiently coordinated and flawlessly executed at both the Kulm Hotel St. and the Grand Hotel Kronenhof Pontresina.  
Your Mission:  
End\-to\-End Event Planning: From the qualified enquiry through proposal and contract to the operational handover \- including accommodation, meeting rooms, catering, technical requirements and personal guest preferences.  
Client Experience: You guide your clients through every stage of the planning process: briefings, site inspections, amendments and professional follow\-up \- always prompt, polished and personalised.  
Administrative Excellence: Preparation of contracts, confirmations, function sheets and Banquet Event Orders (BEOs), maintenance of all event files in PMS and CRM, and monitoring of deposits and payment schedules.  
Operational Interface: You lead the internal event planning meetings and liaise closely with Banqueting, Kitchen, Rooms Division, Reservations, Revenue Management and Front Office across both hotels.  
Leadership \& Development: You lead and coach our Events Coordinator(s) day to day, set priorities and establish shared planning standards, templates and processes.  
Room to Shape: You play an active part in building the new integrated Events organisation of the Kulm Group and develop best practices for both hotels.  
This is you  
Education \& Experience: Bachelor’s degree in hospitality, Events Management or Business Administration and at least three years of experience in hotel events, conference services or event planning, ideally covering meetings, incentives, weddings and private celebrations in the luxury segment.  
Organisational Talent: Outstanding attention to detail, a sure instinct for priorities and the ability to manage several projects simultaneously with composure.  
Process \& Systems Knowledge: Confident command of PMS, CRM and event management systems, along with excellent Microsoft Office 365 skills.  
Personality: Dependable, solution\-oriented and calm under pressure; you build lasting relationships with clients and with every operational department.  
Language Skills: Fluent and stylistically assured German and English, written and spoken; further languages are a plus.  
Start: October or by agreement.  
If you would like to shape the future of Events at the Kulm Group, we look forward to receiving your full application.

description:
Executive Assistant \- LE4 \- DFAT \- Geneva  
Application Deadline: August 26, 2026\.  
Department: DFAT \- Geneva.  
Employment Type: Permanent \- Full Time.  
Location: Australian Permanent Mission, Geneva  
Workplace: Onsite  
Compensation and Benefits: CHF 95,784 / yeat, 20 days annual leave, 50% employer contribution to health insurance and accident insurance, and to a retirement fund.  
Applications are sought from persons interested in employment within the Australian Permanent Mission to the United Nations in Geneva.  
The successful applicant will be engaged as a locally engaged staff member by the Australian Permanent Mission to the United Nations in Geneva.  
Please be advised that the Australian Permanent Mission to the United Nations in Geneva does not assist with relocation. Any costs associated with taking up the position would be the responsibility of the successful candidate.  
A standard probity check will be undertaken prior to commencement for the successful applicant.  
Executive Assistant \- LE4 \- DFAT \- Geneva  
About The Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade  
The role of the Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT) is to advance the interests of Australia and Australians internationally. This involves strengthening Australia’s security, enhancing Australia’s prosperity, delivering an effective and high\-quality overseas aid program and helping Australian travellers and Australians overseas. The department provides foreign, trade and development policy advice to the Australian Government. DFAT also works with other Australian Government agencies to drive coordination of Australia’s pursuit of global, regional and bilateral interests.  
About the Position  
Under direction, the Executive Assistant to the Ambassador and Deputy Ambassador provides high\-level executive, administrative and organisational support at the Australian Permanent Mission to the United Nations in Geneva. The position also organises official events and functions.  
Due to the sensitive nature of the work involved, this position will need to be able to hold and maintain a national security clearance recognised by DFAT.  
Key responsibilities of the position include but are not limited to:  
Provide high\-level executive support to the Ambassador and Deputy Ambassador, ensuring the effective operation of executive offices in a fast\-paced and sensitive environment.  
Manage and prioritise correspondence, invitations, briefing materials and requests, exercising sound judgement to determine priority, action and compliance requirements.  
Coordinate official visits and delegation programs for Ministers, senior officials and high\-level visitors, balancing competing priorities and operational requirements.  
Plan and deliver representational events, meetings and official engagements, liaising with internal and external stakeholders to achieve Mission objectives.  
Manage representational expenditure and financial administration, including forecasting, acquittals, reconciliations and reporting in accordance with DFAT policies and procedures.  
Coordinate travel, logistics and related administrative arrangements for executive leadership and official activities, ensuring compliance with relevant policies and procedures.  
Monitor security, operational and workflow risks, implementing required controls and escalating issues as appropriate.  
Provide administrative guidance, maintain effective business systems and support team coordination, contributing to continuous improvement and organisational effectiveness.  
Required Qualifications/Experience/Knowledge/Skills  
Proven experience in similar Executive Assistant role/s  
Excellent written and verbal communication skills  
Ability to work with and support a team. Ability to develop and maintain respectful and effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders  
Ability to manage time, prioritise, plan, handle multiple tasks and work well under pressure  
Financial management and organisational skills  
Discretion and sound judgement in handling confidential information  
Extensive experience using Microsoft Office and electronic applications  
Exceptional customer service and interpersonal skills  
Fluency in English is required, with fluency in French highly regarded  
Knowledge of, or an ability to quickly acquire a knowledge of Australian Government legislation or departmental policy and guidelines in relation to the position duties  
Desirable  
Previous experience working in an embassy, international organisation, or comparable environment.  
Security Requirements  
Australian NV2 security clearance or the ability to obtain and maintain this. Therefore applicants must hold Australian citizenship to be considered.  
Please note that candidates who hold citizenship or dual citizenship of Switzerland are not eligible for an Australian Security Clearance.  
How to Apply  
Where the application form asks for a cover letter, please provide a written pitch of no more than 500 words demonstrating your suitability to perform the key responsibilities of the position. Your pitch is your opportunity to tell us why you are the right candidate for the role. It will be assessed on your ability to demonstrate, or have the potential to develop, the required skills, knowledge, experience and qualifications to proficiently perform the role. Relevant examples and accomplishments will strengthen your application. Please attach a copy of your pitch with your CV.  
The Fair Work Act 2009 is not intended to apply to the employment of Locally Engaged Staff (LES) at Australia’s overseas diplomatic and consular missions. The successful candidate’s terms and conditions of employment will be governed by the laws of Switzerland.

Manager \- Tax Services \- Indirect Tax/VAT (Zug or Luzern)  
The opportunity  
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your voice and perspective to help EY become even better too.  
We are market leaders in numerous tax services and advise our clients on all tax issues. We optimize the business and legal structures of our global customers and support a healthy development of our clients, from renowned multinational companies to flourishing startups.  
Develop your individual skills in interdisciplinary and multicultural teams with us in our offices in Zug or Luzern! Indirect taxes operate in an extremely dynamic environment in which numerous changes are constantly planned and implemented \- help us and our customers to master the challenges ahead.  
Embark on your next journey and join our unique Indirect Tax Team to help solve exciting problems on a daily basis!  
Your key responsibilities  
Ensure compliance with indirect tax rules on a local and global scale, supporting diverse clients across all industries, from manufactured products to real estate and financial activities  
Address the complexities of a constantly evolving tax landscape, keeping abreast with e\-commerce VAT rules, and rapidly spreading e\-invoicing requirements  
Focus on increased VAT efficiency within supply chains and support clients in transitioning to a digitalized world  
Be a key pilar of our team growth, supporting and training our more junior colleagues and managing your projects from identifying clients' needs to delivering our recommendations  
Collaborate with our global network of Indirect tax experts dedicated to delivering holistic, practice\-oriented solutions  
Work closely with colleagues in Tax, Assurance, and Advisory Services to comprehensively meet clients' needs and offer innovative solutions  
Tackle complex Swiss and international tax questions within an interdisciplinary environment, fostering constant learning opportunities and personal development  
Engage in exciting projects at the intersection of business and law, gaining deep insights into various industries and business areas through daily client interactions and communication with tax authorities

A recognized diploma in Law and/or Economics, preferably obtained from a Swiss University or equivalent foreign diploma; certified Tax Expert recognition is considered an asset  
5 to 7 years of experience in indirect tax consulting, preferably gained at one of the Big4 or a comparable consulting firm, either in Switzerland or internationally; additional experience as an in\-house VAT advisor is considered a valuable asset  
Proven track record as a manager who has responsibly handled client mandates and guided less experienced colleagues through complex projects  
Fluent in German and English, essential for our international company operations; proficiency in other foreign languages is highly appreciated  
Demonstrate commitment and initiative, essential qualities for shaping and advancing your career with us  
Thrive in a great working environment where your proactive approach to career development is encouraged and supported  
You have an agile, growth\-oriented mindset. What you know matters. But the right mindset is just as important in determining success. We're looking for people who are innovative, can work in an agile way and keep pace with a rapidly changing world  
You are curious and purpose driven. We're looking for people who see opportunities instead of challenges, who ask better questions to seek better answers  
You are inclusive. We're looking for people who seek out and embrace diverse perspectives, who value differences, and team inclusively to build safety and trust

title: Sachbearbeiter Kundendienst DE/FR 80-100%
description:
Sachbearbeiter Kundendienst DE/FR 80\-100% (m/w/d)  
Digital Republic ist der innovative und flexible Provider für Mobile Abos und mobiles Internet in der Schweiz. Als Teil der mobilezone Gruppe arbeiten wir in Zürich (Schlieren) und verfolgen ein klares Ziel: Einfache Produkte mit einem starken Preis\-Leistungs\-Verhältnis und persönlichem Support. Bei uns erwartet dich ein junges und motiviertes Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, viel Eigenverantwortung und einer offenen Du\-Kultur. Du möchtest mitdenken, mitgestalten und wirklich etwas bewegen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.  
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in Zürich (Schlieren) suchen wir dich als  
Sachbearbeiter Kundendienst DE/FR 80\-100% (m/w/d)  
Deine Aufgaben  
Als Mitglied unseres Supportteams bist du bei uns die wichtige Ansprechperson für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden und setzt deren Zufriedenheit an erste Stelle. Du hilfst bei Fragen, löst Probleme und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kundinnen und Kunden eine exzellente Erfahrung mit Digital Republic machen.  
Du bearbeitest Kundenanfragen via Telefon und Ticketingsystem auf Deutsch, ösisch und idealerweise auf Englisch.  
Du unterstützt unsere Kundinnen und Kunden bei Fragen und berätst sie proaktiv rund um unsere Mobile\-, Home\- und Daten\-Abos.  
Du gibst Kundenfeedback intern weiter und trägst so zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung unserer Abos und interner Prozesse bei.  
Du unterstützt bei Backoffice\-Aufgaben und arbeitest mit anderen Teams innerhalb der Firma zusammen.  
Das bringst du mit  
Eine abgeschlossene Lehre im Bereich /\-frau, Kundendialog oder einem vergleichbaren Fachgebiet  
Du verfügst über mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung im Kundendienst. Viel wichtiger ist uns aber, dass du gerne mit Menschen kommunizierst, stets freundlich bleibst und auch bei mehreren gleichzeitigen Anfragen den Überblick behältst  
Du schreibst und sprichst fliessend und stilsicher Deutsch und ösisch. Gute Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil  
Du arbeitest selbstständig, zuverlässig und genau. Du denkst mit und übernimmst gerne Verantwortung  
Deine positive und kommunikative Persönlichkeit zeichnet dich aus und du hast Freude daran, Kundinnen und Kunden wirklich weiterzuhelfen  
Du bist bereit, gelegentlich auch samstags zu arbeiten und dafür unter der Woche zu nehmen  
Das bieten wir dir  
Ein spannendes Arbeitsumfeld im Telekommunikationsbereich  
Hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit fixen Büro\- und Homeoffice\-Tagen  
Eine kollegiale Atmosphäre mit Du\-Kultur und tollen Teamevents  
Ein kostenloses Digital Republic Mobile Abo  
Attraktive BVG\-Versicherungsleistungen  
Zentrale Lage in ZH (Schlieren) mit sehr guter ÖV\-Anbindung  
Die Möglichkeit, Ideen einzubringen und die Zukunft von Digital Republic aktiv mitzugestalten  
Interessiert?  
Dann freuen wir uns auf deine vollständige Bewerbung über unser Online\-Bewerbungssystem.

description:

aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.

Solution Architect SAP PS \& SD  
Are you passionate about designing innovative SAP solutions and shaping the next generation of business processes? Join our team and play a key role in shaping and implementing the end\-to\-end architecture for customer project processes across SAP PS \& SD, and surrounding systems. Combining architectural responsibility with hands\-on development, you will collaborate with Product Owners, development teams, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable, integrated, and future\-ready solutions for our global organization.  
This is where you'll excel  
You shape the SAP solution architecture for customer project management across SAP PS \& SD and related custom solutions, ensuring alignment with strategic business objectives and enterprise standards  
You design and specify technical solutions, either implementing them hands\-on or guiding their delivery from concept to completion  
You partner with Product Owners, Product Managers, and agile teams to refine, deliver, and operate solutions across the entire product lifecycle  
You ensure seamless integration between SAP PS \& SD, other SAP modules, and external systems to support efficient end\-to\-end business processes  
You provide expert 3rd\-level support, troubleshoot complex issues, and coordinate with stakeholders to ensure timely resolution of incidents and requests  
These are the skills you'll need  
Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field (e.g., HF, FH, university, or an internationally equivalent qualification)  
5\+ years of professional experience, including 3\+ years in SAP solution architecture, development, or a comparable technical SAP role; agile experience (Scrum, SAFe) is a plus  
Deep expertise in SAP PS and/or SD is ideal. What matters most is a strong architectural mindset across SAP modules, so candidates with deep expertise in another area such as FI/CO who bring broad SAP knowledge and a track record of designing integrated solutions are equally encouraged to apply  
Strong hands\-on expertise in ABAP and ABAP OO development, including custom programs, enhancements, BAPIs, and BADIs; BTP, OData, and CDS experience is a plus  
Proven ability to take ownership, proactively drive initiatives and solutions, solve complex problems, and collaborate effectively across technical and business teams, combined with fluent business\-level English

Werkstudentin / Werkstudent Administration Klinikinformations\-System  
50\-50%

Als neugeschaffener Geschäftsbereich trägt der IDM wesentlich zur Zukunftsfähigkeit der PDAG im sich wandelnden Gesundheitswesen bei.

Sie studieren und sind ein immatrikulierter Student/Studentin  
Sie besitzen analytische Fähigkeiten und sehr gute Anwenderkenntnisse in den gängigen MS Office\-Produkten (Word, PowerPoint, Excel), Visio ist wünschenswert  
Sie sind verantwortungsbewusst, haben sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Sprache und Schrift  
Sie schätzen die Möglichkeit zu selbstorganisiertem Arbeiten und besitzen die Bereitschaft, sich in eine oder mehrere Fachapplikationen und Thematiken einzuarbeiten  
Sie besitzen Erfahrung in Protokollierung von Meetings / Aufgaben generell  
Aufgaben  
Erfassen, Mutieren und Beenden von Berechtigungen gem. Berechtigungskonzept und Sonderrechten gemäss Auftrag im Klinikinformations\-System (Orbis)  
Erstellen von definierten Auswertungen  
Administrative Tätigkeiten Terminabklärungen, Ablage von Dokumenten, Erstellen von Prozessdiagrammen, Vorgabedokumenten für die Parametrierung, (Projekt)\-Besprechungen  
Protokolle verfassen, Dokumente redigieren  
Erfassen von Stammdaten nach Vorgabe  
Mitarbeit bei der Erstellung von Schulungsunterlage
